words.ex: He asked for help at the enquiry desk.
words.ex_cn: 他在问询处寻求帮助。
words.en: A desk in a public place where you can get information or ask questions.

words.ex: The reception at the hotel was very friendly.
words.ex_cn: 酒店的接待非常友好。
words.en: The act of receiving or being received, especially in a formal or official context.

words.tr:
adj. 高层的（建筑）
n. 高楼；大厦；多层建筑物
words.ex: He lives in a high-rise building near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他住在公园附近的一栋高楼里。
words.en: A high-rise building is a tall building with many floors.

words.ex: His residence is near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他的住所靠近公园。
words.en: A residence is a house or place where someone lives.

words.tr:
adj. 居住的；常驻的；
n. 常住居民；
words.ex: The resident population grew last year.
words.ex_cn: 居住人口去年增加了。
words.en: A resident is someone who lives in a particular place or a person who has their home in a place.

words.ex: The occupant of the room is sleeping.
words.ex_cn: 房间里的住户正在睡觉。
words.en: An occupant is someone who lives in or uses a particular room, building, or area of land.

words.ex: The urban area has many tall buildings.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市地区有许多高楼。
words.en: relating to a city or town

words.ex: They live in a quiet suburb outside the city.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在城市外一个安静的市郊。
words.en: A suburb is a residential district located on the outskirts of a city.

words.ex: They live on the outskirts of the city.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在城市的郊区。
words.en: The outskirts of a city or town are the parts of it that are farthest away from its center.

words.ex: He lives in a rural village with no big shops.
words.ex_cn: 他住在没有大商店的农村村庄里。
words.en: Rural areas are areas which are not towns or cities. They are often farming or agricultural areas.

words.ex: He grew up in the countryside.
words.ex_cn: 他是在农村长大的。
words.en: The countryside refers to the land and scenery of a rural area, often characterized by farms, fields, and small villages, away from urban centers.

words.ex: He was born in a small village.
words.ex_cn: 他出生在一个小村庄。
words.en: A village is a small group of houses in the country, smaller than a town.

words.ex: They live in a small cottage near the forest.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在森林附近的一座小村舍里。
words.en: A cottage is a small house, usually in the countryside.

words.tr:
n. 市中心区；商业区；
adv. 在市区；往市区；
words.ex: We went downtown to buy some clothes.
words.ex_cn: 我们去市中心买了一些衣服。
words.en: Downtown refers to the central part or main business and commercial area of a city or town.

words.ex: They bought a small house near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他们买了一栋靠近公园的小房子。
words.en: A house is a building in which people live, usually the people belonging to one family.

words.ex: He lives in a big city.
words.ex_cn: 他住在一个大城市里。
words.en: A city is a large town where many people live and work.

words.tr: n. 地面；土地；场地；根据； v. 磨碎；“grind”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The children are playing on the ground.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在地面上玩耍。
words.en: The solid surface of the earth; the basis or foundation for something; to restrict an aircraft or pilot from flying.

words.tr: n. 住处；膳宿；(交通工具内的)空间；
words.ex: The hotel provided cheap accommodation for travelers.
words.ex_cn: 酒店为旅客提供了便宜的住处。
words.en: Accommodation is a place where someone lives or stays, or the act of providing someone with a place to live or stay.

words.ex: My roommate likes to listen to music at night.
words.ex_cn: 我的室友喜欢晚上听音乐。
words.en: A roommate is a person with whom one shares a room or rooms, especially in a college or university dormitory or a shared apartment.

words.tr: adj. 可获得的；有空的；可用的；
words.ex: The books are available in the library.
words.ex_cn: 这些书在图书馆里可以借到。
words.en: If something is available, it is able to be used or obtained.

words.tr:
n. 公寓；
adj. 平坦的；扁平的；(轮胎)瘪了的；平淡无味的；
adv. 直接地；
words.ex: He lives in a small flat in London.
words.ex_cn: 他住在伦敦的一间小公寓里。
words.en: Something that is flat is level and smooth, with no curved, high, or hollow parts.

words.tr: n. 单元住宅；公寓住宅；
words.ex: He lives in a small apartment near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他住在公园附近的一间小公寓里。
words.en: An apartment is a set of rooms for living in, usually on one floor of a large building.

words.ex: They live in a big villa near the sea.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在海边的一座大别墅里。
words.en: A villa is a fairly large house, especially one that is used for holidays in Mediterranean countries.

words.ex: We stayed at a small hotel near the beach.
words.ex_cn: 我们住在海边一家小旅馆里。
words.en: A hotel is a building where people stay, for example on holiday, paying for their rooms and meals.

words.ex: They stayed at a motel near the highway.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在高速公路旁的一家汽车旅馆。
words.en: A motel is a hotel which is designed for people who are travelling by car, usually with parking spaces next to each room.

words.ex: The students stayed in a youth hostel during their trip.
words.ex_cn: 学生们在旅行期间住在青年旅舍。
words.en: A youth hostel is a place where young people, especially those who are traveling, can stay cheaply for short periods of time. It usually provides dormitory-style accommodation and shared facilities.

words.tr:
n. 度假胜地；手段；
v. 求助于；
words.ex: They went to a beach resort for their vacation.
words.ex_cn: 他们去一个海滨度假胜地度假。
words.en: If you resort to a particular course of action, you do it because you cannot see any other way of achieving what you want.

words.tr:
n. 地点；场所；斑点；
v. 发现；识别；
words.ex: This is the spot where we met for the first time.
words.ex_cn: 这是我们第一次见面的地方。
words.en: A spot is a particular place or point. It can also refer to a small mark or stain, or a small amount of something. As a verb, it means to see, notice, or recognize someone or something.

words.ex: He waited in the foyer before the show started.
words.ex_cn: 演出开始前，他在门厅里等候。
words.en: A foyer is an area at the front of a building, especially a hotel or theater, where people can wait or meet others.

words.ex: I live with a local family during my homestay.
words.ex_cn: 我在寄宿家庭期间和一个当地家庭住在一起。
words.en: A homestay is a form of tourism and/or study abroad program that allows the visitor to rent a room from a local family to better learn the local lifestyle as well as improve their language ability.

words.ex: He lives in a small studio apartment near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他住在公园附近的一间小单间公寓里。
words.en: A studio apartment is a small apartment which combines living room, bedroom, and kitchen into a single room.

words.ex: He lives in the residence hall with his roommates.
words.ex_cn: 他和室友住在学生宿舍里。
words.en: A residence hall is a building where students live, typically on a university campus.

words.ex: He lives in the dormitory with three roommates.
words.ex_cn: 他和三个室友住在宿舍里。
words.en: A dormitory is a large bedroom where many people sleep, especially in a school or college.

words.ex: He lives in a residential college near the campus.
words.ex_cn: 他住在校园附近的一所住宿学院里。
words.en: A residential college is a college that provides accommodation for students, typically on or near the campus of a university.

words.ex: Please leave your coat in the cloakroom.
words.ex_cn: 请把你的外套放在衣帽间。
words.en: A cloakroom is a room where coats, hats, luggage, or other items may be left temporarily, as in a theater, public building, or school.

words.ex: He lives in a bedsit near the station.
words.ex_cn: 他住在车站附近的一间单间公寓里。
words.en: A bedsit is a single room that serves as both bedroom and living room, often with basic cooking facilities.

words.tr: phrase. 合住房间；多人共用的房间
words.ex: They live in a shared room at university.
words.ex_cn: 他们在大学里住一间共用的房间。
words.en: A room that is rented and used by more than one person, typically to reduce costs.

words.ex: He booked a standard suite for his vacation.
words.ex_cn: 他为假期预订了一间标准套房。
words.en: A basic set of rooms or services in a hotel, offering essential amenities at a standard rate.

words.ex: He booked a single room for the night.
words.ex_cn: 他预订了一个单人房间过夜。
words.en: A single room is a hotel room designed for one person, containing one single bed.

words.ex: He put his clothes in the laundry room.
words.ex_cn: 他把衣服放进洗衣房。
words.en: A room in a house or building where clothes and linens are washed and dried.

words.ex: We waited in the lounge before our flight.
words.ex_cn: 我们在登机前等在休息室里。
words.en: A lounge is a room in a house or public building where people can sit and relax. As a verb, to lounge means to lie, sit, or stand in a relaxed or lazy way.

words.ex: The closetlavatory is down the hall.
words.ex_cn: 厕所在走廊尽头。
words.en: A small, enclosed space within a room used for storage or as a private area.

words.ex: The toilet is broken and needs repair.
words.ex_cn: 马桶坏了，需要修理。
words.en: A toilet is a large bowl connected to the plumbing and used for urinating and defecating, typically fitted with a seat and flushing device.

words.ex: I went to the bathroom after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 晚饭后我去了一趟浴室。
words.en: A room containing a bath or shower and typically also a washbasin and a toilet.

words.ex: He drinks coffee on the balcony every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都在阳台上喝咖啡。
words.en: A balcony is a platform on the outside of a building, enclosed by walls or balustrades, supported by columns or console brackets. The platform is projected from the wall of a building, usually above the ground floor.

words.ex: The house has a small terrace with chairs.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子有一个带椅子的小平台。
words.en: A terrace is a flat area of stone or grass next to a building where people can sit.

words.ex: She cooks dinner in the kitchen.
words.ex_cn: 她在厨房里做晚饭。
words.en: A kitchen is a room or part of a room used for cooking and food preparation in a dwelling or in a commercial establishment.

words.ex: The children found old toys in the attic.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在阁楼上找到了旧玩具。
words.en: An attic is a space or room just below the roof of a building, often used for storage or as an extra room.

words.ex: We eat dinner in the dining room.
words.ex_cn: 我们在餐厅吃晚饭。
words.en: A dining room is a room in a house where people eat their meals.

words.ex: We watch TV in the living room.
words.ex_cn: 我们在客厅看电视。
words.en: A room in a house for general and informal everyday use.

words.ex: He sleeps in his bedroom every night.
words.ex_cn: 他每晚都在卧室睡觉。
words.en: A bedroom is a room in a house or apartment where people sleep.

words.ex: The toys are in the basement.
words.ex_cn: 玩具在地下室里。
words.en: The basement of a building is a room or area that is partly or completely below ground level.

words.tr: n. 建筑物；楼房； v. 建筑；“build”的现在分词；
words.ex: The tall building has 20 floors.
words.ex_cn: 这栋高楼有20层。
words.en: A building is a structure that has a roof and walls and stands more or less permanently in one place.

words.tr: phrase. 翼楼；侧翼附属建筑（指与主建筑相连的侧边扩建部分）
words.ex: The wing annex is connected to the main building.
words.ex_cn: 附属翼楼与主楼相连。
words.en: A wing annex is a building or section attached to the main part of a larger structure, often used for additional space or specific purposes.

words.ex: The invention of the wheel was a landmark in human history.
words.ex_cn: 轮子的发明是人类历史上的一个里程碑。
words.en: A landmark is a building or feature of a landscape that is easily seen and recognized from a distance, especially one that enables someone to establish their location.

words.tr:
n. 大楼；大厦；块；街区；障碍物；
v. 阻塞；阻碍；
words.ex: The new block is next to the park.
words.ex_cn: 这栋新大楼就在公园旁边。
words.en: A block is a large solid piece of material with flat surfaces on each side. As a verb, to block means to prevent movement or progress.

words.tr:
n. 地址；演讲；
v. 解决；向…讲话；
words.ex: Please write your address on the form.
words.ex_cn: 请把你的地址写在表格上。
words.en: The particulars of the place where someone lives or an organization is situated; a formal speech delivered to an audience.

words.ex: The cat ran down the alley.
words.ex_cn: 猫跑进了小巷。
words.en: An alley is a narrow passage between buildings or other structures.

words.ex: There are many shops on this avenue.
words.ex_cn: 这条大街上有许多商店。
words.en: An avenue is a wide street or main thoroughfare, often lined with trees or other landscaping.

words.ex: The children play on the street.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在街上玩耍。
words.en: A street is a road in a city, town, or village, usually with houses and buildings on one or both sides.

words.ex: The road is long and quiet.
words.ex_cn: 这条路又长又安静。
words.en: A road is a long piece of hard ground which is built between two places so that people can drive or ride easily from one place to the other.

words.ex: He wrote his postcode on the envelope.
words.ex_cn: 他把邮编写在了信封上。
words.en: A postcode is a sequence of letters and numbers which is part of an address and shows exactly where a place is.

words.tr: adj. 共享的；共同的； v. 共享；分享；“share”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: They use a shared kitchen in the apartment.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在公寓里，共用一个厨房。
words.en: Used to describe something that is used, held, or enjoyed by two or more people together.

words.ex: The landlady gives us the keys every Monday.
words.ex_cn: 女房东每周一给我们钥匙。
words.en: A woman who rents out land, a building, or accommodation.

words.ex: The landlord fixed the broken window.
words.ex_cn: 房东修好了破掉的窗户。
words.en: A landlord is a person who owns land or property and rents it out to others.

words.ex: He is a nondrinker because he does not like alcohol.
words.ex_cn: 他不喝酒，因为他不喜欢酒精。
words.en: A nondrinker is someone who does not drink alcohol.

words.ex: The neighboring house has a big garden.
words.ex_cn: 邻近的那所房子有一个大花园。
words.en: Located or living near or next to a place or person.

words.ex: The home appliance stopped working suddenly.
words.ex_cn: 家用电器突然坏了。
words.en: A home appliance is a device or machine used in the home, especially for domestic chores.

words.ex: The room has new furniture.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间有新家具。
words.en: Furniture refers to the movable objects intended to support various human activities such as seating, eating, and sleeping.

words.ex: He sits by the fireplace in winter.
words.ex_cn: 冬天他坐在壁炉旁。
words.en: A fireplace is a place built into a wall where you can have a fire, especially in a house.

words.tr:
n. 声音；声响；
v. 听起来；
adj. 健全的；合理的；可靠的；
words.ex: I heard a strange sound at night.
words.ex_cn: 我半夜听到了一个奇怪的声音。
words.en: Sound is a vibration that propagates as an acoustic wave, through a transmission medium such as a gas, liquid or solid. In human physiology and psychology, sound is the reception of such waves and their perception by the brain.

words.ex: The noise from the street kept me awake.
words.ex_cn: 街道上的噪声让我睡不着。
words.en: Noise is a sound, especially one that is loud, unpleasant, or disturbing.

words.tr:
n. 声音；意见；
v. 表达；
words.ex: I heard a loud voice from the next room.
words.ex_cn: 我听到隔壁房间传来很大的声音。
words.en: Your voice is the sound that you make when you speak or sing.

words.ex: The speaker told a funny story.
words.ex_cn: 说话者讲了一个有趣的故事。
words.en: A speaker is someone who speaks, especially someone who gives a speech or makes a presentation.

words.tr: n. 无线电；无线电广播；收音机；
words.ex: He listens to the radio every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上听无线电。
words.en: A radio is the equipment that you use to listen to broadcasts of news, music, and other programs.

words.ex: She turned on the lamp to read a book.
words.ex_cn: 她打开灯来读书。
words.en: A lamp is a device that produces light by the flow of electric current, or by burning oil or gas.

words.tr:
adj. 温暖的；
v. （使）变暖；
words.ex: The sun gives us warm light.
words.ex_cn: 太阳给我们温暖的光。
words.en: Having or giving out a moderate degree of heat, as perceived by the senses.

words.ex: He took a photo with his camera.
words.ex_cn: 他用他的摄像机拍了一张照片。
words.en: A camera is a piece of equipment that is used for taking photographs, making films, or producing television pictures.

words.ex: He dried his hands with a towel.
words.ex_cn: 他用毛巾擦干手。
words.en: A towel is a piece of thick soft cloth that you use to dry yourself with.

words.tr:
n. 真空；空虚；
v. 用真空吸尘器打扫；
words.ex: The vacuum in space keeps no air.
words.ex_cn: 太空中的真空没有空气。
words.en: A vacuum is a space that contains no air or other gas, or a space from which most of the air or gas has been removed. It can also refer to a device that cleans floors and surfaces by sucking up dirt and dust.

words.ex: He turned on the hoover to clean the carpet.
words.ex_cn: 他打开吸尘器清理地毯。
words.en: To clean something, especially a carpet, with a vacuum cleaner.

words.ex: She pulled the curtain to block the sunlight.
words.ex_cn: 她拉上帷幕以挡住阳光。
words.en: A curtain is a piece of material that hangs down, often used to cover a window or to divide a room.

words.ex: She opened the window to let in fresh air.
words.ex_cn: 她打开窗户让新鲜空气进来。
words.en: A window is a space in the wall of a building or in the side of a vehicle, which has glass in it so that light can pass through and people can see out.

words.ex: He pressed the shutter to take a photo.
words.ex_cn: 他按下快门拍了一张照片。
words.en: A shutter is a device used to cover or uncover a window or a camera lens.

words.ex: I need to buy a new water heater.
words.ex_cn: 我需要买一个新的热水器。
words.en: A device that heats water for use in homes and businesses.

words.tr:
n. 电话；
v. 打电话；
words.ex: I lost my phone yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 我昨天丢了电话。
words.en: A phone is a piece of equipment that you use to talk to someone who is in another place.

words.tr: adj. 即将开始的；新任的；
words.ex: The incoming class will start next week.
words.ex_cn: 即将开始的班级将在下周开课。
words.en: An incoming thing or person is arriving or being received.

words.tr: n. 电话交谈节目；热线节目
words.ex: He called a phone-in show to share his story.
words.ex_cn: 他打电话参加了一个电话热线节目来分享他的故事。
words.en: A phone-in is a radio or television program during which listeners or viewers call in to participate, ask questions, or give opinions.

words.ex: The doctor examined the tissue under a microscope.
words.ex_cn: 医生在显微镜下检查了组织。
words.en: Tissue is a group of cells that have a similar structure and that work together to perform a specific function.

words.tr:
v. 举起；提起；抬起；
n. 电梯；搭便车；
words.ex: He lift the box with both hands.
words.ex_cn: 他用双手举起箱子。
words.en: To lift something means to move it to a higher position. A lift is a device that carries people or goods up and down inside buildings.

words.ex: He took the elevator to the 10th floor.
words.ex_cn: 他乘电梯上了十楼。
words.en: An elevator is a device that moves people or goods up and down inside a building.

words.ex: He put the milk in the fridge.
words.ex_cn: 他把牛奶放进冰箱里。
words.en: A fridge is a large container which is kept cool inside, usually by electricity, so that the food and drink in it stays fresh.

words.ex: He put the milk in the refrigerator.
words.ex_cn: 他把牛奶放进冰箱里。
words.en: A refrigerator is a large container which is kept cool inside, usually by electricity, so that the food and drink in it stays fresh.

words.ex: She put the ice cream in the freezer.
words.ex_cn: 她把冰淇淋放进冷冻柜里。
words.en: A freezer is a device that is used to store food at very low temperatures in order to preserve it.

words.ex: He does his homework at the desk.
words.ex_cn: 他在书桌上做作业。
words.en: A desk is a piece of furniture with a flat surface, typically used for writing, reading, or working on a computer.

words.ex: He sat on the chair and read a book.
words.ex_cn: 他坐在椅子上读书。
words.en: A chair is a piece of furniture for one person to sit on, with a back and usually four legs.

words.tr:
n. 桌子；表格；台子；
v. 搁置；
words.ex: He put his books on the table.
words.ex_cn: 他把书放在桌子上。
words.en: A table is a piece of furniture with a flat top that you put things on or use to do things such as eat, write, or work.

words.ex: He kept the dishes in the cabinet.
words.ex_cn: 他把盘子放在储藏柜里。
words.en: A cabinet is a piece of furniture with doors and shelves or drawers, used for storing or showing things. In politics, a cabinet is a group of people who are chosen by a head of state to give advice and to help set government policy.

words.ex: He pulled the keys from the drawer.
words.ex_cn: 他从抽屉里拿出钥匙。
words.en: A drawer is a sliding container that fits into a piece of furniture, such as a desk or chest, and is used for storing things.

words.ex: He rubbed his chest after the cough.
words.ex_cn: 他咳嗽后揉了揉胸部。
words.en: The front part of a person's body between the neck and the stomach, or a large strong box used for storing things.

words.tr: n. 有围栏的幼儿床；轻便小床；
words.ex: The baby sleeps in a cot beside the bed.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿睡在床边的婴儿床里。
words.en: A cot is a small bed for a baby, with high sides to prevent the baby from falling out.

words.ex: He bought a new mattress for his bed.
words.ex_cn: 他为床买了一个新床垫。
words.en: A mattress is a large, flat pad that is placed on a bed to make it comfortable to sleep on.

words.ex: He put a mat on the floor to keep it clean.
words.ex_cn: 他在地上放了一块垫子以保持清洁。
words.en: A mat is a piece of thick fabric or other material that is placed on a floor or other surface to protect it or to provide a soft surface to stand or sit on.

words.ex: She washed the bedsheet yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 她昨天洗了床单。
words.en: A bedsheet is a large piece of cloth that is used to cover a mattress and is often used as a layer between the sleeper and their blanket.

words.tr: phrase. 床单用亚麻布；亚麻床单布料
words.ex: She washes the sheet linen every week.
words.ex_cn: 她每周清洗床单。
words.en: Sheet linen refers to a type of lightweight, breathable fabric made from flax, often used for clothing, bedding, or table linens.

words.tr:
n. 毛毯；厚的覆盖物；
adj. 包括所有的；
words.ex: He wrapped himself in a warm blanket.
words.ex_cn: 他把自己裹在一条温暖的毛毯里。
words.en: A blanket is a large piece of woolen or similar material used as a covering on a bed or elsewhere for warmth.

words.ex: He walks on the carpet every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都走在地毯上。
words.en: A carpet is a thick covering of soft material which is laid over a floor or a staircase.

words.ex: She put a cushion on the chair to make it comfortable.
words.ex_cn: 她在椅子上放了一个靠垫，让它更舒服。
words.en: A cushion is a soft bag of some ornamental material, stuffed with wool, hair, feathers, polyester staple fiber, non-woven material, or even paper torn into fragments. It may be used for sitting or kneeling upon, or to soften the hardness or angularity of a chair or couch.

words.ex: The size of the box is too big for the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子的大小对架子来说太大了。
words.en: The physical dimensions, proportions, magnitude, or extent of an object.

words.ex: We booked a double room for our trip.
words.ex_cn: 我们为旅行预订了一间双人房。
words.en: A room intended for two people, typically containing a double bed.

words.tr: phrase. 带两张单人床的双人房
words.ex: We booked a twin room for our trip.
words.ex_cn: 我们为旅行预订了一间双人房。
words.en: A room with two single beds, typically for two people.

words.tr: phrase. 双单人床房间（指配备两张单人床的客房）
words.ex: They share a twin-bed room at the summer camp.
words.ex_cn: 他们在夏令营共用一个双人床的房间。
words.en: A room with two single beds, suitable for two people.

words.tr: phrase. 带双人床的房间；双人卧室
words.ex: They booked a double-bed room for their honeymoon.
words.ex_cn: 他们为蜜月预订了一间双人床房间。
words.en: A room with a bed designed for two people to sleep in.

words.ex: He heats food in a microwave oven.
words.ex_cn: 他用微波炉加热食物。
words.en: A microwave oven is an oven that uses microwaves to cook or heat food.

words.ex: She uses the washing machine every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 她每星期天都用洗衣机。
words.en: A washing machine is a machine that washes clothes, sheets, and other items.

words.ex: He turned on the air-conditioner to cool the room.
words.ex_cn: 他打开了空调来让房间凉快。
words.en: An air-conditioner is a machine that keeps the air in a building cool and dry.

words.ex: He turns on the electric fan to cool the room.
words.ex_cn: 他打开电风扇来让房间凉快。
words.en: An electric fan is a device with rotating blades that creates a current of air for cooling or ventilation.

words.ex: The radiator is hot in the winter.
words.ex_cn: 冬天时，散热器是热的。
words.en: A radiator is a device for heating a room or building, consisting of a series of pipes through which hot water or steam is circulated. It can also refer to a device for cooling an engine or other mechanism, typically consisting of a bank of thin tubes with fins attached, through which coolant flows.

words.ex: He uses a toaster to make toast every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上用烤面包机烤面包。
words.en: A toaster is an electric device for making toast by heating slices of bread on both sides.

words.tr: n. 加热；供暖设备；采暖； v. 加热；“heat”的现在分词；
words.ex: The heating of the room takes five minutes.
words.ex_cn: 房间的加热需要五分钟。
words.en: The process of making something warm or hot, or the system that does this.

words.ex: He made a pre-booking for the hotel room.
words.ex_cn: 他提前预订了酒店房间。
words.en: The act of booking or reserving something in advance.

words.ex: I take a shower every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我每天早上都洗淋浴。
words.en: A shower is a device that sprays water over you so that you can wash yourself. It is also a short period of rain or snow.

words.ex: The bath is next to the bedroom.
words.ex_cn: 浴室在卧室旁边。
words.en: A bath is the process of washing your body, usually by sitting or lying in a container of water.

words.ex: He is taking a bath in the bathtub.
words.ex_cn: 他正在浴缸里洗澡。
words.en: A bathtub is a long, usually rectangular container which you fill with water and sit in to wash your body.

words.tr: phrase. 烟雾报警器；烟感警报装置
words.ex: The smoke alarm went off at night.
words.ex_cn: 夜里的烟雾报警器响了。
words.en: A smoke alarm is a device that makes a loud noise to warn people when it detects smoke, indicating a possible fire.

words.ex: He forgot the keys to the locks.
words.ex_cn: 他忘了锁的钥匙。
words.en: Locks are devices used to secure doors, containers, etc., and can also refer to sections of a canal or river where the water level changes, controlled by gates.

words.tr:
adj. 关键的；
n. 钥匙；关键；
words.ex: This is a key step to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 这是解决问题的关键步骤。
words.en: A key is a specially shaped piece of metal that you place in a lock and turn in order to open or lock a door, or to start or stop the engine of a vehicle.

words.ex: He keeps a spare key under the mat.
words.ex_cn: 他把一把备用钥匙放在门垫下面。
words.en: A spare key is an extra key made for a lock, kept as a replacement in case the original key is lost or locked inside.

words.ex: She looked at herself in the mirror.
words.ex_cn: 她对着镜子看自己。
words.en: A mirror is a flat piece of glass which reflects light, so that when you look at it you can see yourself reflected in it.

words.ex: He cut the bread with a knife.
words.ex_cn: 他用刀切面包。
words.en: A knife is a tool for cutting or a weapon, consisting of a flat piece of metal with a sharp edge on the end of a handle.

words.tr:
n. 警报；闹钟；惊慌；
v. 使惊恐；
words.ex: The fire alarm rang loudly.
words.ex_cn: 火警警报大声响了起来。
words.en: An alarm is a warning of danger, often given by a bell or flashing light.

words.tr: phrase. 预订座位；预留座位
words.ex: I will reserve a seat for you.
words.ex_cn: 我会为你预留一个座位。
words.en: To book or hold a seat in advance for a particular event or journey.

words.ex: I will make a reservation for two people.
words.ex_cn: 我将为两个人预订。
words.en: To book or arrange for something in advance, such as a table at a restaurant.

words.ex: He keeps his diary private.
words.ex_cn: 他把日记保密。
words.en: If something is private, it is for the use of one person or group, rather than for the general public.

words.tr: phrase. 没有隐私；毫无私人空间
words.ex: He has no privacy in his small apartment.
words.ex_cn: 他在小公寓里没有隐私。
words.en: The condition of being free from unauthorized intrusion or observation by others.

words.ex: The town lost electricity during the storm.
words.ex_cn: 风暴期间，这个城镇停电了。
words.en: A form of energy resulting from the existence of charged particles (such as electrons or protons), either statically as an accumulation of charge or dynamically as a current.

words.ex: He closed the door quietly.
words.ex_cn: 他轻轻地关上了门。
words.en: A door is a piece of wood, glass, or metal, which is moved to open and close the entrance to a building, room, cupboard, or vehicle.

words.ex: The unemployment rate is an economic indicator.
words.ex_cn: 失业率是一个经济指标。
words.en: An indicator is a measurement or value which gives you an idea of what something is like.

words.ex: He bought a new stereo system for his living room.
words.ex_cn: 他为客厅买了一个新的音响系统。
words.en: A stereo system is a set of equipment for playing recorded sound, which uses two or more separate speakers to produce a more natural and realistic sound.

words.ex: She put the dirty plates into the dishwasher.
words.ex_cn: 她把脏盘子放进洗碗机里。
words.en: A dishwasher is a machine that washes dirty dishes automatically.

words.tr: n. 烘干机； adj. “dry”的比较级；
words.ex: I put my clothes in the dryer after washing.
words.ex_cn: 我洗完衣服后把它们放进烘干机。
words.en: A dryer is a machine that dries things, especially clothes, by using hot air.

words.ex: She put the plates in the cupboard.
words.ex_cn: 她把盘子放在碗橱里。
words.en: A cupboard is a piece of furniture with doors and shelves that is used for storing things, usually in a kitchen.

words.ex: He put his clothes in the wardrobe.
words.ex_cn: 他把衣服放进衣橱里。
words.en: A wardrobe is a tall cupboard or cabinet in which you can hang your clothes.

words.ex: She turned on the cooker to boil water.
words.ex_cn: 她打开炉子烧水。
words.en: A cooker is a device or appliance used for cooking food.

words.ex: The cooks prepare dinner every evening.
words.ex_cn: 厨师们每天晚上准备晚餐。
words.en: To prepare food by heating it, often by boiling, baking, or frying. Also refers to a person who prepares and cooks food, especially as a job.

words.tr: adj. 偏远的；隔离的；孤独的； v. 使隔离；“isolate”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The village is isolated, far from any city.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄很偏远，远离任何城市。
words.en: If something is isolated, it is far away from other places, buildings, or people.

words.tr: n. 定居点；定居（过程）；协议；
words.ex: The small settlement near the river has five houses.
words.ex_cn: 河边的小定居点有五所房子。
words.en: A settlement is an official agreement intended to resolve a dispute or conflict.

words.ex: The noise from the construction caused a disturbance.
words.ex_cn: 建筑工地的噪音造成了干扰。
words.en: A disturbance is an event or situation in which people behave in a noisy or violent way, or something that interrupts what you are doing.

words.ex: He bought insurance for his car.
words.ex_cn: 他为他的车买了保险。
words.en: Insurance is an arrangement in which you pay money to a company, and they pay money to you if something unpleasant happens to you, for example if your property is stolen or damaged, or if you get a serious illness.

words.ex: The construction of the new bridge took two years.
words.ex_cn: 新桥的建筑花了两年时间。
words.en: The process or method of building or making something, especially buildings, bridges, etc.

words.tr: 短语. 正在建设中；施工中
words.ex: The bridge is under construction.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥正在建设中。
words.en: If a building or other structure is under construction, it is being built.

words.ex: A is the first letter in the English alphabet.
words.ex_cn: A 是英语字母表中的第一个字母。
words.en: A letter is a written message that can be handwritten or printed on paper. It is usually sent in an envelope by post or messenger.

words.tr:
n. 邮件；
v. 邮寄；
words.ex: I checked my mail this morning.
words.ex_cn: 我今天早上查了邮件。
words.en: Mail refers to letters, packages, etc., that are sent or delivered by post.

words.tr:
n. 烟；烟雾；
v. 抽烟；冒烟；
words.ex: The fire produced thick smoke.
words.ex_cn: 火灾产生了浓烟。
words.en: Smoke consists of gas and small bits of solid material that are sent into the air when something burns.

words.ex: The community cleaned the park together.
words.ex_cn: 社区居民一起清理了公园。
words.en: A community is a group of people who live in the same area or who have the same interests, religion, or nationality.

words.tr: n. 代码；编码；行为准则；密码；法典；
words.ex: He wrote a simple code to solve the math problem.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一段简单的代码来解决这个数学问题。
words.en: A code is a system of words, letters, figures, or other symbols substituted for other words, letters, etc., especially for the purposes of secrecy. As a verb, it means to convert (a message or other information) into a code.

words.ex: He forgot his password and could not log in.
words.ex_cn: 他忘记了密码，无法登录。
words.en: A password is a secret word or phrase that you must know in order to be allowed to enter a place or to use a computer system.

words.ex: The alteration of the dress made it fit better.
words.ex_cn: 这件衣服的修改让它更合身了。
words.en: An alteration is a change in or to something.

words.ex: She bought new decoration for her living room.
words.ex_cn: 她为客厅买了新的装饰品。
words.en: Decoration is the process or art of decorating something, or the objects used to decorate something.

words.ex: He parked his car in the garage.
words.ex_cn: 他把车停在了车库里。
words.en: A garage is a building where you keep a car. It can also refer to a place where cars are repaired.

words.ex: The children threw garbage on the floor.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们把垃圾扔在地上。
words.en: Waste material; unwanted or undesired material.

words.ex: He paints the wall blue.
words.ex_cn: 他把墙涂成蓝色。
words.en: A wall is a vertical structure, often made of stone or brick, that divides or encloses an area of land.

words.tr:
v. 抽水；打气；
n. 泵；抽水机；打气机；
words.ex: He pumps water from the well every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上从井里抽水。
words.en: A pump is a device that moves fluids (liquids or gases), or sometimes slurries, by mechanical action. Pumps can be classified into three major groups according to the method they use to move the fluid: direct lift, displacement, and gravity pumps.

words.ex: The government built large-scale housing for poor families.
words.ex_cn: 政府为贫困家庭建设了大规模住房。
words.en: Large-scale housing refers to the development of a significant number of residential units or housing projects, typically undertaken to meet the housing needs of a large population.

words.ex: The children are waiting in the entrance hall.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们正在入口大厅里等待。
words.en: An entrance hall is a large room or area at the entrance of a building.

words.ex: We waited in the hotel lobby for our friend.
words.ex_cn: 我们在酒店的大厅里等我们的朋友。
words.en: A lobby is a large room or hall in a building, often used for meetings or as a waiting area. As a verb, to lobby means to try to influence politicians or officials on a particular issue.

words.ex: He sits on the porch and drinks coffee.
words.ex_cn: 他坐在门廊上喝咖啡。
words.en: A porch is a covered shelter projecting in front of the entrance of a building.

words.tr: phrase. 特别的食物；特色食品
words.ex: He eats special food on his birthday.
words.ex_cn: 他在生日那天吃特别的食物。
words.en: Special food refers to food that is prepared or served for a particular occasion, purpose, or group of people, often characterized by its unique ingredients, preparation methods, or cultural significance.

words.tr: n. 需求；要求；必要条件；
words.ex: The job has a requirement of two years of experience.
words.ex_cn: 这份工作的要求是两年经验。
words.en: A requirement is something that is necessary or that must be done.

words.tr:
n. 素食者；食草动物；
adj. 素食者的；素菜的；
words.ex: He is a vegetarian and doesn't eat meat.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名素食者，不吃肉。
words.en: A vegetarian is someone who does not eat meat or fish, and sometimes other animal products, especially for moral, religious, or health reasons.

words.ex: I eat carrot and broccoli every day as vegetable.
words.ex_cn: 我每天吃胡萝卜和西兰花作为蔬菜。
words.en: A vegetable is a plant or part of a plant that is used as food, typically as accompaniment to meat or fish, such as a cabbage, potato, carrot, or bean.

words.tr:
adv. 只；仅仅；只有；
adj. 唯一的；仅有的；
words.ex: He eats only apples for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他早餐只吃苹果。
words.en: You use only to indicate the one thing that is true, appropriate, or important in a particular situation, in contrast to all the other things that are not true, appropriate, or important.

words.tr: phrase. 不吃红肉；不食用牛肉、猪肉、羊肉等红色肉类
words.ex: He eats no red meat for health reasons.
words.ex_cn: 他因为健康原因不吃红肉。
words.en: The term 'no red meat' refers to the practice of excluding red meat from one's diet, often for health, ethical, or environmental reasons.

words.tr: phrase. 禁止携带宠物；不允许带宠物
words.ex: Pets are not allowed in this building.
words.ex_cn: 这个建筑里不允许养宠物。
words.en: The phrase 'pets are not allowed' is used to indicate that bringing pets into a certain area or establishment is prohibited.

words.ex: He is a non-smoker and never drinks alcohol.
words.ex_cn: 他是个不吸烟的人，从不喝酒。
words.en: A person who does not smoke tobacco.

words.ex: The rent for the apartment is $800 per month.
words.ex_cn: 这套公寓的租金是每月800美元。
words.en: The rent rental price is the amount of money paid periodically by a tenant to a landlord for the use of a property or asset.

words.ex: Let me help you with your homework.
words.ex_cn: 让我帮你做作业。
words.en: To allow or permit something to happen or someone to do something.

words.tr:
n. 租契；
v. 出租；
words.ex: He signed a lease for the apartment.
words.ex_cn: 他签了公寓的租契。
words.en: A lease is a legal agreement by which the owner of a building, a piece of land, or something such as a car allows someone else to use it for a period of time in return for money.

words.ex: You need to pay a 40-yuan deposit to rent the bike.
words.ex_cn: 租自行车需要支付40元押金。
words.en: A deposit is a sum of money which is part of the full price of something, and which you pay when you agree to buy it. It is also a sum of money that you pay into a bank account.

words.ex: I asked for a refund after the product broke.
words.ex_cn: 产品坏了之后，我要求退款。
words.en: A refund is a sum of money that is returned to you, for example because you have paid too much or because you have returned goods to a shop.

words.tr: phrase. 最高租金；租金上限
words.ex: The maximum rent is $1000 per month.
words.ex_cn: 最高租金是每月1000美元。
words.en: The highest amount of money that can be legally charged for renting a property or space.

words.tr: phrase. 暖气费；取暖费用账单
words.ex: He paid his heating bill last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周付了取暖费。
words.en: A heating bill is a statement of money owed for heating services provided to a household or building.

words.tr: phrase. 公用事业账单（如水、电、燃气等费用账单）
words.ex: He paid the utility bill yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天交了水电费。
words.en: A utility bill is a statement of the amount owed for services such as electricity, water, and gas.

words.tr:
n. 预算；预算金额；
adj. 廉价的；花钱少的；
v. 为 ... 做预算；
words.ex: We made a budget for our vacation.
words.ex_cn: 我们为旅行制定了一个预算。
words.en: A budget is a plan that shows how much money a person or organization will earn and how much they will need or be able to spend.

words.ex: He paid one dollar for the apple.
words.ex_cn: 他花了一美元买这个苹果。
words.en: The dollar is the unit of money used in the United States, Canada, Australia, and some other countries.

words.ex: The book costs five pounds.
words.ex_cn: 这本书五英镑。
words.en: The pound is the unit of money used in Britain. It is also a unit of weight equal to 16 ounces or 0.4536 kilograms. As a verb, to pound means to hit something hard many times or to crush something into a powder or paste.

words.ex: The phone is expensive.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机很贵。
words.en: Costing a lot of money; having a high price.

words.ex: He gave a reasonable answer to the question.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个问题给出了一个合理的回答。
words.en: Fair and sensible; not excessive or extreme.

words.tr: v. 布置家具；“furnish”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 配备家具的；
words.ex: They furnished the apartment with new tables and chairs.
words.ex_cn: 他们给公寓布置了新的桌椅。
words.en: If a room or building is furnished, it is equipped with furniture.

words.tr:
adj. 无装备的；无家具设备的
v. 搬走家具；“unfurnish”的过去式和过去分词
words.ex: The apartment is unfurnished.
words.ex_cn: 这个公寓没有家具。
words.en: If a room or house is unfurnished, it does not contain any furniture.

words.tr:
n. 内部；
adj. 内部的；
words.ex: The interior of the house is very cozy.
words.ex_cn: 房子的内部非常舒适。
words.en: The interior of something is the inside part of it.

words.ex: The exterior of the house is painted white.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子的外观是白色的。
words.en: The outer surface or structure of something.

words.ex: He cooks soup on the stove.
words.ex_cn: 他用炉子煮汤。
words.en: A stove is a piece of equipment which provides heat, either for cooking or for heating a room.

words.tr: phrase. 冷却的；加热的（分别表示经过降温或升温处理的状态）
words.ex: The cooled heated metal was safe to touch.
words.ex_cn: 冷却后的金属可以安全触摸。
words.en: Cooled heated refers to a system or device that can both lower and raise the temperature to maintain a comfortable environment.

words.tr: n. 小路；小巷；航道；车道；航线；
words.ex: The children walked down the narrow lane to school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们沿着狭窄的小路去上学。
words.en: A lane is a narrow road, especially in the country. It can also refer to a division of a road intended to separate lines of traffic moving in the same or opposite directions.

words.ex: He saw an advertisement on TV.
words.ex_cn: 他在电视上看到一则广告。
words.en: An advertisement is a notice or announcement in a public medium promoting a product, service, or event or publicizing a job vacancy.

words.ex: The children are playing in their natural surroundings.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们正在他们的自然环境中玩耍。
words.en: The things and conditions around a person, place, or thing.

words.tr: phrase. 靠近中心铁路；在中心铁路附近
words.ex: The house is near the center railway.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子靠近中央铁路。
words.en: A location situated in the middle of a railway line or track.

words.ex: I wait for the bus at station 15.
words.ex_cn: 我在15号车站等公交车。
words.en: A station is a place where trains, buses, or other vehicles regularly stop so that people can get on or off, or where a particular activity or service is based.

words.tr: 短语. 离公交车站很远
words.ex: He lives far from the bus stop.
words.ex_cn: 他住得离公交站很远。
words.en: Situated at a considerable distance from the bus stop.

words.ex: The hotel is near the airport.
words.ex_cn: 这家酒店靠近机场。
words.en: Located close to the airport.

words.ex: The cabin is in a place where insects haunting the woods at night.
words.ex_cn: 小木屋位于夜晚有虫蚊出没的树林里。
words.en: Insects that are frequently present in a place, often causing annoyance or damage.

words.ex: He took out a mortgage to buy his first house.
words.ex_cn: 他申请了一笔抵押贷款来购买他的第一套房子。
words.en: A mortgage is a loan of money which you get from a bank or building society in order to buy a house.

words.tr: phrase. 个人财物；私人物品；随身物品
words.ex: He packed his personal belongings before leaving the hotel.
words.ex_cn: 他离开酒店前收拾了自己的个人物品。
words.en: Personal belongings refer to items that are owned by a particular person and are typically carried with them or kept in their personal space.

words.ex: The company is improving its recruitment process.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司正在改进它的招聘流程。
words.en: The process of finding and hiring new employees for a company or organization.

words.ex: He works in the sales department.
words.ex_cn: 他在销售部工作。
words.en: A department is one of the sections in an organization such as a government, business, or university.

words.ex: He went to a job fair to find work.
words.ex_cn: 他去参加招聘会找工作。
words.en: A job fair is an event where employers, recruiters, and schools give information to potential employees.

words.tr: n. 求职; v. 求职（job-hunt 的 ing 形式）
words.ex: He is job-hunting after graduation.
words.ex_cn: 他毕业后正在找工作。
words.en: The activity of trying to find a job.

words.tr: phrase. 面对面的面试；当面访谈
words.ex: I have a face-to-face interview tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我明天有一个面对面的面试。
words.en: A face-to-face interview is a meeting in which someone is asked questions to see if they are suitable for a job or course.

words.ex: His profession is a teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他的职业是教师。
words.en: A profession is a type of job that requires advanced education or training.

words.ex: He chose teaching as his vocation.
words.ex_cn: 他选择了教学作为自己的职业。
words.en: A vocation is a type of work that you feel you are especially suited to do and to which you give much of your time and energy.

words.ex: The occupation of the city by foreign troops lasted for years.
words.ex_cn: 外国军队对这座城市的占领持续了多年。
words.en: An occupation is a job or profession, or a way of spending your time.

words.tr: phrase. 永久职位；长期稳定的工作
words.ex: He wants a permanent job to support his family.
words.ex_cn: 他想要一份永久工作来养家。
words.en: A permanent job is a position that is intended to last indefinitely, as opposed to a temporary or contract position.

words.tr: phrase. 临时工作；短期职位
words.ex: He has a temporary job at the store.
words.ex_cn: 他在商店有一份临时工作。
words.en: A temporary job is work that lasts for a limited period of time, often until a particular project is completed or a permanent employee is found.

words.tr: adj. 兼职的；部分时间的
words.ex: He works part-time at a coffee shop.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家咖啡店做兼职。
words.en: If someone is a part-time worker or has a part-time job, they work for only part of each day or week.

words.tr: adj. 全部时间的；专任的
words.ex: He works full-time at a grocery store.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家杂货店全职工作。
words.en: If you are a full-time worker, you work the normal number of hours or days in a week.

words.tr: phrase. 白班；日班（指在白天工作的轮班）
words.ex: He works the day shift at the hospital.
words.ex_cn: 他在医院上白班。
words.en: A day shift refers to a period of time during the day, typically from early morning to late afternoon, when a person is scheduled to work.

words.ex: He works the evening shift at the hospital.
words.ex_cn: 他在医院上夜班。
words.en: The period of time during which a person works in the evening, typically from late afternoon to night.

words.tr: phrase. 夜班工作；夜间作业
words.ex: He does night work at the hospital.
words.ex_cn: 他在医院上夜班。
words.en: Work that is done during the night, often referring to jobs that require working overnight shifts.

words.ex: We eat lunch at midday.
words.ex_cn: 我们在中午吃午饭。
words.en: Midday is the middle part of the day, from noon until early afternoon.

words.ex: The applicant filled out the form carefully.
words.ex_cn: 这位申请人仔细填写了表格。
words.en: An applicant is someone who applies for something, especially a job.

words.ex: He is a candidate for the mayor position.
words.ex_cn: 他是市长职位的候选人。
words.en: A candidate is someone who is being considered for a position, for example someone who is running in an election or applying for a job.

words.ex: After a short break, he resumed his work.
words.ex_cn: 短暂休息后，他继续工作。
words.en: If you resume an activity or if it resumes, it begins again or continues after an interruption.

words.tr:
n. 合同；契约；
v. 收缩；
words.ex: They signed a contract to buy the house.
words.ex_cn: 他们签署了一份购买房子的合同。
words.en: A contract is a legal agreement between two or more parties. It can also mean to become smaller or tighter, or to catch a disease.

words.ex: There is a vacancy in the sales department.
words.ex_cn: 销售部门有一个空缺职位。
words.en: A vacancy is a position or job that is available for someone to fill.

words.ex: He stored the documents in a metal file.
words.ex_cn: 他把文件存放在一个金属档案盒里。
words.en: A file is a box or folded piece of heavy paper or plastic in which letters or documents are kept. As a verb, to file means to put documents in a file or to officially record something.

words.tr:
n. 标签；
v. 用标签标明；
words.ex: The bottle has a label with the name of the drink.
words.ex_cn: 瓶子上有一个写着饮料名称的标签。
words.en: A label is a piece of paper, polymer, cloth, metal, or other material affixed to a container or article, on which is written or printed information or symbols about the product or item.

words.ex: He asked his teacher for a reference letter.
words.ex_cn: 他请老师给他写一封推荐信。
words.en: A reference letter is a document in which the writer assesses the qualities, characteristics, and capabilities of the person being recommended in terms of that individual's ability to perform a particular task or function.

words.tr: phrase. 职业发展；事业进步
words.ex: He worked hard for his career advance.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作以促进职业发展。
words.en: Career advance refers to the progress or promotion in one's professional life, often through gaining new skills, experiences, or responsibilities.

words.tr: 短语动词. 逃离工作；摆脱工作压力
words.ex: He tries to escape from work by walking in the park.
words.ex_cn: 他通过在公园散步来逃避工作。
words.en: To avoid or get away from the duties or responsibilities of one's job or employment.

words.ex: The manager approved the new project.
words.ex_cn: 经理批准了新项目。
words.en: A manager is a person who is responsible for running part of or the whole of a business organization.

words.ex: The deputy manager helps the manager with daily tasks.
words.ex_cn: 副经理帮助经理处理日常事务。
words.en: A deputy manager is a person who is directly below a manager in rank and who is responsible for helping to manage a company, store, etc.

words.tr: phrase. 良好的视力；清晰的视觉
words.ex: He has good vision and doesn't need glasses.
words.ex_cn: 他有良好的视力，不需要戴眼镜。
words.en: The ability to see clearly and without visual impairment, sometimes a requirement for certain jobs.

words.ex: His eyesight is getting worse with age.
words.ex_cn: 他的视力随着年龄增长而变差。
words.en: Your eyesight is your ability to see.

words.tr: adj. 勤勉的；努力工作的
words.ex: He is hard-working and always finishes his homework on time.
words.ex_cn: 他很勤奋，总是按时完成作业。
words.en: Someone who is hard-working always puts a lot of effort and care into their work.

words.ex: He improves his problem-solving skills by doing math puzzles.
words.ex_cn: 他通过做数学谜题来提高解决问题的能力。
words.en: The ability to find solutions to difficult or complex issues.

words.ex: He is always punctual for class.
words.ex_cn: 他上课总是准时。
words.en: If you are punctual, you do something or arrive somewhere at the right time and are not late.

words.ex: The meeting has a variable time depending on the schedule.
words.ex_cn: 会议的时间根据安排而变化。
words.en: Has a time that is not fixed and can change or vary.

words.ex: They did a collaborative project in class.
words.ex_cn: 他们在课堂上做了一个合作项目。
words.en: A collaborative piece of work is done by two or more people or groups working together.

words.ex: He is a beginner in piano lessons.
words.ex_cn: 他是钢琴课的初学者。
words.en: A beginner is someone who has just started learning to do something and has not yet mastered it.

words.tr: phrase. + n. 高度训练有素的员工
words.ex: The hospital has highly-trained staff.
words.ex_cn: 这家医院有训练有素的员工。
words.en: Employees who have received extensive and specialized training.

words.ex: The designer created a new dress for the show.
words.ex_cn: 这位设计师为这场秀设计了一条新裙子。
words.en: A designer is a person who plans the form, structure, or appearance of something before it is made, by preparing drawings or plans.

words.ex: The driver stopped the car at the red light.
words.ex_cn: 司机在红灯处停了车。
words.en: A driver is a person who drives a vehicle.

words.ex: He is an architect who designs houses.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位设计房屋的建筑师。
words.en: An architect is a person who designs buildings and advises in their construction.

words.tr:
n. 教练；长途客运汽车；
v. 训练；培训；
words.ex: The coach taught the team how to win.
words.ex_cn: 教练教球队如何获胜。
words.en: A coach is someone who trains a person or team in a particular sport. It also refers to a large, comfortable bus that carries passengers on long journeys.

words.ex: The lawyer helps people with legal problems.
words.ex_cn: 律师帮助人们解决法律问题。
words.en: A lawyer is a person who is qualified to advise people about the law and represent them in court.

words.tr: n. 钢琴家；钢琴弹奏者；
words.ex: The pianist played a beautiful song at the concert.
words.ex_cn: 这位钢琴家在音乐会上演奏了一首美妙的曲子。
words.en: A pianist is a person who plays the piano, especially professionally.

words.ex: He is a piano player in a café.
words.ex_cn: 他是一家咖啡馆的钢琴演奏者。
words.en: A piano player is someone who plays the piano, either professionally or as a hobby.

words.tr: n. 小提琴手；小提琴演奏者；
words.ex: The violinist played a beautiful song at the concert.
words.ex_cn: 小提琴手在音乐会上演奏了一首优美的曲子。
words.en: A violinist is a person who plays the violin.

words.ex: He is a drummer in a rock band.
words.ex_cn: 他是摇滚乐队的一名鼓手。
words.en: A drummer is a person who plays a drum or drums.

words.tr: phrase. 弹吉他的人；吉他手
words.ex: He is a guitar player in a small band.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个小乐队的吉他手。
words.en: A person who plays the guitar, especially professionally.

words.ex: The reporter asked the president a difficult question.
words.ex_cn: 记者问了总统一个困难的问题。
words.en: A reporter is a person whose job is to discover information about news events and describe them for a newspaper, magazine, radio, or television.

words.ex: The receptionist greeted the visitors with a smile.
words.ex_cn: 接待员微笑着迎接了访客。
words.en: A receptionist is a person whose job is to deal with people arriving at or telephoning a hotel, office building, doctor's surgery, etc.

words.ex: He works as an accountant in a small company.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家小公司当会计师。
words.en: An accountant is a person whose job is to keep, inspect, and analyze financial accounts.

words.ex: The secretary types letters for the manager.
words.ex_cn: 秘书为经理打字。
words.en: A secretary is a person whose job is to do office work, such as typing letters, answering phone calls, and arranging meetings.

words.ex: The scientist studies stars in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 这位科学家研究夜空中的恒星。
words.en: A scientist is someone who has studied science and whose job is to teach or do research in science.

words.tr: adj. 自己经营的；个体经营的；非受雇于人的
words.ex: He is self-employed and works from home.
words.ex_cn: 他是自由职业者，在家工作。
words.en: Someone who is self-employed works for themselves rather than for an employer.

words.ex: The tailor made a new suit for the man.
words.ex_cn: 裁缝为这位男士做了一套新西装。
words.en: A tailor is a person whose job is to make men's clothes, especially suits, jackets, and trousers, that fit individual customers. As a verb, to tailor means to make or adapt something for a particular purpose or person.

words.ex: He is a computer programmer who writes code every day.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名计算机程序员，每天写代码。
words.en: A computer programmer is a person who writes computer programs.

words.tr: n.[计] 键盘输入，键盘作业
words.ex: He practices keyboarding every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天练习打字。
words.en: The skill or activity of typing on a keyboard.

words.ex: The technician fixed the broken machine.
words.ex_cn: 技术员修好了坏掉的机器。
words.en: A technician is a worker trained with special skills, especially in science or engineering.

words.ex: The translator helped him understand the French book.
words.ex_cn: 这位翻译员帮他理解了这本法语书。
words.en: A translator is a person whose job is translating writing or speech from one language to another.

words.ex: The hairdresser cut my hair nicely.
words.ex_cn: 理发师给我剪了一头漂亮的头发。
words.en: A hairdresser is a person who cuts, colours, and arranges people's hair, especially women's, as their job.

words.ex: He visits the dentist every six months.
words.ex_cn: 他每六个月去看一次牙医。
words.en: A dentist is a person who is qualified to treat diseases and conditions that affect the teeth and gums, especially the repair and extraction of teeth and the insertion of artificial ones.

words.ex: The veterinarian helps sick animals.
words.ex_cn: 兽医帮助生病的动物。
words.en: A veterinarian is a person who is qualified to treat sick or injured animals.

words.ex: The waiter brought us water and menus.
words.ex_cn: 服务员给我们端来了水和菜单。
words.en: A waiter is a man who works in a restaurant, serving people with food and drink.

words.ex: The waitress brought us water and menus.
words.ex_cn: 女服务员给我们端来了水和菜单。
words.en: A waitress is a woman who works in a restaurant, serving food and drink to customers.

words.tr: n. 男推销员；男售货员；
words.ex: The salesman showed us new phones.
words.ex_cn: 那位男推销员给我们展示了新手机。
words.en: A salesman is a man whose job is to sell things, especially directly to shops or other businesses on behalf of a company.

words.ex: The customer bought a new phone.
words.ex_cn: 这位客户买了一部新手机。
words.en: A customer is someone who buys goods or services from a shop or business.

words.tr:
n. 服务人员
adj. 随之而来的
words.ex: The attendant helped me find my seat.
words.ex_cn: 服务员帮我找到了座位。
words.en: An attendant is someone whose job is to serve or help people in a public place.

words.ex: He got a work permit to work in Canada.
words.ex_cn: 他获得了在加拿大工作的许可证。
words.en: A work permit is an official document giving someone the right to work in a particular country or area.

words.ex: He asked for permission to leave early.
words.ex_cn: 他请求允许早点离开。
words.en: If someone who has authority over you gives you permission to do something, they say that they will allow you to do it.

words.tr: n. 工作场所；工作地点；
words.ex: The new safety rules apply to the workplace.
words.ex_cn: 新的安全规则适用于工作场所。
words.en: A workplace is a place where people work, such as an office or factory.

words.ex: His status in the company is very high.
words.ex_cn: 他在公司里的地位很高。
words.en: The status of someone or something is their position or situation according to the law or according to other people's opinions.

words.ex: The guest arrived at the party early.
words.ex_cn: 客人早早到了派对。
words.en: A guest is someone who is visiting a place or attending an event by invitation, without having a permanent role there.

words.ex: He hangs his clothes on the line to dry.
words.ex_cn: 他把衣服挂在绳子上晾干。
words.en: Clothes are the things that people wear, such as shirts, coats, trousers, and dresses.

words.ex: She bought some cloth to make a dress.
words.ex_cn: 她买了一些布来做裙子。
words.en: Cloth is fabric which is made by weaving or knitting cotton, wool, silk, or other threads. Cloth is used especially for making clothes.

words.tr: adj. 随意的；非正式的；偶然的；
words.ex: He wore casual clothes to the party.
words.ex_cn: 他穿了随意的衣服去参加派对。
words.en: If you describe someone's attitude or behavior as casual, you mean they are not very concerned about what they are doing or what is happening around them, or they are not taking it seriously.

words.ex: She wore a red skirt to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一条红色短裙去参加派对。
words.en: A skirt is a piece of clothing that hangs from the waist and covers part or all of the legs. It can also refer to the edge or border of something, or to the act of moving along the edge of something.

words.ex: He wears blue jeans every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天穿蓝色牛仔裤。
words.en: Jeans are casual trousers made from denim or dungaree cloth.

words.ex: He buys sportswear for running.
words.ex_cn: 他买运动服来跑步。
words.en: Clothes worn for sport or for casual outdoor activities.

words.ex: He wears a warm sweater in winter.
words.ex_cn: 他冬天穿一件暖和的毛衣。
words.en: A sweater is a piece of clothing that you wear on the upper part of your body. It is usually made of wool or cotton and has long sleeves.

words.ex: He wears blue trousers to work.
words.ex_cn: 他上班穿蓝色的裤子。
words.en: Trousers are a piece of clothing that you wear over your body from the waist downwards, and that cover each leg separately.

words.tr:
adj. 一致的；统一的；
n. 制服；
words.ex: The students wear a uniform shirt to school.
words.ex_cn: 学生们穿一致的衬衫去学校。
words.en: A uniform is a special set of clothes which some people, for example soldiers or the police, wear to work in and which some children wear at school. It is also used to describe something that is the same in all parts and does not vary.

words.ex: He put the suitcase in the boot of the car.
words.ex_cn: 他把行李箱放进了汽车的后备箱里。
words.en: A boot is a type of shoe that covers the whole foot and the lower part of the leg. It can also mean to kick something forcefully or to start a computer.

words.ex: He wore a funny costume for the party.
words.ex_cn: 他为派对穿了一套滑稽的服装。
words.en: A costume is a set of clothes in a style typical of a particular country or historical period, or a set of clothes worn by an actor for a particular role.

words.tr:
v. 适合；相配；
n. 套装；西装；诉讼；
words.ex: This color suits her well.
words.ex_cn: 这个颜色很适合她。
words.en: A suit is a set of clothes made from the same fabric, usually consisting of a jacket and trousers or a skirt. As a verb, to suit means to be appropriate or acceptable for someone or something.

words.ex: He ties his shoelaces before running.
words.ex_cn: 他在跑步前系鞋带。
words.en: To fasten or secure with or as if with a cord, rope, or strap.

words.tr: n. 宽松的女短衫；女衬衫
words.ex: She wears a white blouse to work.
words.ex_cn: 她上班穿一件白色上衣。
words.en: A blouse is a piece of clothing for women, which covers their body from the neck to the waist or slightly below, and which usually has long sleeves and buttons down the front.

words.ex: He put on his shoe before going out.
words.ex_cn: 他出门前穿上了鞋子。
words.en: A shoe is a covering for the foot, typically made of leather, having a sturdy sole and not reaching above the ankle.

words.ex: She wore sandals to the beach.
words.ex_cn: 她穿着凉鞋去海滩。
words.en: A sandal is a type of light shoe that you wear in warm weather, which has straps that go over your foot and around your ankle.

words.ex: He put on his jacket before going out.
words.ex_cn: 他出门前穿上了夹克。
words.en: A jacket is a short coat with long sleeves.

words.ex: He keeps spare socks in his drawer.
words.ex_cn: 他把备用袜子放在抽屉里。
words.en: Spare socks are extra socks that you keep with you in case you need to change your socks.

words.ex: He wears a black shirt every Monday.
words.ex_cn: 他每个星期一都穿一件黑色衬衫。
words.en: A black shirt is a piece of clothing, typically made of cotton or a similar fabric, that covers the upper part of the body and is black in color.

words.ex: He wore a white waistcoat with his suit.
words.ex_cn: 他穿着一件白色背心搭配西装。
words.en: A waistcoat is a sleeveless garment that buttons down the front, typically worn over a shirt and under a jacket as part of a man's formal or business attire.

words.ex: The printer is out of paper.
words.ex_cn: 打印机没有纸了。
words.en: A printer is a machine that can be connected to a computer in order to make copies on paper of documents or other information held by the computer.

words.ex: He spilled ink on his shirt.
words.ex_cn: 他把墨水洒在了衬衫上。
words.en: Ink is the colored liquid used for writing, printing, or drawing.

words.tr: 复印机：一种用于复制文件、图片等纸质资料的机器，通过光学技术将原始文件扫描并打印到另一张纸上。
words.ex: He used the photo copier to make a copy of his ID.
words.ex_cn: 他用复印机复印了他的身份证。
words.en: A machine that copies documents by scanning and printing them, often used in offices.

words.tr: phrase. 年假；每年享有的带薪休假
words.ex: He took his annual leave last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周休了年假。
words.en: Annual leave refers to the paid time off work that employees are entitled to by law or by their employment contract, typically used for rest, travel, or personal matters.

words.ex: He showed great capability in solving math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他在解决数学问题上展现了很强的能力。
words.en: The ability or qualities necessary to do something.

words.ex: The school has a strict dress code.
words.ex_cn: 学校有严格的着装规定。
words.en: A set of rules specifying the attire that is appropriate for a particular place or event.

words.ex: He works hard during his workday.
words.ex_cn: 他在工作日努力工作。
words.en: A workday is a day on which people go to work.

words.tr: n. 工作日（周一至周五中的任何一天）
words.ex: He goes to work every weekday.
words.ex_cn: 他每个工作日都去上班。
words.en: A weekday is any of the days from Monday to Friday, when most people go to work or school.

words.ex: He has a day off on Friday.
words.ex_cn: 他星期五休息一天。
words.en: A day off is a day when you do not go to work or school, especially because you have a holiday or because you need or want to rest.

words.tr: phrase. 休假；休息时间；请假
words.ex: He asked for time off to visit his family.
words.ex_cn: 他请假去探望家人。
words.en: Time off refers to a period of time that someone is allowed to be away from their work or duties, often for rest or vacation.

words.tr: phrase. 农场劳动；农业工作
words.ex: He does farm work every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上干农活。
words.en: Work done on a farm, such as planting, harvesting, and caring for animals.

words.ex: He works as a programmer because it offers good pay.
words.ex_cn: 他做程序员，因为这份工作报酬优厚。
words.en: Good pay refers to a salary or wage that is considered high or above average, often used to describe jobs or positions that offer financial compensation significantly higher than the norm.

words.tr: phrase. 家庭清洁服务；房屋清扫服务
words.ex: They hired a house-cleaning service for Saturday.
words.ex_cn: 他们为周六雇了一家家政清洁服务。
words.en: A professional service for cleaning homes.

words.ex: She does housekeeping every Saturday.
words.ex_cn: 她每个星期六做家务。
words.en: Housekeeping refers to the management of duties and chores involved in the running of a household, such as cleaning, cooking, home maintenance, shopping, and bill payment.

words.ex: The bonus is an incentive to work harder.
words.ex_cn: 奖金是努力工作的动机。
words.en: Something that encourages a person to do something or to work harder.

words.ex: His income is enough to pay for rent and food.
words.ex_cn: 他的收入足以支付房租和食物。
words.en: Income is the money that a person or a company earns regularly, for example from investment or work.

words.ex: He wants job security because he has a family to support.
words.ex_cn: 他想要工作保障，因为他要养家。
words.en: Job security refers to the probability that an individual will keep their job; a job with a high level of job security is one with a low risk of unemployment.

words.ex: He wears a name badge at work.
words.ex_cn: 他在工作中佩戴姓名牌。
words.en: A name badge is a small card or label that you wear, which shows your name and sometimes your job title or the organization you belong to.

words.ex: The notice board has a new message.
words.ex_cn: 公告板上有一条新消息。
words.en: A board on which notices are posted; a bulletin board.

words.ex: His job has many perks, like free lunch and flexible hours.
words.ex_cn: 他的工作有很多福利，比如免费午餐和弹性工作时间。
words.en: Perks are extra benefits or advantages that you get in addition to your salary or wages, often as part of your job.

words.ex: The new policy is for the promotion of clean energy.
words.ex_cn: 这项新政策是为了促进清洁能源。
words.en: A promotion is a move to a more important job or rank in a company or organization.

words.ex: The prospect of a better job makes him happy.
words.ex_cn: 更好工作的前景让他感到高兴。
words.en: A prospect is the possibility that something will happen, or a view of a wide area.

words.tr: phrase. 销售佣金；销售提成
words.ex: He earns sales commission from every product he sells.
words.ex_cn: 他每卖出一件产品就获得销售提成。
words.en: A sales commission is a sum of money paid to an agent in a commercial transaction, calculated as a percentage of the sale.

words.ex: His starting salary is $30,000 per year.
words.ex_cn: 他的起薪是每年3万美元。
words.en: The initial amount of money that an employee is paid when they start a new job.

words.tr: phrase. 基本工资；基本薪酬
words.ex: His base salary is 3000 dollars per month.
words.ex_cn: 他的基本工资是每月3000美元。
words.en: The fixed amount of money that an employee is paid each year, not including any extra payments.

words.tr: phrase. 职业课程；职业技能培训课程
words.ex: He is taking a vocational course in car repair.
words.ex_cn: 他正在参加一门汽车维修的职业课程。
words.en: A vocational course is a type of education that focuses on providing practical skills and knowledge for a specific job or career.

words.tr: n. 培训；训练；锻炼； v. “train”的现在分词；
words.ex: The company provided free training for new employees.
words.ex_cn: 公司为新员工提供了免费培训。
words.en: The process of learning the skills you need to do a particular job or activity.

words.ex: The school had a fire drill this morning.
words.ex_cn: 学校今天早上进行了消防演习。
words.en: A fire drill is a practice of the emergency procedures to be used in case of fire.

words.ex: He receives his wages every Friday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周五领工资。
words.en: Wages are the money that someone is paid each week by their employer, especially for work that is done manually or in a factory.

words.tr: phrase. 工作表现；工作绩效
words.ex: His work performance improved last month.
words.ex_cn: 他上个月的工作表现提高了。
words.en: The manner in which a job is executed or the level of achievement in a job role.

words.ex: The government made a new regulation to control pollution.
words.ex_cn: 政府出台了一项新管理措施来控制污染。
words.en: A regulation is an official rule or order.

words.tr:
adj. 相对的；相关联的；
n. 亲戚；
words.ex: His success is relative to his hard work.
words.ex_cn: 他的成功是相对于他的努力而言的。
words.en: A relative is someone who is part of your family. Parents, siblings, uncles, aunts, grandparents, cousins, nieces and nephews — they're all relatives.

words.tr: n. 夫或妻的兄弟；姐夫；妹夫；连襟；姻兄弟
words.ex: My brother-in-law works at a hospital.
words.ex_cn: 我的姐夫/妹夫在医院工作。
words.en: The brother of your husband or wife, or the man who is married to your sister.

words.tr: n. 夫或妻的姐妹；小姑子；小姨子；嫂；弟媳
words.ex: My sister-in-law lives next door.
words.ex_cn: 我的嫂子/小姑子住在隔壁。
words.en: A sister-in-law is the sister of your husband or wife, or the wife of your brother.

words.ex: My mother-in-law lives next door.
words.ex_cn: 我的岳母住在隔壁。
words.en: The mother of one's spouse.

words.ex: My father-in-law gave me advice about cars.
words.ex_cn: 我的岳父给了我关于汽车的建议。
words.en: The father of one's spouse.

words.ex: My son-in-law works at a hospital.
words.ex_cn: 我的女婿在一家医院工作。
words.en: A son-in-law is the husband of your daughter.

words.ex: My daughter-in-law is coming to dinner tonight.
words.ex_cn: 我的儿媳今晚要来吃晚饭。
words.en: Your daughter-in-law is the wife of your son.

words.tr: n. 叔父；伯父；舅父；姑父；姨父；
words.ex: My uncle works at a local bank.
words.ex_cn: 我的叔父在当地一家银行工作。
words.en: The brother of someone's father or mother, or the husband of someone's aunt.

words.ex: My aunt bought me a birthday gift.
words.ex_cn: 我姨给我买了一份生日礼物。
words.en: The sister of your father or mother, or the wife of your uncle.

words.ex: My brother's son is my nephew.
words.ex_cn: 我弟弟的儿子是我的侄子。
words.en: A nephew is a son of one's sibling or sibling-in-law.

words.ex: My sister's daughter is my niece.
words.ex_cn: 我妹妹的女儿是我的侄女。
words.en: Someone's niece is the daughter of their sister or brother.

words.ex: My grandfather tells stories every evening.
words.ex_cn: 我的祖父每天晚上都讲故事。
words.en: The father of one's father or mother.

words.tr: n. 表兄弟（或姐妹）；堂兄弟（或姐妹）；
words.ex: My cousin plays soccer with me every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我的表兄弟每周六都和我一起踢足球。
words.en: A cousin is a child of your uncle or aunt.

words.ex: Her stepmother gave her a birthday gift.
words.ex_cn: 她的继母送了她一份生日礼物。
words.en: A stepmother is a woman who is married to one's father after the divorce or death of one's mother.

words.tr:
n. 运输；
v. 运输；
words.ex: He uses public transport to go to work.
words.ex_cn: 他乘坐公共交通去上班。
words.en: To transport something or someone is to move them from one place to another, especially over long distances.

words.tr:
n. 冲；匆忙；
v. 冲；赶忙做；
words.ex: There was a rush to buy tickets for the concert.
words.ex_cn: 人们争相购买演唱会的票。
words.en: If you rush somewhere, you go there quickly. A rush is a situation in which you need to go somewhere or do something very quickly.

words.tr: phrase. 帐篷旅行；大篷车旅行；房车旅游
words.ex: We went on a caravan tour through the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 我们进行了一次帐篷旅行，穿越了山脉。
words.en: A caravan tour refers to a journey or trip made in a caravan, typically for leisure or vacation purposes, allowing travelers to explore various destinations while living in their mobile accommodation.

words.tr: n. 车辆；交通工具；媒介；
words.ex: The vehicle stopped at the red light.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车在红灯前停了下来。
words.en: A vehicle is a machine such as a car, bus, or truck which has an engine and is used to carry people or goods from place to place.

words.ex: The helicopter flew over the city.
words.ex_cn: 直升机飞过了城市。
words.en: A helicopter is a type of aircraft that derives both lift and propulsion from one or more sets of horizontally revolving overhead rotors. It is capable of moving vertically and horizontally, the direction of motion being controlled by the pitch of the rotor blades.

words.tr:
n. 火车；列车；列；队；
v. 训练；培训；
words.ex: I took the train to work this morning.
words.ex_cn: 今天早上我坐火车去上班。
words.en: A train is a number of carriages or trucks which are all connected together and which are pulled by an engine along a railway. Train also means to teach someone the skills of a particular job or activity, or to be taught these skills.

words.ex: The traffic on the highway was very heavy this morning.
words.ex_cn: 今天早上高速公路上的交通非常拥堵。
words.en: Traffic refers to the movement of vehicles or people along roads, or to the movement of aircraft, ships, or trains. It can also refer to the trade or exchange of goods or services, especially illegal ones.

words.ex: He takes the tram to work every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上乘电车上班。
words.en: A tram is a vehicle that is used for public transportation in cities and towns, running on tracks laid in the streets.

words.ex: The truck carried boxes to the store.
words.ex_cn: 卡车把箱子运到了商店。
words.en: A truck is a large vehicle that is used to transport goods by road.

words.ex: Traffic congestion caused delays on the highway.
words.ex_cn: 交通堵塞导致了高速公路的延误。
words.en: Congestion refers to the state of being overcrowded, especially with traffic or people, or the condition of being blocked or clogged.

words.ex: The car has four wheels.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车有四个车轮。
words.en: A wheel is a circular object that revolves on an axle and is fixed below a vehicle or other object to enable it to move easily over the ground.

words.ex: We took the ferry to cross the river.
words.ex_cn: 我们乘渡船过河。
words.en: A ferry is a boat that transports passengers and sometimes also vehicles, usually across rivers or short stretches of sea.

words.ex: They sailed on a yacht during their vacation.
words.ex_cn: 他们在假期乘游艇航行。
words.en: A yacht is a medium-sized sailboat used for racing or cruising.

words.tr:
n. 教练；长途客运汽车；
v. 训练；培训；
words.ex: The coach taught the team how to win.
words.ex_cn: 教练教球队如何获胜。
words.en: A coach is someone who trains a person or team in a particular sport. It also refers to a large, comfortable bus that carries passengers on long journeys.

words.ex: He rides his bicycle to school every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天骑自行车去上学。
words.en: A bicycle is a vehicle with two wheels which you ride by sitting on it and pushing two pedals with your feet.

words.ex: He took a taxicab to the airport.
words.ex_cn: 他打了一辆出租车去机场。
words.en: A taxicab is a car driven by a person whose job is to take passengers where they want to go in return for money.

words.ex: He pushed the trolley to carry the groceries.
words.ex_cn: 他推着手推车来搬购物品。
words.en: A trolley is a small vehicle with wheels that can be pushed or pulled along and is used for carrying things.

words.ex: The tourists rode the cable car up the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 游客们乘坐缆车上了山。
words.en: A cable car is a vehicle that is pulled by a moving cable and is used for transporting people up and down mountains.

words.tr:
v. 行走；
n. 步行；
words.ex: I walk to school every day.
words.ex_cn: 我每天步行去学校。
words.en: To move along on foot at a moderate pace; to go on foot for pleasure or exercise.

words.ex: The farmer drives a tractor in the field.
words.ex_cn: 农夫在田里开拖拉机。
words.en: A tractor is a powerful motor vehicle with large rear wheels, used chiefly on farms for hauling equipment and trailers.

words.ex: He rides a motorcycle to work every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天骑摩托车去上班。
words.en: A motorcycle is a vehicle with two wheels and an engine.

words.tr:
n. 循环；周期；自行车；
v. 骑自行车；循环；
words.ex: The water cycle is important for nature.
words.ex_cn: 水循环对自然界很重要。
words.en: A cycle is a series of events that are regularly repeated in the same order or a bicycle.

words.tr: phrase. 长途飞行；长距离航班
words.ex: He took a long-distance flight to Australia.
words.ex_cn: 他乘坐了一趟长途航班去澳大利亚。
words.en: A long-distance flight refers to a flight that covers a great distance, typically between continents or across large countries.

words.tr: n. 小巴；小型公共汽车；
words.ex: The children took the minibus to school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们坐小巴去学校。
words.en: A minibus is a small bus, usually one that carries fewer than twenty passengers.

words.ex: They drive a minivan to take the kids to school.
words.ex_cn: 他们开一辆小型货车送孩子们上学。
words.en: A minivan is a vehicle designed for carrying passengers, which is smaller than a full-size van but larger than a compact car.

words.ex: The ship arrived at the dock at sunrise.
words.ex_cn: 船在日出时到达了码头。
words.en: A dock is an enclosed area of water in a port where ships go to be loaded, unloaded, and repaired.

words.ex: The express train arrives in 10 minutes.
words.ex_cn: 特快列车10分钟后到达。
words.en: An express train is a fast train that stops at few stations and is intended for passengers who wish to travel quickly between major cities.

words.tr: n. [英]地铁；管子；管状物；电视机；
words.ex: I take the tube to work every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我每天早上乘地铁去上班。
words.en: A tube is a long, hollow cylinder used for conveying or holding liquids or gases.

words.tr: phrase. 机场班车；航空港往返接送巴士
words.ex: The air shuttle bus takes passengers to the terminal.
words.ex_cn: 机场接驳巴士将乘客送往航站楼。
words.en: A bus service that operates between an airport and a city center or between terminals within an airport, typically offering frequent departures.

words.tr:
n. 光；灯；光线；
adj. 轻的；浅的；少量的；明亮的；
v. 点燃；照亮；
words.ex: The light from the window brightened the room.
words.ex_cn: 窗户透进来的光让房间变亮了。
words.en: Light is the natural agent that stimulates sight and makes things visible. It is also used to describe something that is not heavy or a source of illumination.

words.ex: The train runs on the railway.
words.ex_cn: 火车在铁轨上行驶。
words.en: A railway is a route between two places along which trains travel on steel rails.

words.tr:
adj. 地下的；
n. 地铁；地下；
adv. 在地下；
words.ex: The underground tunnel connects two buildings.
words.ex_cn: 这条地下的隧道连接了两座建筑。
words.en: Something that is underground is below the surface of the ground. It can also refer to secret activities or organizations.

words.ex: He uses a wheelchair to move around.
words.ex_cn: 他使用轮椅来移动。
words.en: A wheelchair is a chair with wheels, used by people who cannot walk because of illness, injury, or disability.

words.ex: A hammer is a useful tool for fixing things.
words.ex_cn: 锤子是修理东西的有用工具。
words.en: A tool is any instrument or simple piece of equipment that you hold in your hands and use to do a particular kind of work.

words.tr:
n. 塔；塔楼；
v. 高耸；
words.ex: The tower stands tall in the center of the city.
words.ex_cn: 这座塔矗立在城市中心。
words.en: A tower is a tall, narrow building, either part of a larger building such as a church or castle, or standing alone.

words.ex: They slept in a tent during the camping trip.
words.ex_cn: 他们在露营时睡在帐篷里。
words.en: A tent is a portable shelter made of fabric or other material stretched over a supporting framework of poles and usually stabilized or secured to the ground with cords and stakes.

words.ex: The government made a new regulation to control pollution.
words.ex_cn: 政府出台了一项新管理措施来控制污染。
words.en: A regulation is an official rule or order.

words.ex: Watching movies is a popular entertainment.
words.ex_cn: 看电影是一种流行的休闲娱乐。
words.en: Entertainment refers to performances or activities that are intended to amuse or interest an audience.

words.tr: adj. 充满智慧的；明智的；英明的；
words.ex: The wise old man gave good advice.
words.ex_cn: 这位充满智慧的老人给出了很好的建议。
words.en: If you describe someone as wise, you mean that they have experience, knowledge, and good judgment.

words.ex: It is advisable to wear a helmet when riding a bike.
words.ex_cn: 骑自行车时戴头盔是明智的。
words.en: If something is advisable, it will avoid problems if you do it.

words.ex: The river is dangerous for children.
words.ex_cn: 这条河对孩子来说很危险。
words.en: If something is dangerous, it is able or likely to hurt or harm you.

words.ex: The chemicals are hazardous to health.
words.ex_cn: 这些化学物质对健康有危险。
words.en: Something that is hazardous is dangerous, especially to people's health or safety.

words.ex: The agency helps people find jobs.
words.ex_cn: 这个机构帮助人们找工作。
words.en: An agency is a business which provides a service on behalf of other businesses.

words.ex: The boy found a fossil in the rock.
words.ex_cn: 男孩在岩石中发现了一块化石。
words.en: A fossil is the remains or impression of a prehistoric organism preserved in petrified form or as a mold or cast in rock.

words.tr: n. 矿物；矿物质；“mineral”的复数；
words.ex: Rock contains many minerals like quartz and feldspar.
words.ex_cn: 岩石中含有许多矿物，如石英和长石。
words.en: Minerals are solid substances that are formed naturally in the earth and are not of animal or vegetable origin.

words.ex: The dog buried a bone in the garden.
words.ex_cn: 狗把一根骨头埋在了花园里。
words.en: The hard, rigid form of connective tissue constituting most of the skeleton of vertebrates, composed chiefly of calcium salts.

words.tr: v. 埋葬；埋藏；“bury”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 埋在地下的；
words.ex: They buried the dog in the backyard.
words.ex_cn: 他们把狗埋在了后院里。
words.en: If something is buried, it is placed in a hole in the ground and covered with earth, or it is hidden or concealed in some way.

words.ex: Rivers carry sediment to the sea.
words.ex_cn: 河流把沉积物带到大海。
words.en: Material that settles to the bottom of a liquid; matter that has been deposited by some natural process.

words.ex: He reads books in his leisure.
words.ex_cn: 他在空闲时间读书。
