words.ex_cn: 他住在没有大商店的农村村庄里。
words.en: Rural areas are areas which are not towns or cities. They are often farming or agricultural areas.

words.ex: The teacher gave us a math assignment.
words.ex_cn: 老师给我们布置了一份数学作业。
words.en: An assignment is a task or piece of work that you are given to do, especially as part of your job or studies.

words.ex: The children played in the natural park.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在自然公园里玩耍。
words.en: Existing in or caused by nature; not made or caused by humankind.

words.tr: n. 气体；气态；汽油；天然气；煤气；
words.ex: Oxygen is a gas that we need to breathe.
words.ex_cn: 氧气是一种我们呼吸所需的气体。
words.en: Gas is a substance like air that is neither liquid nor solid and burns easily. It is used as a fuel for cooking and heating.

words.ex: We made an arrangement to meet at 6 p.m.
words.ex_cn: 我们安排好晚上六点见面。
words.en: An arrangement is a plan or preparation which you make so that something can happen.

words.ex: The park has ramps for wheelchairs.
words.ex_cn: 这个公园有供轮椅使用的坡道。
words.en: A wheelchair is a chair with wheels, used when walking is difficult or impossible due to illness, injury, or disability.

words.ex: He ate a potato for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午餐吃了一个土豆。
words.en: A potato is a round vegetable that grows underground and has white flesh with a brown, red, or yellow skin.

words.ex: She added a tomato to her salad.
words.ex_cn: 她往沙拉里加了一个西红柿。
words.en: A tomato is a soft, red fruit that is eaten raw or cooked as a vegetable.

words.ex: He eats a carrot every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天吃一根胡萝卜。
words.en: A carrot is a long, thin, orange-colored vegetable that grows underground.

words.ex: He eats a banana every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上吃一根香蕉。
words.en: A banana is a long curved fruit with a yellow skin and soft, sweet, white flesh inside.

words.ex: The layout of the room makes it feel bigger.
words.ex_cn: 房间的布局让它显得更大。
words.en: The way in which the parts of something are arranged or laid out.

words.ex: He made a correction to his answer.
words.ex_cn: 他改正了他的答案。
words.en: A correction is a change that makes something right, accurate, or better.

words.ex: He invests money in stocks.
words.ex_cn: 他投资股票。
words.en: If you invest in something, or if you invest a sum of money, you use your money in a way that you hope will increase its value, for example by putting it in a bank, or buying shares or property.

words.ex: The location of the store is near the park.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店的位置在公园附近。
words.en: A location is the place where something happens or is situated.

words.ex: The toys are in the basement.
words.ex_cn: 玩具在地下室里。
words.en: The basement of a building is a room or area that is partly or completely below ground level.

words.tr: n. 代码；编码；行为准则；密码；法典；
words.ex: He wrote a simple code to solve the math problem.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一段简单的代码来解决这个数学问题。
words.en: A code is a system of words, letters, figures, or other symbols substituted for other words, letters, etc., especially for the purposes of secrecy. As a verb, it means to convert (a message or other information) into a code.

words.ex: He put up a poster on the wall.
words.ex_cn: 他把一张海报贴在墙上。
words.en: A poster is a large notice or picture that you stick on a wall or board, often in order to advertise something.

words.ex: She put the apples in a basket.
words.ex_cn: 她把苹果放进了一个篮子里。
words.en: A basket is a container which is usually made of stiff fibers, such as rushes, straw, or thin strips of wood, and is used for carrying or storing things.

words.tr: adj. 拥挤的；密集的； v. “crowd”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The bus was crowded during rush hour.
words.ex_cn: 高峰时段公交车很拥挤。
words.en: If a place is crowded, it is full of people.

words.ex: The deputy signed the document for the manager.
words.ex_cn: 代理人替经理签署了文件。
words.en: A deputy is a person who is appointed to act as a substitute for another, especially in a position of authority.

words.ex: The global climate conference was held in Paris.
words.ex_cn: 全球气候大会在巴黎举行。
words.en: A conference is a meeting of people who share the same interests or profession.

words.ex: A sliver of wood stuck in his finger.
words.ex_cn: 一小片木头扎进了他的手指。
words.en: A sliver is a small, thin piece of something that has been cut, broken, or torn off from a larger piece.

words.ex: He lost his wallet on the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他在公交车上丢了钱包。
words.en: A wallet is a small flat folding case made of leather or plastic, in which you can keep banknotes, credit cards, and other small flat objects.

words.ex: He took the elevator to the 10th floor.
words.ex_cn: 他乘电梯上了十楼。
words.en: An elevator is a device that moves people or goods up and down inside a building.

words.ex: He works at a small college.
words.ex_cn: 他在一所小型学院工作。
words.en: A college is an institution where students study after they have left school, in order to get a degree or qualification.

words.tr:
n. 奖赏；奖品；奖金；
v. 珍视；
words.ex: He won a prize for the best science project.
words.ex_cn: 他因最好的科学项目获得了奖赏。
words.en: A prize is something valuable, such as money or a trophy, that is given to someone who wins a competition or who has done outstanding work.

words.ex: He drank water from a cup.
words.ex_cn: 他从杯子里喝水。
words.en: A cup is a small round container that you drink from. Cups usually have handles and are made from china or plastic.

words.ex: The boy picked up a piece of rubber from the floor.
words.ex_cn: 男孩从地上捡起一块橡胶。
words.en: Rubber is a strong, waterproof, elastic substance made from the juice of some tropical plants or artificially. It is used for making tires, boots, and many other products.

words.ex: She has excellent night vision.
words.ex_cn: 她有很好的夜视能力。
words.en: Vision is the ability to see, the area that you can see, the ability to imagine how a country, society, industry, etc. could develop in the future and to plan in a suitable way, or an experience in which you see something that is not really there.

words.ex: Sharks live in the deep ocean.
words.ex_cn: 鲨鱼生活在深海中。
words.en: Sharks are a group of elasmobranch fish characterized by a cartilaginous skeleton, five to seven gill slits on the sides of the head, and pectoral fins that are not fused to the head.

words.ex: The lake is covered with ice in winter.
words.ex_cn: 冬天湖面结满了冰。
words.en: Ice is frozen water. It is a solid state of water that occurs when water freezes at or below 0 degrees Celsius.

words.tr:
v. 包装；收拾行李；
n. 包裹；小包；
words.ex: She packs the gift in colorful paper.
words.ex_cn: 她用彩纸包装礼物。
words.en: A pack is a container of a particular kind, especially one made of strong paper or plastic and containing a number of the same items. As a verb, pack means to put something into a container, especially in a neat and efficient way.

words.tr: n. 练习；锻炼；行使；“exercise”的复数； v. 使用；
words.ex: He does morning exercises every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天做晨练。
words.en: Physical or mental activity that you do to stay healthy or become stronger.

words.tr:
v. 粘附；（随意）放置；忍受；
n. 棍枝；条状物；球棍；
words.ex: The glue makes the paper stick to the table.
words.ex_cn: 胶水使纸粘在桌子上。
words.en: A stick is a thin branch which has fallen off a tree. If you stick something somewhere, you put it there in a rather casual way.

words.ex: The car has a strong engine.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车有一个强劲的发动机。
words.en: An engine is a machine that converts energy into mechanical force and motion.

words.ex: The river is dangerous for children.
words.ex_cn: 这条河对孩子来说很危险。
words.en: If something is dangerous, it is able or likely to hurt or harm you.

words.ex: The two dogs are similar in color.
words.ex_cn: 这两只狗的颜色很相似。
words.en: If one thing is similar to another, or if two things are similar, they have features that are the same.

words.ex: They have a good relationship with their neighbors.
words.ex_cn: 他们和邻居关系很好。
words.en: A relationship is the way in which two or more people or things are connected, or the state of being connected.

words.ex: Children love to watch insects in the garden.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们喜欢在花园里观察昆虫。
words.en: Insects are small creatures such as flies, ants, and bees that have six legs, a body divided into three parts, and often one or two pairs of wings.

words.ex: You need to pay a 40-yuan deposit to rent the bike.
words.ex_cn: 租自行车需要支付40元押金。
words.en: A deposit is a sum of money which is part of the full price of something, and which you pay when you agree to buy it. It is also a sum of money that you pay into a bank account.

words.ex: His interests include reading and painting.
words.ex_cn: 他的兴趣包括阅读和绘画。
words.en: Interests refers to the feeling of wanting to know or learn about something or someone, or activities that you enjoy doing in your spare time.

words.ex: The students asked their advisors for help with their projects.
words.ex_cn: 学生们向他们的顾问寻求项目帮助。
words.en: Advisors are people who give advice, especially someone whose job is to give advice on a particular subject.

words.ex: The door opens automatically when you get close.
words.ex_cn: 当你靠近时，门会自动打开。
words.en: If something happens automatically, it happens as a part of the normal process or system, without needing to be started by someone.

words.ex: He got a driver's license last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周拿到了驾照。
words.en: A license is an official document which gives you permission to do, use, or own something.

words.ex: The dove is a symbol of peace.
words.ex_cn: 鸽子是和平的象征。
words.en: Symbols are marks or signs that represent something else, such as an idea, a quality, or a relationship.

words.ex: He listens to music with headphones.
words.ex_cn: 他用耳机听音乐。
words.en: Headphones are a pair of small speakers that you wear over your ears in order to listen to music or other sounds without other people hearing them.

words.ex: He ate popcorn made from corn.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了用玉米做的爆米花。
words.en: Corn is a tall plant which produces long vegetables covered with yellow seeds. It is also a cereal crop.

words.tr:
n. 最小值；
adj. 最小量的；
words.ex: The minimum of the function is 5.
words.ex_cn: 这个函数的最小值是5。
words.en: The minimum is the smallest or least amount possible or allowed.

words.ex: The tree produces a sticky gum.
words.ex_cn: 这棵树分泌出一种粘稠的树胶。
words.en: Gum refers to the firm area of flesh in the mouth to which the teeth are attached, or a type of sweet, flavored, synthetic rubber which is chewed for pleasure.

words.ex: He wants to study medicine at university.
words.ex_cn: 他想在大学学习医学。
words.en: Medicine is the science or practice of the diagnosis, treatment, and prevention of disease.

words.tr: n. 时间表；时刻表；课程表；
words.ex: The school publishes a new timetable every term.
words.ex_cn: 学校每学期都会公布新的时间表。
words.en: A timetable is a detailed plan showing the times at which things are intended to happen, especially the times at which particular events or activities are planned to occur.

words.ex: He put his head on the pillow and fell asleep.
words.ex_cn: 他把头放在枕头上，睡着了。
words.en: A pillow is a cushion that you rest your head on when you are in bed.

words.ex: Last month's rainfall was very low.
words.ex_cn: 上个月的降雨量非常少。
words.en: Rainfall is the amount of rain that falls in a particular area during a particular period.

words.ex: The coastal village has beautiful beaches.
words.ex_cn: 这个沿海村庄有美丽的海滩。
words.en: relating to the coast, the area where the land meets the sea

words.ex: A spider is crawling on the wall.
words.ex_cn: 一只蜘蛛正在墙上爬。
words.en: A spider is a small creature with eight legs and a body divided into two parts, which spins webs to catch insects for food.

words.ex: The children play near the fountain in the park.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在公园的喷泉附近玩耍。
words.en: A fountain is a structure that squirts water into the air to create a visual or auditory effect, or a natural source of water.

words.tr:
n. 平衡；天平；秤；
v. （使）相抵；（使）平衡；
words.ex: She maintains a good balance between work and rest.
words.ex_cn: 她在工作和休息之间保持良好的平衡。
words.en: Balance is the ability to remain steady when you are standing up. Also, it refers to the state of having your weight spread equally so that you do not fall. In finance, it refers to the amount of money you have in a bank account.

words.tr:
n. 潜水；跳水；暴跌；
v. 潜水；跳水；暴跌；
words.ex: He went for a dive in the sea.
words.ex_cn: 他去海里潜水。
words.en: If you dive into water, you jump in head-first with your arms held straight above your head. Dive is also a noun.

words.tr: n. 雕刻（术）；雕塑品；雕刻品；
words.ex: He made a beautiful sculpture from clay.
words.ex_cn: 他用黏土做了一件精美的雕刻。
words.en: Sculpture is the art of making two- or three-dimensional representative or abstract forms, especially by carving stone or wood or by casting metal or plaster.

words.tr:
n. 商店；店铺；仓库；储存；
v. 贮藏；存储；
words.ex: I bought milk at the store.
words.ex_cn: 我在商店买了牛奶。
words.en: A store is a building or part of a building where things are sold. In British English, a store is a large shop that sells many different kinds of goods. In American English, a store is any kind of shop.

words.ex: He spilled powder on the floor.
words.ex_cn: 他把粉末撒在了地上。
words.en: A powder is a dry substance made up of very small particles. It can be used for various purposes, including cosmetics, cleaning, and cooking. As a verb, to powder means to apply or cover something with powder.

words.ex: Eating vegetables gives you good nutrition.
words.ex_cn: 吃蔬菜能提供良好的营养。
words.en: The process of providing or obtaining the food necessary for health and growth.

words.tr:
n. 利润；
v. 获利；
words.ex: The company made a big profit this year.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司今年赚了大量利润。
words.en: Profit is the amount of money that you gain when you are paid more for something than it cost you to make, get, or do it.

words.ex: He speaks English with a French accent.
words.ex_cn: 他说英语时带有法国口音。
words.en: An accent is a distinctive way of pronouncing a language, especially one associated with a particular country, area, or social class.

words.ex: He lit a candle to see in the dark.
words.ex_cn: 他点燃了一支蜡烛以便在黑暗中看见。
words.en: A candle is a stick of wax with a wick through the middle which is lit to give light as it burns.

words.tr: n. 树枝；分支；分公司；分支；“branch”的复数；
words.ex: The wind blew down the branches of the tree.
words.ex_cn: 风把树的树枝吹落了。
words.en: The parts of a tree that grow out from the trunk and have leaves, flowers, or fruit on them.

words.tr:
n. 平方；广场；正方形；四方形；
adj. 正方形的；四方形的；平方的；成直角的；
v. 与...一致；
adv. 成直角地；
words.ex: The area of the room is 16 square.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间的面积是16平方米。
words.en: A square is a shape with four sides of equal length and four angles of 90 degrees. It can also refer to an open area in a town, often used for public events, or to the result of multiplying a number by itself.

words.ex: They slept in a tent during the camping trip.
words.ex_cn: 他们在露营时睡在帐篷里。
words.en: A tent is a portable shelter made of fabric or other material stretched over a supporting framework of poles and usually stabilized or secured to the ground with cords and stakes.

words.ex: There are many versions of this app.
words.ex_cn: 这个应用有很多版本。
words.en: A version of something is a particular form of it in which some details are different from earlier or later forms.

words.ex: He built a wall with red bricks.
words.ex_cn: 他用红砖砌了一堵墙。
words.en: Bricks are rectangular blocks of baked clay used for building walls and houses.

words.tr:
n. 战斗；
v. 战斗；
words.ex: The soldiers fought in a long battle.
words.ex_cn: 士兵们进行了一场漫长的战斗。
words.en: A battle is a violent fight between groups of people, especially one between military forces during a war.

words.ex: He lives a 24/7 lifestyle, working and texting all day and night.
words.ex_cn: 他过着24/7的生活方式，整天整夜地工作和发信息。
words.en: The way in which a person lives is their lifestyle.

words.tr:
n. 许可证；
v. 允许；准许；
words.ex: He showed his fishing permit to the officer.
words.ex_cn: 他向官员出示了他的钓鱼许可证。
words.en: If someone permits something, they allow it to happen. If they permit you to do something, they allow you to do it.

words.ex: The quantity of water in the bottle is small.
words.ex_cn: 瓶子里的水量很少。
words.en: A quantity is an amount that you can measure or count.

words.tr: v. 作曲；撰写；“compose”的现在分词；
words.ex: He is composing a song for his daughter.
words.ex_cn: 他正在为女儿作一首歌。
words.en: The act of creating or putting together something, especially a piece of music or writing.

words.ex: The community cleaned the park together.
words.ex_cn: 社区居民一起清理了公园。
words.en: A community is a group of people who live in the same area or who have the same interests, religion, or nationality.

words.ex: The king lives in a big castle.
words.ex_cn: 国王住在一座大城堡里。
words.en: A castle is a large building or group of buildings fortified against attack with thick walls, battlements, towers, and in many cases a moat.

words.ex: The slaves worked in the fields every day.
words.ex_cn: 这些奴隶每天在田地里劳作。
words.en: A slave is a person who is the legal property of another and is forced to obey them.

words.ex: He is a beginner in piano lessons.
words.ex_cn: 他是钢琴课的初学者。
words.en: A beginner is someone who has just started learning to do something and has not yet mastered it.

words.ex: The students walk through the corridors to get to class.
words.ex_cn: 学生们穿过走廊去上课。
words.en: A corridor is a long passage in a building, with doors and rooms on one or both sides.

words.tr:
n. 屏幕；屏风；掩蔽物；
v. 筛查；掩蔽；
words.ex: The movie is playing on the screen.
words.ex_cn: 电影正在屏幕上播放。
words.en: A screen is a flat surface on which pictures or words are shown, such as the one on a television or computer. It can also refer to a partition used to divide or protect an area. As a verb, to screen means to examine something in order to decide whether it is suitable for a particular purpose, or to protect someone or something from something harmful or unpleasant.

words.ex: The brain controls our thoughts and movements.
words.ex_cn: 大脑控制我们的思想和行动。
words.en: The brain is the organ inside your head that controls your body's activities and enables you to think and to feel things such as heat and pain.

words.ex: The planet Mars is red.
words.ex_cn: 火星是红色的。
words.en: A planet is a large object in space that moves around a star, such as the sun, and does not produce its own light.

words.ex: The tree casts a long shadow at sunset.
words.ex_cn: 夕阳下，树投下长长的影子。
words.en: A shadow is a dark shape on a surface that is made when something stands between a light and the surface.

words.tr: n. 细节；“detail”的复数； v. 详细说明；
words.ex: Can you give me the details of the meeting?
words.ex_cn: 你能给我会议的细节吗？
words.en: The word 'details' refers to the individual facts or elements that make up a larger whole. It is often used to describe the specific aspects or components of a subject that are important for understanding it fully.

words.tr: n. 会员资格；全体会员；
words.ex: He paid $50 to get membership of the gym.
words.ex_cn: 他支付了50美元以获得健身房的会员资格。
words.en: Membership is the state of being a member of a group or organization.

words.ex: My neighbours often help me with groceries.
words.ex_cn: 我的邻居经常帮我买杂货。
words.en: People living next to or near each other, or things situated close to each other.

words.tr:
n. 粘附物；胶粘物；不干胶标签；贴纸；不屈不挠的人
v. 给…贴上标签价
words.ex: He put a sticker on his notebook.
words.ex_cn: 他在笔记本上贴了一个粘附物。
words.en: A sticker is a small piece of paper or plastic with a picture or writing on one side and glue on the other side, which you can stick onto a surface.

words.ex: He is aware of the danger.
words.ex_cn: 他意识到危险。
words.en: If you are aware of something, you know about it.

words.ex: He wears a helmet to protect his head.
words.ex_cn: 他戴头盔来保护头部。
words.en: If you protect someone or something, you prevent them from being harmed or damaged.

words.ex: He wants freedom to speak his mind.
words.ex_cn: 他想要自由地表达自己的想法。
words.en: The condition of being free; the power to act or speak or think without externally imposed restraints.

words.tr: n. 伪道歉；敷衍的道歉（由 'banana' 和 'apology' 组合而成的俚语，指毫无诚意的道歉）
words.ex: Banapology is not a real word.
words.ex_cn: Banapology不是一个真正的单词。
words.en: A term combining 'banana' and 'apology,' often used humorously to describe a trivial or insincere apology.

words.ex: The children felt excitement before the birthday party.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在生日派对前感到兴奋。
words.en: A feeling of great enthusiasm and eagerness.

words.ex: We read chapter five last night.
words.ex_cn: 我们昨晚读了第五章。
words.en: The fifth section of a book, report, or other written work.

words.ex: The box has enough storage space for toys.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子有足够的存储空间来放玩具。
words.en: The area or capacity available for storing data, files, or other materials in a computer or other device.

words.ex: He filled out the booking form for the hotel.
words.ex_cn: 他填写了酒店的预订表格。
words.en: A document used to reserve or book a service, such as a hotel room or flight.

words.tr: phrase. 最后的时间；最终时刻
words.ex: The final time to submit the assignment is tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 提交作业的最后时间是明天。
words.en: The concluding or final moment of an event, period, or process.

words.ex: He ordered room service because he was tired.
words.ex_cn: 他因为累了就点了客房服务。
words.en: Room service is a service provided by a hotel in which food and drink are brought to guests' rooms.

words.tr: phrase. 噪声水平；噪音等级；音量大小
words.ex: The noise level in the room is too high.
words.ex_cn: 房间里的噪音水平太高了。
words.en: The level of sound, especially when it is unwanted, unpleasant, or loud.

words.tr: phrase. 紧急联系号码；在紧急情况下可联系的电话号码
words.ex: Write down your emergency contact number.
words.ex_cn: 写下你的紧急联系人电话。
words.en: A phone number that can be used to contact someone in case of an emergency.

words.ex: He goes to the sports center every Saturday.
words.ex_cn: 他每个星期六都去体育中心。
words.en: A sports center is a place where people can go to participate in various sports and physical activities. It typically includes facilities such as gyms, swimming pools, and courts for games like basketball and tennis.

words.ex: The birds live in a nature reserve.
words.ex_cn: 这些鸟生活在自然保护区。
words.en: A nature reserve is a protected area of importance for wildlife, flora, fauna or features of geological or other special interest, which is reserved and managed for conservation and to provide special opportunities for study or research.

words.ex: He drinks bottled water every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天喝瓶装水。
words.en: Water that has been purified and sealed in bottles for drinking.

words.ex: He uses a credit card to buy food.
words.ex_cn: 他用信用卡买食物。
words.en: A credit card is a small plastic card that you use to buy things on credit or to borrow money.

words.ex: He lives in a low income family.
words.ex_cn: 他住在一个低收入家庭。
words.en: Low income refers to a level of earnings that is significantly below the average income, often making it difficult for individuals or families to meet their basic needs.

words.tr: phrase. 艺术家俱乐部；艺术家们聚集交流的团体或场所
words.ex: He joins the artists club to paint with friends.
words.ex_cn: 他加入艺术家俱乐部和朋友一起画画。
words.en: An artists club is a social organization or venue where artists meet to share their work, ideas, and experiences.

words.tr: phrase. 可循环使用的袋子；环保袋
words.ex: She uses a reusable bag for shopping.
words.ex_cn: 她购物时使用可重复使用的袋子。
words.en: A bag that can be used multiple times, designed to reduce waste and environmental impact compared to single-use bags.

words.tr: phrase. 身体语言；肢体语言
words.ex: He smiles and nods, that is positive body language.
words.ex_cn: 他微笑并点头，这是积极的肢体语言。
words.en: The conscious and unconscious movements and postures by which attitudes and feelings are communicated.

words.tr: phrase. 公共医疗卫生服务
words.ex: The health service helps people get free check-ups.
words.ex_cn: 医疗服务帮助人们获得免费体检。
words.en: Health service refers to the medical services provided to the public, often by a government or private organization, aimed at maintaining or improving people's health.

words.ex: They swim in the swimming pool every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他们每天早上在游泳池里游泳。
words.en: A swimming pool is a large container filled with water, designed for people to swim in.

words.ex: He buys fresh fish at the fish market.
words.ex_cn: 他在鱼市买新鲜的鱼。
words.en: A place where fish and seafood are sold.

words.tr: phrase. 最顶层的屋顶；建筑物最高处的覆盖结构
words.ex: The top roof of the building is covered with solar panels.
words.ex_cn: 这栋楼的最顶层屋顶覆盖着太阳能板。
words.en: The highest part of a roof, typically the ridge or peak.

words.ex: He left the house through the back door.
words.ex_cn: 他从后门离开了房子。
words.en: A back door is a door at the back of a building, or a way of achieving something secretly or unofficially.

words.ex: We visited a national park last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我们上周末参观了一个国家公园。
words.en: A national park is an area of land that is protected by the government because of its natural beauty, plants, or animals, and is open to the public for enjoyment and education.

words.tr: phrase. 访客中心：一个提供旅游信息给游客的实体位置。
words.ex: The visitor center gives maps to tourists.
words.ex_cn: 游客中心向游客提供地图。
words.en: A visitor center is a facility that provides information to tourists and visitors about a particular place, such as a park, museum, or city.

words.tr: phrase. 合住房间；多人共用的房间
words.ex: They live in a shared room at university.
words.ex_cn: 他们在大学里住一间共用的房间。
words.en: A room that is rented and used by more than one person, typically to reduce costs.

words.ex: You should have a health check every year.
words.ex_cn: 你应该每年做一次健康检查。
words.en: A health check is a medical examination to test your general state of health.

words.tr: phrase. v. 关闭；停业；终止运营
words.ex: The shop will close down next week.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店将在下周关门。
words.en: If a business or organization closes down or if someone closes it down, it stops operating permanently.

words.ex: Climate change is making the weather hotter.
words.ex_cn: 气候变化让天气变得更热。
words.en: A significant and lasting change in the Earth's climate, especially a change due to an increase in the average atmospheric temperature.

words.ex: He pays high car taxes every year.
words.ex_cn: 他每年都要支付很高的汽车税。
words.en: High car taxes refer to the significant amount of money that car owners are required to pay to the government as a tax for owning and operating a vehicle, often implemented to discourage car use or to fund public transportation projects.

words.ex: The government election will happen next month.
words.ex_cn: 政府选举将在下个月举行。
words.en: A government election is a formal decision-making process by which a population chooses an individual or multiple individuals to hold public office.

words.ex: Global warming is making the Earth hotter.
words.ex_cn: 全球变暖正在让地球变得更热。
words.en: Global warming refers to the long-term increase in Earth's average surface temperature due to human activities, primarily fossil fuel burning, which increases heat-trapping greenhouse gas levels in Earth's atmosphere.

words.ex: New York is a melting pot of many cultures.
words.ex_cn: 纽约是多种文化的熔炉。
words.en: A place where different peoples, styles, theories, etc., are mixed together.

words.ex: The middle class works hard to afford a home and education for their children.
words.ex_cn: 中产阶级努力工作，以负担住房和孩子的教育。
words.en: The social group between the upper and working classes, including professional and business workers and their families.

words.ex: He cooks with olive oil every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都用橄榄油做饭。
words.en: Olive oil is a liquid fat obtained from olives, a traditional tree crop of the Mediterranean Basin. It is commonly used in cooking, for frying foods or as a salad dressing.

words.tr: phrase. 公司员工；企业工作人员
words.ex: The company workers leave work at five o'clock.
words.ex_cn: 公司员工五点下班。
words.en: Employees of a business or organization.

words.ex: He enjoys horse riding every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每个周末都喜欢骑马。
words.en: The activity of riding a horse, especially for pleasure or sport.

words.ex: He took a fishing lesson last Saturday.
words.ex_cn: 他上个星期六上了一节钓鱼课。
words.en: A session or course designed to teach the skills and techniques of fishing.

words.ex: The bus service runs every 15 minutes.
words.ex_cn: 公交车服务每15分钟一趟。
words.en: A bus service is a system of transporting people by bus, usually along a fixed route and schedule.

words.ex: He wears a dark blue shirt to work.
words.ex_cn: 他上班穿一件深蓝色的衬衫。
words.en: A dark blue color is a deep shade of blue.

words.tr: phrase. 遗传信息（指生物体中通过基因传递的、控制遗传特征的生物化学信息）
words.ex: DNA carries genetic information.
words.ex_cn: DNA携带遗传信息。
words.en: Genetic information refers to the heritable biological information coded in the DNA or RNA of an organism, which determines the development and functioning of that organism.

words.tr: phrase. 废物处理系统；垃圾处理系统
words.ex: The town has a new waste disposal system.
words.ex_cn: 这个城镇有了一个新的废物处理系统。
words.en: A waste disposal system refers to the process and infrastructure used to manage and dispose of waste materials in a way that minimizes their impact on the environment.

words.tr: phrase. 信息产业；信息部门
words.ex: The government supports information sectors with new technology.
words.ex_cn: 政府用新技术支持信息产业。
words.en: Sectors of the economy that primarily produce, process, and disseminate information, such as telecommunications, software, and media.

words.ex: The digital system shows the time on the screen.
words.ex_cn: 这个数字系统在屏幕上显示时间。
words.en: A digital system is a system that uses discrete values, often binary numbers, for input, processing, transmission, storage, or display, as opposed to an analog system which uses continuous signals.

words.tr: phrase. 农业用品；农用物资（指用于农业生产的工具、设备、肥料、种子等物品）
words.ex: He bought farming supplies at the local store.
words.ex_cn: 他在当地商店买了农用物资。
words.en: Farming supplies refer to the tools, equipment, and other materials needed for agricultural activities.

words.tr: phrase. 支持服务；辅助性服务
words.ex: The support service helps customers with their problems.
words.ex_cn: 客服服务帮助客户解决他们的问题。
words.en: Support service refers to assistance provided to users or customers to help them solve problems or answer questions related to a product or service.

words.tr: phrase. 金融市场；进行金融资产（如股票、债券等）交易的市场
words.ex: The financial market went down yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 昨天金融市场下跌了。
words.en: A financial market is a market in which people trade financial securities, commodities, and other fungible items of value at low transaction costs and at prices that reflect supply and demand.

words.ex: She works in the clothing sections of a big mall.
words.ex_cn: 她在大型商场的服装行业工作。
words.en: Designated areas in a store where different types of garments are sold.

words.ex: He likes online shopping for clothes.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在网上买衣服。
words.en: The activity of buying goods or services over the internet.

words.ex: The company got a corporate loan to expand its business.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司获得了一笔企业贷款来扩展业务。
words.en: A corporate loan is a loan made to a business rather than an individual, typically for the purpose of expansion, equipment purchase, or working capital.

words.ex: The mineral soil helps plants grow strong.
words.ex_cn: 矿物质土壤帮助植物茁壮成长。
words.en: Soil that contains a significant amount of mineral matter, as opposed to organic soil which is primarily composed of organic material.

words.ex: The waves moved the soft sediment on the sea floor.
words.ex_cn: 海浪移动了海底的软沉积物。
words.en: Soft sediment refers to the accumulation of particles that have settled from suspension in a fluid, typically water, and are not yet compacted into rock.

words.tr: phrase. 员工培训；职员训练
words.ex: The school is doing staff training this week.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校本周正在进行员工培训。
words.en: Staff training refers to the process of teaching the skills and knowledge that employees need to perform their jobs effectively.

words.ex: The government checks food safety in all restaurants.
words.ex_cn: 政府检查所有餐厅的食品安全。
words.en: The condition of food being safe to eat, not contaminated with harmful substances.

words.tr: phrase. 食品包装；食物包裹
words.ex: The food package is on the table.
words.ex_cn: 食品包装在桌子上。
words.en: A container or wrapping in which food is stored, transported, and sold.

words.ex: The factory does food processing for supermarkets.
words.ex_cn: 这家工厂为超市进行食品加工。
words.en: Food processing is the transformation of raw ingredients, by physical or chemical means into food, or of food into other forms. Food processing combines raw food ingredients to produce marketable food products that can be easily prepared and served by the consumer.

words.ex: He loves learning local history in his town.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢了解自己小镇的本地历史。
words.en: Local history refers to the historical study of a particular community, area, or region, often focusing on the people, events, and developments that have shaped its identity over time.

words.tr: phrase. 长期效应；长期影响；长期后果
words.ex: The medicine has long-term effects on children.
words.ex_cn: 这种药物对儿童有长期影响。
words.en: The consequences or impacts that occur over a long period of time.

words.ex: The traffic flow is slow during rush hour.
words.ex_cn: 高峰时段交通流量很慢。
words.en: The movement of vehicles or pedestrians along a street or other route.

words.tr: phrase. 人际关系给予患者安慰
words.ex: Kind personal relationships reassure patients during recovery.
words.ex_cn: 良好的人际关系在康复过程中给予患者安慰。
words.en: The way in which personal connections can provide comfort and confidence to patients in a healthcare setting.

words.ex: The electric field pushes the charged particle.
words.ex_cn: 电场推动带电粒子。
words.en: An electric field is a region around a charged particle or object within which a force would be exerted on other charged particles or objects.

words.ex: The immune system fights germs in the body.
words.ex_cn: 免疫系统在体内对抗细菌。
words.en: The immune system is the body's defense against infectious organisms and other invaders. Through a series of steps called the immune response, the immune system attacks organisms and substances that invade body systems and cause disease.

words.tr: phrase. 教育功能的；与教育职能相关的
words.ex: The app has educational functions for children.
words.ex_cn: 这个应用程序具有儿童教育功能。
words.en: The purposes or roles of education, such as teaching, learning, and personal development.

words.ex: He puts leftovers in food containers.
words.ex_cn: 他把剩饭放在食品容器里。
words.en: Containers specifically designed for storing, preserving, or transporting food.

words.ex: He takes public transport to work every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天乘公共交通去上班。
words.en: Public transport refers to the system of vehicles such as buses and trains that operate at regular times on fixed routes and are used by the public.

words.ex: She puts the plates in the dish washer.
words.ex_cn: 她把盘子放进洗碗机。
words.en: A dish washer is a machine that washes dishes, cutlery, and cookware automatically.

words.ex: He stops at the petrol station to fill his car.
words.ex_cn: 他停在加油站给车加油。
words.en: A petrol station is a place where petrol is sold and where vehicles can be filled with petrol.

words.ex: The toy factory makes small cars for children.
words.ex_cn: 玩具工厂为孩子们制造小汽车。
words.en: A toy factory is a place where toys are manufactured.

words.tr: phrase. 在运输中；在途中；在转运过程中
words.ex: The package is in transit.
words.ex_cn: 这个包裹正在运输途中。
words.en: If someone or something is in transit, they are travelling or being taken from one place to another.

words.ex: The meeting will be held at the town hall.
words.ex_cn: 会议将在市政厅举行。
words.en: A town hall is a building used for the administration of local government, or a meeting at which a public official or political candidate addresses an audience.

words.tr: phrase. 中程的；中等范围的；中等水平的
words.ex: The price is in the middle range.
words.ex_cn: 这个价格在中等范围内。
words.en: The term 'middle range' refers to something that is neither at the highest nor at the lowest level of a scale, but somewhere in between.

words.ex: He is a computer programmer who writes code every day.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名计算机程序员，每天写代码。
words.en: A computer programmer is a person who writes computer programs.

words.ex: The hotel room has a sea view.
words.ex_cn: 这家酒店的房间有海景。
words.en: A view of the sea from a particular place.

words.ex: I live at 788 North Gate.
words.ex_cn: 我住在北门788号。
words.en: The north gate refers to the entrance located on the northern side of a place, such as a city, university, or park.

words.ex: He went to the police station to report a theft.
words.ex_cn: 他去警察局报案被盗。
words.en: A police station is the office of a local police force, where the police work and where people can report crimes.

words.ex: He gave me his phone number.
words.ex_cn: 他给了我他的电话号码。
words.en: A phone number is a sequence of digits assigned to a fixed-line telephone subscriber station connected to a telephone line or to a wireless electronic telephony device, such as a radio telephone or a mobile telephone, or to other devices for data transmission via the public switched telephone network (PSTN) or other public and private networks.

words.tr: phrase. 手臂带；袖章；用于手臂上的带状物，常用于标识身份或支持某种活动
words.ex: He wore an arm band to show his support.
words.ex_cn: 他戴了一个手臂带以表示他的支持。
words.en: An arm band is a band worn around the arm, typically as a symbol of support, mourning, or membership in a group.

words.ex: The baby learned to roll over at three months.
words.ex_cn: 宝宝三个月大时学会了翻身。
words.en: To move by turning over and over on an axis; to defer or transfer something to a later time or another account.

words.ex: The higher seats offer a better view of the stage.
words.ex_cn: 更高的座位能更好地看到舞台。
words.en: Positions of greater authority or importance.

words.ex: He drinks milk every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上喝牛奶。
words.en: Consume milk as a beverage.

words.tr: phrase. 黄色票券；通常指特定场合或用途的黄色纸质凭证（如交通罚单、活动入场券等）
words.ex: He bought yellow tickets for the concert.
words.ex_cn: 他买了黄色的演唱会门票。
words.en: A type of official document or permit, often yellow in colour, granting specific rights or access.

words.tr: phrase. 下一场研讨会；下次研讨课
words.ex: The next seminar is on Friday.
words.ex_cn: 下一次研讨会是在周五。
words.en: A seminar is a meeting where a group of people discuss a subject or topic, often in an educational or business context. 'Next seminar' refers to the upcoming meeting of this kind.

words.ex: He works in the chemistry lab after school.
words.ex_cn: 他放学后在化学实验室工作。
words.en: A chemistry lab is a facility that provides controlled conditions in which scientific or technological research, experiments, and measurement may be performed.

words.ex: We are reading chapter six in our math book.
words.ex_cn: 我们正在数学书里读第六章。
words.en: The sixth section of a book, report, or other written work.

words.tr: phrase. 在线帮助；联机帮助（系统）
words.ex: I got online help with my math homework.
words.ex_cn: 我在线上得到了数学作业的帮助。
words.en: Online help refers to assistance or information provided to users through a digital medium, typically accessible via the internet or within software applications.

words.ex: He is a baseball coach at the local school.
words.ex_cn: 他是当地学校的一名棒球教练。
words.en: A baseball coach is a person who trains and directs a baseball team.

words.tr: phrase. 救援司机；抢险驾驶员
words.ex: The rescue driver saved the cat from the tree.
words.ex_cn: 救援司机把猫从树上救了下来。
words.en: A rescue driver is a person who drives a vehicle to the scene of an emergency to provide assistance or transport.

words.tr: phrase. 潜水经验；指进行水下潜水活动的经历或熟练程度
words.ex: He has diving experience from his trip to the beach.
words.ex_cn: 他去海滩旅行时有过潜水经验。
words.en: The experience gained from diving activities, which may include knowledge of diving techniques, safety measures, and interaction with marine life.

words.ex: They play tennis on the tennis courts after school.
words.ex_cn: 他们放学后在网球场打网球。
words.en: A tennis court is the venue where the game of tennis is played.

words.ex: The tourists rode the cable car up the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 游客们乘坐缆车上了山。
words.en: A cable car is a vehicle that is pulled by a moving cable and is used for transporting people up and down mountains.

words.ex: Farmers use natural methods to kill harmful insects.
words.ex_cn: 农民使用自然方法杀死有害昆虫。
words.en: Insects that cause damage to crops, plants, or are a nuisance to humans and animals.

words.ex: He runs a small scale bakery at home.
words.ex_cn: 他在家经营一家小型面包店。
words.en: Small scale refers to something that is limited in size or extent.

words.ex: We visited an art gallery on Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 我们在周日参观了一个美术馆。
words.en: A place where works of art are displayed for public viewing.

words.ex: They went to the concert hall to hear the orchestra.
words.ex_cn: 他们去音乐厅听交响乐。
words.en: A concert hall is a building designed for the performance of concerts and other musical events.

words.tr: phrase. 实验室工作；实验操作；实验任务
words.ex: He does lab work every Friday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周五做实验。
words.en: Work that is done in a laboratory, especially scientific experiments or research.

words.tr: phrase. 橱窗装饰；橱窗布置；弄虚作假
words.ex: The store put flowers and lights as window dressing for the holiday sale.
words.ex_cn: 商店为了节日促销，用鲜花和灯光做橱窗装饰。
words.en: The act of making something appear better than it really is, especially in order to deceive people.

words.tr: phrase. 悠久的历史；漫长的历史
words.ex: This city has a long history.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市有着悠久的历史。
words.en: A period of time spanning many years or centuries.

words.ex: The water pipes leak in winter.
words.ex_cn: 水管在冬天会漏水。
words.en: Water pipes are tubes or pipes that carry water from one place to another, especially as part of a water supply system.

words.tr: phrase. 实际成果；实践结果；可落地的成效
words.ex: The project had practical outcomes for daily life.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目对日常生活产生了实际成果。
words.en: The tangible results or effects that arise from practical actions or experiments.

words.ex: Plants take in carbon dioxide from the air.
words.ex_cn: 植物从空气中吸收二氧化碳。
words.en: Carbon dioxide is a gas that is produced when people and animals breathe out, or when carbon is burned in the air. It is used by plants in photosynthesis.

words.ex: The city has too much air pollution.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市有太多的空气污染。
words.en: Air pollution refers to the presence of substances in the atmosphere that are harmful to the health of humans and other living beings, or cause damage to the climate or to materials.

words.tr: phrase. 更好的结果；更理想的结果
words.ex: He works hard to get better results.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作以取得更好的成绩。
words.en: Outcomes that are superior to previous ones.

words.tr: phrase. 长期趋势；长期走向
words.ex: The long term trend shows more people use electric cars.
words.ex_cn: 长期趋势显示越来越多的人使用电动汽车。
words.en: A general direction in which something is developing or changing over a long period of time.

words.ex: The museum offers free entry on Sundays.
words.ex_cn: 博物馆在星期日免费入场。
words.en: The permission or right to enter a place or event without payment.

words.tr: phrase. 技术改进；科技方面的提升或进步
words.ex: The company made a technological improvement to save energy.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司进行了技术改进以节约能源。
words.en: An enhancement or advancement in technology that leads to better performance, efficiency, or capabilities.

words.tr: phrase. 不常见的运动项目；指那些非主流或较少人参与的体育活动
words.ex: Curling is an uncommon sport in many countries.
words.ex_cn: 冰壶在许多国家是不常见的运动项目。
words.en: Activities or games that are not widely played or known, often pursued for recreation or competition.

words.tr: phrase. 尊重隐私；对个人隐私予以尊重
words.ex: He respects privacy and never reads others' messages.
words.ex_cn: 他尊重隐私，从不阅读别人的短信。
words.en: To avoid intruding into someone's personal life or affairs without permission.

words.tr: phrase. 足够的细节；充分的详情
words.ex: The report does not have sufficient details.
words.ex_cn: 这份报告没有足够的细节。
words.en: Enough information or particulars to meet a requirement or purpose.

words.tr: phrase. 预期持续时间；预计的持续时长
words.ex: The expected duration of the trip is two weeks.
words.ex_cn: 这次旅行的预计时长是两周。
words.en: The period of time that is anticipated or predicted to last.

words.ex: He sent his curriculum vitae to the company.
words.ex_cn: 他把简历发给了公司。
words.en: A curriculum vitae is a written account of your education and the jobs you have done, which you send when you are applying for a job.

words.ex: Parental teaching helps children learn good habits.
words.ex_cn: 父母的教导帮助孩子养成好习惯。
words.en: The act or process of imparting knowledge, skills, and values from parents to their children.

words.tr: phrase. 一般能力；平均水平的能力
words.ex: He has average ability in math.
words.ex_cn: 他的数学能力一般。
words.en: An ordinary or typical level of competence or skill.

words.ex: He needs further training to get the job.
words.ex_cn: 他需要进一步的培训才能得到这份工作。
words.en: Additional training or education undertaken to improve or update one's skills or knowledge.

words.ex: They did a telephone survey last week.
words.ex_cn: 他们上周进行了电话调查。
words.en: A method of collecting information from a sample of individuals by interviewing them over the telephone.

words.tr: phrase. 个案研究；案例分析；调查研究
words.ex: He did a case study on a small business.
words.ex_cn: 他做了一个关于小企业的案例研究。
words.en: A case study is a detailed examination of a particular case or situation, especially in order to understand its complexities or to test a theory.

words.tr: phrase. 邮寄调查；通过邮政方式发放的问卷调研
words.ex: They sent a postal survey to every household.
words.ex_cn: 他们给每户家庭寄了一份邮寄调查问卷。
words.en: A method of collecting data by sending questionnaires through the mail to a sample of individuals or households.

words.tr: phrase. 中心部分；核心部分
words.ex: The central part of the city is busy with people.
words.ex_cn: 城市的中心部分人很多。
words.en: The central or middle section of something, such as a book, a city, or a discussion, often serving as the main focus or core area.

words.ex: The drug has a negative effect on his health.
words.ex_cn: 这种药物对他的健康有负面影响。
words.en: A negative effect is an adverse or unfavorable outcome or impact that results from a particular action, event, or situation.

words.tr: phrase. 身体变化；物理变化
words.ex: The boy is going through physical changes during puberty.
words.ex_cn: 这个男孩在青春期经历身体变化。
words.en: Physical changes refer to changes affecting the form of a chemical substance, but not its chemical composition.

words.ex: The river has poor water quality.
words.ex_cn: 这条河的水质很差。
words.en: The condition of the water, including chemical, physical, and biological characteristics, usually with respect to its suitability for a particular purpose.

words.ex: He made eye contact with the teacher during the lesson.
words.ex_cn: 他在上课时与老师进行了眼神交流。
words.en: The act of looking directly into someone's eyes as a means of communication or to express interest.

words.ex: He is improving his social skills at work.
words.ex_cn: 他正在工作中提升自己的社交技能。
words.en: Social skills are the skills we use to communicate and interact with each other, both verbally and non-verbally, through gestures, body language and our personal appearance.

words.tr: phrase. 特价商品；特价销售
words.ex: The store has special offers on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店在周末有特价优惠。
words.en: Special offers are discounts or deals that are available for a limited time to encourage people to buy a product or service.

words.ex: His heart rate increased after running.
words.ex_cn: 他跑步后心率加快了。
words.en: The number of times the heart beats per minute.

words.ex: He has muscle pain after running.
words.ex_cn: 他跑步后肌肉酸痛。
words.en: Pain in the muscles, often due to strain or injury.

words.ex: The train runs on a long railway line.
words.ex_cn: 火车行驶在一条长长的铁路线上。
words.en: A railway line is the track along which trains run, connecting different places.

words.ex: The train runs on the railway track.
words.ex_cn: 火车在铁轨上行驶。
words.en: A railway track is the pair of metal rails fixed to the ground that trains run on.

words.ex: The digestive system breaks down food in the body.
words.ex_cn: 消化系统在体内分解食物。
words.en: The group of organs that break down food into smaller components that can be absorbed into the bloodstream and used by the body.

words.tr: phrase. 火山灰；火山喷发后散落在空中的细小颗粒物质
words.ex: The volcano dust covered the nearby village.
words.ex_cn: 火山灰覆盖了附近的村庄。
words.en: Fine particles of rock and mineral that are ejected into the atmosphere during a volcanic eruption.

words.ex: The lion is at the top of the food chain.
words.ex_cn: 狮子处于食物链的顶端。
words.en: A food chain is a series of organisms each dependent on the next as a source of food.

words.tr: phrase. 建筑材料；用于建造房屋或其他结构的材料
words.ex: He bought building materials for his new house.
words.ex_cn: 他为他的新房子买了建筑材料。
words.en: Materials used in construction, such as wood, steel, concrete, etc.

words.ex: She cares about her body shape.
words.ex_cn: 她关心自己的体型。
words.en: The natural form of a person's body, especially in terms of its overall appearance and the proportions of its parts.

words.ex: He planted fruit trees in his backyard.
words.ex_cn: 他在后院种了果树。
words.en: Trees that bear fruit, cultivated for their edible produce.

words.ex: He mends his fishing net by the sea.
words.ex_cn: 他在海边修补他的渔网。
words.en: A fishing net is a net used for catching fish in the water.

words.tr: phrase. 化石燃料（如煤、石油和天然气）
words.ex: Cars use fossil fuels to move.
words.ex_cn: 汽车使用化石燃料来行驶。
words.en: Fossil fuels are natural fuels such as coal or gas, formed in the geological past from the remains of living organisms.

words.tr: phrase. 天气模式；气象模式（指一段时间内天气变化的规律或趋势）
words.ex: The weather patterns change with the seasons.
words.ex_cn: 天气模式随季节变化。
words.en: Weather patterns refer to the recurring characteristics of the weather in a particular region over a period of time.

words.ex: The health department gave out free masks.
words.ex_cn: 卫生部门分发了免费口罩。
words.en: A health department is a part of a government or other organization that is responsible for public health issues.

words.ex: He tracks his food intake every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天记录自己的食物摄入量。
words.en: The amount of food consumed by an organism or individual.

words.ex: His eating patterns changed after he moved to a new city.
words.ex_cn: 他搬到新城市后，饮食习惯发生了变化。
words.en: Eating patterns refer to the habitual way in which a person or group eats, including the types of food chosen, the timing of meals, and the quantities consumed.

words.tr: phrase. 学术报告；学术性书面报告
words.ex: He wrote an academic report for his science class.
words.ex_cn: 他为他的科学课写了一份学术报告。
words.en: A detailed document that presents the findings of a research study or academic inquiry, typically written by students or researchers in an educational institution.

words.tr: phrase. 原始生命；原始生物；早期生命形式
words.ex: Scientists found signs of primitive life in ancient rocks.
words.ex_cn: 科学家在古老的岩石中发现了原始生命的迹象。
words.en: Primitive life refers to the earliest forms of life on Earth, characterized by simple structures and functions, often studied to understand the evolution of more complex organisms.

words.tr: phrase. 酸性的水；指pH值低于7的水，具有酸性性质
words.ex: The lake has acidic water that kills fish.
words.ex_cn: 这个湖里的水是酸性的，会杀死鱼类。
words.en: Water that has a pH level of less than 7, indicating it is more acidic than neutral.

words.ex: He plays video games every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上玩电子游戏。
words.en: Video games are electronic games that involve interaction with a user interface to generate visual feedback on a video device.

words.ex: The life span of a dog is about 10 to 15 years.
words.ex_cn: 狗的寿命大约是10到15年。
words.en: The length of time for which a person or animal lives or a thing functions.

words.ex: He takes the tube railway to work every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天乘地铁上班。
words.en: An underground railway system, especially one in a city.

words.tr: phrase. 学习障碍；学习困难
words.ex: Some children have a learning difficulty and need extra help in school.
words.ex_cn: 一些孩子有学习困难，需要在学校得到额外帮助。
words.en: A learning difficulty is a condition that makes it harder for someone to learn in the same way as most other people.

words.tr: phrase. 备用零件；替换部件
words.ex: He keeps spare parts for his car in the garage.
words.ex_cn: 他把汽车的备用零件存放在车库里。
words.en: Spare parts are components that are kept in reserve to replace other parts that may fail or wear out.

words.ex: The bird knows when to fly south by its internal clock.
words.ex_cn: 鸟通过它的生物钟知道何时飞往南方。
words.en: An internal clock is a natural mechanism within living organisms that regulates the timing of physiological processes and behaviors, such as sleep cycles, in accordance with the environment.

words.ex: He shows strong mental ability in solving math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他在解决数学问题时表现出很强的思维能力。
words.en: The capacity of an individual to perform the higher mental processes of reasoning, remembering, understanding, and problem solving.

words.tr: phrase. 社会事务；社会问题
words.ex: He cares about social matters like poverty and education.
words.ex_cn: 他关心贫困和教育等社会问题。
words.en: Social matters refer to issues or topics that are of concern to society or the community at large.

words.ex: He works at a small law firm.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家小型律师事务所工作。
words.en: A law firm is a business entity formed by one or more lawyers to engage in the practice of law. The primary service rendered by a law firm is to advise clients (individuals or corporations) about their legal rights and responsibilities, and to represent clients in civil or criminal cases, business transactions, and other matters in which legal advice and other assistance are sought.

words.ex: He bought some frozen food from the supermarket.
words.ex_cn: 他从超市买了些速冻食品。
words.en: Frozen food refers to food that has been subjected to rapid freezing and is kept frozen until use, preserving it from the time of preparation to the time of consumption.

words.ex: The back wheel of his bike is flat.
words.ex_cn: 他自行车的后轮瘪了。
words.en: The rear wheel of a vehicle or bicycle.

words.ex: Please write the page number at the top.
words.ex_cn: 请把页码写在顶部。
words.en: The number assigned to a page in a book, document, or other written material, indicating its order in the sequence of pages.

words.tr: phrase. 毛皮贸易；皮草交易
words.ex: The fur trade was common in Canada long ago.
words.ex_cn: 很久以前，毛皮贸易在加拿大很普遍。
words.en: The exchange of animal pelts and furs for goods and money, especially between indigenous peoples and European settlers in North America.

words.tr: phrase. 沟通技巧、移民模式（指人们迁移的规律或趋势）
words.ex: The study shows how communication skills affect migration patterns.
words.ex_cn: 这项研究展示了沟通技巧如何影响移民模式。
words.en: The study of how communication abilities change and develop as people move between different cultures or regions.

words.ex: Do not share your personal information online.
words.ex_cn: 不要在网上分享你的个人信息。
words.en: Information about a particular person, such as their name, address, and phone number, that can be used to identify or contact them.

words.tr: phrase. 棉纺厂；棉纺织工厂
words.ex: Many workers work in cotton factories.
words.ex_cn: 许多工人在棉纺厂工作。
words.en: Cotton factories are industrial facilities where cotton is processed into yarn, fabric, or other textile products.

words.tr: phrase. 运营经理；负责日常业务运作与流程管理的管理人员
words.ex: He is the operation manager of a small factory.
words.ex_cn: 他是这家小工厂的运营经理。
words.en: An operation manager is a person who is responsible for managing the operations of a company or organization, ensuring that all processes are efficient and effective.

words.tr: phrase. 饮食习惯；进食方式
words.ex: His eating habits are very unhealthy.
words.ex_cn: 他的饮食习惯非常不健康。
words.en: Eating habits refer to the way a person or group eats, including the types of food chosen, the manner of eating, and the frequency of meals.

words.ex: Many people lost jobs during the economic depression.
words.ex_cn: 在经济萧条期间，许多人失去了工作。
words.en: A period of drastic decline in a national or international economy, characterized by decreasing business activity, falling prices, and unemployment.

words.ex: We will discuss the details in Chapter Seven of the book.
words.ex_cn: 我们将在书的第七章讨论细节。
words.en: A section of a book or document, typically numbered seven, that forms a distinct part of the whole.

words.tr: phrase. 会议报告；会议纪要
words.ex: He wrote a conference report last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周写了一份会议报告。
words.en: A conference report is a document that summarizes the discussions, decisions, and outcomes of a conference or meeting.

words.ex: He focuses on objective matters in the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他在会议上专注于客观事项。
words.en: A subject or issue that is factual, unbiased, and relevant to the main point of discussion.

words.tr: phrase. 研究设施；科研机构；实验设备
words.ex: The university has modern research facilities.
words.ex_cn: 这所大学有现代化的研究设施。
words.en: Buildings, equipment, and services provided for the purpose of conducting research.

words.tr: phrase. 教师；教学人员；师资队伍
words.ex: The teaching staff helped the students with their homework.
words.ex_cn: 教师们帮助学生完成作业。
words.en: The group of people who teach in a school, college, or university.

words.ex: He practiced interview skills before the job interview.
words.ex_cn: 他在面试前练习了面试技巧。
words.en: The abilities and techniques that enable someone to perform well in job interviews, including communication, presentation, and the ability to answer questions effectively.

words.ex: He uses a tape recorder to practice English.
words.ex_cn: 他用录音机练习英语。
words.en: A tape recorder is a device used for recording and playing back sound on magnetic tape.

words.tr: phrase. 标志性景点；具有代表性的地点
words.ex: Tourists visit iconic sites like the Eiffel Tower.
words.ex_cn: 游客参观埃菲尔铁塔等标志性景点。
words.en: Iconic sites refer to places that are widely recognized and well-established as representative symbols or landmarks of a particular area, culture, or historical period.

words.ex: The sound quality of this speaker is very good.
words.ex_cn: 这个音箱的音质非常好。
words.en: The standard of how good or clear the sound is.

words.tr: phrase. 打印出的清单；印刷列表
words.ex: He checked the printed list before the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他在会议前检查了打印的清单。
words.en: A document listing items in printed form.

words.tr: phrase. 免费的代金券；免费的优惠券
words.ex: They give free vouchers to students.
words.ex_cn: 他们给学生免费代金券。
words.en: Free vouchers are coupons or tickets that are given to people without charge, allowing them to get something for free, such as a product or a service.

words.tr: phrase. 考试结果；化验结果
words.ex: The teacher showed the test results to the students.
words.ex_cn: 老师把考试成绩给学生们看了。
words.en: The outcomes or data obtained from a test or examination.

words.tr: phrase. 大学协调员；负责协调学院或大学各项事务的管理人员
words.ex: The college coordinator helps students with their schedules.
words.ex_cn: 大学协调员帮助学生安排课程。
words.en: A college coordinator is a person responsible for organizing and managing various activities and programs within a college or university.

words.tr: phrase. 更大的效用；更高的实用性
words.ex: This tool has greater utility than the old one.
words.ex_cn: 这个工具比旧的更有用。
words.en: The concept of greater utility refers to the increased usefulness or benefit that can be obtained from a particular good or service.

words.ex: He uses a calculator to save time.
words.ex_cn: 他使用计算器来节省时间。
words.en: To do something in a way that reduces the amount of time needed.

words.tr: phrase. 科学任务；科研课题；科学作业
words.ex: He finished his scientific assignment last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚完成了他的科学作业。
words.en: A task or piece of work given to someone as part of their studies or job, specifically related to science.

words.tr: phrase. 笔记系统；注释体系
words.ex: He uses a note system to remember his tasks.
words.ex_cn: 他使用一个笔记系统来记住他的任务。
words.en: A method or set of rules for recording information, often in written form.

words.tr: phrase. 双倍行距；每行之间留有一个空行的排版方式
words.ex: He uses double spacing in his essay.
words.ex_cn: 他在论文中使用双倍行距。
words.en: The practice of inserting a full line of space between each line of text, often used in academic and professional documents to allow room for comments and corrections.

words.ex: Children learn through social interactions with their peers.
words.ex_cn: 儿童通过与同龄人的社交互动来学习。
words.en: Social interactions refer to the ways in which people act and react in relation to others.

words.tr: phrase. 意外的噪音；未预料到的声响
words.ex: The unexpected noise woke me up.
words.ex_cn: 那阵意外的噪音把我吵醒了。
words.en: A sound that is not anticipated or foreseen, often causing surprise or alarm.

words.tr: phrase. 生活费用；日常开销
words.ex: He works part-time to cover his living expenses.
words.ex_cn: 他做兼职来支付生活开销。
words.en: The costs incurred by a person or family for the necessities of life, such as food, shelter, and clothing.

words.ex: Different students have different learning styles.
words.ex_cn: 不同的学生有不同的学习方式。
words.en: Learning styles refer to the preferred ways in which individuals absorb, process, comprehend, and retain information.

words.ex: We use solar panels to get alternative energy.
words.ex_cn: 我们使用太阳能板来获取可再生能源。
words.en: Alternative energy refers to energy sources that are different from the traditional fossil fuels (coal, oil, and natural gas) and are considered to be more environmentally friendly and sustainable.

words.ex: Workers must follow safety regulations at the site.
words.ex_cn: 工人必须遵守现场的安全规定。
words.en: Rules or directives made and maintained by an authority to ensure safety.

words.ex: She is the class representative for Grade 10.
words.ex_cn: 她是十年级的班级代表。
words.en: A student leader who organizes class activities and the process of sorting data or ideas into categories.

words.ex: The seminar group discussed the book last week.
words.ex_cn: 研讨小组上周讨论了这本书。
words.en: A seminar group is a small group of people who meet regularly to discuss a particular subject or topic, often as part of a course of study.

words.ex: He wrote a project outline for his science fair.
words.ex_cn: 他为他的科学展览写了一个项目大纲。
words.en: A structured summary or plan that outlines the main objectives, key stages, and expected outcomes of a project or task.

words.ex: The project background explains why we started this work.
words.ex_cn: 项目背景解释了我们为什么开始这项工作。
words.en: The project background refers to the context and circumstances that led to the initiation of a project, including the problem it aims to solve, the objectives it seeks to achieve, and the environment in which it operates.

words.tr: phrase. 简要的总结；简短的概述
words.ex: He gave a brief summary of the story.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个故事做了简要的总结。
words.en: A short, condensed account of the most important points.

words.ex: He put the papers in a blue folder.
words.ex_cn: 他把文件放进了一个蓝色的文件夹。
words.en: A folder that is blue in color.

words.ex: He reads aloud to his little sister every night.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上为他的小妹妹大声朗读。
words.en: To speak the words that you are reading, so that other people can hear them.

words.tr: phrase. 演讲技巧；表达技巧
words.ex: He improved his presentation skills by practicing every day.
words.ex_cn: 他通过每天练习提高了演讲技巧。
words.en: The ability to effectively communicate information, ideas, or messages to an audience in a clear and engaging manner.

words.tr: phrase. 暴力犯罪；指涉及身体伤害或威胁使用暴力的犯罪行为
words.ex: The city saw a rise in violent crime last year.
words.ex_cn: 去年这个城市的暴力犯罪增加了。
words.en: A violent crime is a crime in which the offender uses or threatens to use violent force upon the victim.

words.ex: He works as a videotape editor for a TV station.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名电视台的录像带编辑。
words.en: A person who edits videotapes, especially for professional broadcasting or film production.

words.ex: The company built a large scale factory to make more products.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司建造了一个大规模的工厂来生产更多产品。
words.en: Involving or affecting a large number of people or things; extensive.

words.ex: He owns private property near the lake.
words.ex_cn: 他拥有湖边的一处私人财产。
words.en: Private property refers to property owned by individuals or entities, not by the government or the public.

words.ex: The library is on the second floor.
words.ex_cn: 图书馆在二楼。
words.en: The level of a building that is immediately above the ground floor.

words.tr: phrase. 公司士气；企业员工的整体精神状态和工作积极性
words.ex: The new manager improved corporation morale by giving bonuses.
words.ex_cn: 新经理通过发放奖金提高了公司士气。
words.en: The overall mood, spirit, and satisfaction level among employees within a company.

words.ex: He is learning business management at university.
words.ex_cn: 他正在大学学习工商管理。
words.en: The process of planning, organizing, directing, and controlling the activities of a business or organization to achieve its objectives.

words.ex: He practices essay writing every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上练习写作文。
words.en: The activity or skill of writing essays, especially as part of a student's academic work.

words.ex: She walks in the rose garden every morning.
words.ex_cn: 她每天早上都在玫瑰园里散步。
words.en: A garden where roses are cultivated.

words.tr: phrase. 培训课程；训练课程
words.ex: He joined a training course last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周参加了一个培训课程。
words.en: A training course is a series of lessons or lectures teaching the skills that you need for a particular job or activity.

words.ex: She works at the front desk of the hotel.
words.ex_cn: 她在酒店的前台工作。
words.en: The front desk is the place in a hotel, office building, or other establishment where visitors are greeted and dealt with.

words.tr: phrase. 资深同事；年长或职位较高的同事
words.ex: He asked his senior colleagues for advice.
words.ex_cn: 他向他的资深同事寻求建议。
words.en: Experienced or higher-ranking coworkers.

words.ex: The company publishes an annual report every year.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司每年发布一份年度报告。
words.en: A document prepared by a company at the end of each year, giving details of its financial performance and activities over the year.

words.tr: phrase. 行业刊物；贸易杂志
words.ex: He reads trade journals to learn about new products.
words.ex_cn: 他阅读行业期刊以了解新产品。
words.en: Trade journals are publications that focus on a specific industry or trade, providing news, analysis, and information relevant to professionals in that field.

words.ex: He keeps spare socks in his drawer.
words.ex_cn: 他把备用袜子放在抽屉里。
words.en: Spare socks are extra socks that you keep with you in case you need to change your socks.

words.tr: phrase. 塑料文件夹；塑料资料夹
words.ex: He put the papers in a plastic folder.
words.ex_cn: 他把文件放在一个塑料文件夹里。
words.en: A flexible, often transparent container made of plastic, used for organizing and storing documents.

words.tr: phrase. 健身中心；健身场所
words.ex: He goes to the fitness center every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上去健身中心。
words.en: A fitness center is a place where people go to exercise and improve their physical health, typically equipped with various workout machines and offering fitness classes.

words.ex: He uses the fitness suite every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上使用健身房。
words.en: A fitness suite is a room or area equipped with machines and equipment for physical exercise and training.

words.tr: phrase. 忠实顾客；忠诚客户
words.ex: He is a loyal customer who buys from this store every week.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位忠实顾客，每周都来这家店购物。
words.en: A loyal customer is someone who regularly buys products or services from a particular business because they like the quality, service, etc., and not because of lower prices or other reasons.

words.tr: phrase. 罗马帝国（公元前27年—公元476年，以地中海为中心横跨欧洲、北非和西亚的古代帝国）
words.ex: The Roman Empire ruled many countries long ago.
words.ex_cn: 罗马帝国很久以前统治了许多国家。
words.en: The Roman Empire was the post-Republican period of ancient Rome, characterized by an autocratic form of government and large territorial holdings around the Mediterranean in Europe, Africa, and Asia.

words.tr: phrase. 整个星期；完整的一周
words.ex: He stayed at home for the whole week.
words.ex_cn: 他整个星期都待在家里。
words.en: The entire period of seven days from Monday to Sunday.

words.tr: phrase. 野餐地点；适合野餐的场所
words.ex: We found a quiet picnic spot near the lake.
words.ex_cn: 我们在湖边找到了一个安静的野餐地点。
words.en: A picnic spot refers to a place where people can have a picnic, typically outdoors and often in a scenic or pleasant environment.

words.ex: The doctor walked into the surgery room quickly.
words.ex_cn: 医生迅速走进了手术室。
words.en: A room in a hospital where surgical operations are performed.

words.ex: He went to the post office to send a letter.
words.ex_cn: 他去邮局寄信。
words.en: A post office is a public department or corporation responsible for mail services, including the acceptance, transmission, and delivery of letters and parcels.

words.ex: He waits for the bus at the bus stop.
words.ex_cn: 他在公交站等公交车。
words.en: A place on a bus route where buses regularly stop to pick up and drop off passengers.

words.tr: phrase. 草地营地；位于草地上的露营地点
words.ex: We set up our tent at the meadow campsite near the lake.
words.ex_cn: 我们在湖边的草地露营地搭起了帐篷。
words.en: A meadow campsite refers to a camping area located in a meadow, offering a natural and serene environment for outdoor activities.

words.tr: phrase. 取款机；现金提款机（用于从银行账户中提取现金的自动机器）
words.ex: He withdrew money from the cash point.
words.ex_cn: 他从自动取款机取了钱。
words.en: A cash point is a machine, usually in a wall outside a bank, from which you can take money out of your bank account using a special card.

words.tr: phrase. 病历；医疗记录；医学档案
words.ex: The doctor checked my medical records.
words.ex_cn: 医生查看了我的医疗记录。
words.en: Medical records are documents that contain a patient's health history, diagnoses, treatments, and outcomes. They are used by healthcare professionals to ensure the continuity of care.

words.ex: He is watching TV in the mediaroom.
words.ex_cn: 他正在媒体室里看电视。
words.en: A mediaroom is a room equipped with facilities for the media, such as for press conferences or media events.

words.ex: He loves wood carving on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在周末进行木雕。
words.en: Wood carving is the process of shaping wood into a desired form, figure, or design by cutting with a sharp tool.

words.tr: phrase. 艺术展览；美术展览
words.ex: They visited an art exhibition last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他们上周末参观了一个艺术展览。
words.en: An art exhibition is a public display of works of art, often in a museum or gallery, where people can view and appreciate the artwork.

words.ex: He loves creating oil painting on canvas.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在画布上创作油画艺术。
words.en: An oil painting is a picture that has been painted using oil paints.

words.tr: phrase. 健康中心；医疗中心（提供基本医疗服务的机构）
words.ex: He went to the health centre for a check-up.
words.ex_cn: 他去健康中心做检查。
words.en: A health centre is a building or a place where people can go for medical treatment or advice.

words.tr: phrase. 画廊商店；美术馆内的销售店铺
words.ex: She bought a painting from the gallery shop.
words.ex_cn: 她从画廊商店买了一幅画。
words.en: A gallery shop is a store that sells artworks, often located within or associated with an art gallery.

words.ex: The teacher created a quiet learning zone for students to focus.
words.ex_cn: 老师创建了一个安静的学习区，让学生们专心学习。
words.en: An area designated for the purpose of studying or acquiring knowledge, often characterized by resources and an environment conducive to learning.

words.ex: We read chapter eight last night.
words.ex_cn: 我们昨晚读了第八章。
words.en: The eighth section of a book, report, or other written work.

words.ex: The lock uses a simple combination of three numbers.
words.ex_cn: 这个锁使用三个数字的简单组合。
words.en: A combination is a mixture of things or people that are combined.

words.ex: The reproduction of rabbits is very fast.
words.ex_cn: 兔子的生殖速度很快。
words.en: The process of producing offspring or new individuals of the same species, or the act of making a copy of something.

words.ex: Farmers work hard in agriculture.
words.ex_cn: 农民在农业中辛勤工作。
words.en: The science or practice of farming, including cultivation of the soil for the growing of crops and the rearing of animals to provide food, wool, and other products.

words.tr:
n. 淀粉；淀粉浆
v. 给（布）上浆
words.ex: The potato contains a lot of starch.
words.ex_cn: 土豆含有大量淀粉。
words.en: A carbohydrate that is the chief form of stored energy in plants, especially in seeds and tubers. It is also used in cooking and as a stiffening agent in textiles.

words.ex: He eats eggs for protein.
words.ex_cn: 他吃鸡蛋来获取蛋白质。
words.en: Proteins are large, complex molecules that play many critical roles in the body. They are necessary for the structure, function, and regulation of the body's tissues and organs.

words.ex: The city needs better infrastructure for roads and water.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市需要更好的道路和供水设施。
words.en: The basic physical and organizational structures and facilities (e.g., buildings, roads, power supplies) needed for the operation of a society or enterprise.

words.ex: The critics praised the new movie.
words.ex_cn: 评论家们称赞了这部新电影。
words.en: A critic is a person who expresses opinions about the good and bad qualities of books, films, music, etc.

words.ex: The photo showed an enlargement of the tiny letter.
words.ex_cn: 这张照片展示了那个小字母的放大版。
words.en: The act of making something larger or the state of being made larger.

words.ex: The extinction of dinosaurs happened millions of years ago.
words.ex_cn: 恐龙的灭绝发生在数百万年前。
words.en: The state or process of a species, family, or larger group being or becoming extinct.

words.ex: The circulation of blood keeps us alive.
words.ex_cn: 血液的循环让我们活着。
words.en: The movement of something such as money or goods from place to place or from person to person; the number of copies of a newspaper or magazine that are sold.

words.tr: adj. 有免疫力的；免疫的；不受影响的；
words.ex: Children are immune to this disease after vaccination.
words.ex_cn: 儿童接种疫苗后对这种疾病有免疫力。
words.en: If you are immune to a particular disease, you cannot be affected by it. If you are immune to something such as criticism, it does not affect you.

words.ex: The wound caused a serious infection.
words.ex_cn: 伤口引起了严重的感染。
words.en: An infection is a disease caused by microorganisms such as bacteria, viruses, or parasites invading the body.

words.ex: The magnet picks up the iron nail.
words.ex_cn: 磁铁吸起了铁钉。
words.en: A magnet is a piece of iron or other material which attracts iron or steel towards it.

words.tr:
n. 实验；试验；
v. 做试验；进行实验；
words.ex: The boy did a science experiment in class.
words.ex_cn: 这个男孩在课堂上做了一个科学实验。
words.en: An experiment is a scientific procedure undertaken to make a discovery, test a hypothesis, or demonstrate a known fact.

words.ex: He looked at me with confusion.
words.ex_cn: 他困惑地看着我。
words.en: A state of uncertainty about what is happening, intended, or required.

words.ex: The team knits their efforts to win the game.
words.ex_cn: 团队紧密合作以赢得比赛。
words.en: To make clothes, etc. by using two long needles to connect wool or another type of thread into joined rows.

words.tr:
n. 壳体；贝壳；炮弹；
v. 剥…的壳；去…的皮；炮轰；炮击；
words.ex: The crab crawled out of its shell.
words.ex_cn: 螃蟹从它的壳里爬了出来。
words.en: A shell is the hard protective outer case of a mollusk or crustacean, or the outer layer of an egg, nut, or seed. It can also refer to a metal case filled with explosive, to be fired from a gun.

words.ex: He showed maturity when he apologized for his mistake.
words.ex_cn: 当他为自己的错误道歉时，表现出了成熟。
words.en: Maturity is the state of being fully developed or grown, or the time when a financial arrangement becomes ready to be paid.

words.ex: He received compensation for his injured leg.
words.ex_cn: 他因腿部受伤获得了赔偿。
words.en: Compensation is something, typically money, awarded to someone in recognition of loss, suffering, or injury.

words.tr:
n. 谣言
v. 谣传
words.ex: The rumor spread quickly that the school would close.
words.ex_cn: 学校即将关闭的谣言迅速传播开来。
words.en: A rumor is a story or piece of information that may or may not be true, but that people are talking about.

words.ex: The intensity of the sunlight made me wear sunglasses.
words.ex_cn: 阳光的强度让我戴上了太阳镜。
words.en: The quality of being intense, especially in terms of concentration, power, or force.

words.ex: The hurricane destroyed many houses.
words.ex_cn: 飓风摧毁了许多房屋。
words.en: A hurricane is an extremely violent wind or storm.

words.ex: Many immigrants work hard to build a new life.
words.ex_cn: 许多移民努力工作以建立新的生活。
words.en: Immigrants are people who come to live permanently in a foreign country.

words.ex: His participation in the meeting was very important.
words.ex_cn: 他参与会议非常重要。
words.en: The act of taking part in something.

words.ex: The population of this city is growing fast.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市的人口正在快速增长。
words.en: The number of people living in a particular area, city, or country; the total number of people who live in a place.

words.tr: n. 译本；翻译( translation的名词复数 )；
words.ex: The library has many translations of classic novels.
words.ex_cn: 图书馆有很多经典小说的译本。
words.en: The process or result of expressing the meaning of words or text from one language into another.

words.ex: The teacher gave an assessment of the students' work.
words.ex_cn: 老师对学生的作品进行了评估。
words.en: An assessment is a judgment about something, especially about how good or bad it is, or an amount that is calculated for something, especially for tax purposes.

words.ex: He protects the environment by recycling.
words.ex_cn: 他通过回收利用来保护环境。
words.en: The environment is the natural world in which people, animals, and plants live.

words.ex: He won three competitions last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年赢得了三场比赛。
words.en: Competitions are events in which people or teams compete against each other in order to win.

words.ex: Follow the procedure step by step.
words.ex_cn: 一步一步地按照步骤进行。
words.en: A procedure is a way of doing something, especially the usual or correct way.

words.ex: This plant is resistant to drought.
words.ex_cn: 这种植物对干旱有抵抗力。
words.en: If someone is resistant to something, they are opposed to it and want to prevent it.

words.ex: This jacket is waterproof.
words.ex_cn: 这件夹克是防水的。
words.en: Something that is waterproof does not let water pass through it.

words.ex: He overfilled the cup with water.
words.ex_cn: 他把杯子装得水都溢出来了。
words.en: To fill something beyond its capacity or beyond what is necessary.

words.ex: The rubber band is elastic.
words.ex_cn: 橡皮筋是有弹性的。
words.en: An elastic material is able to stretch and then return to its original shape or size.

words.tr: n. 观察；观测；注意；监视；(观察后的）意见；
words.ex: The scientist made an observation about the bird's behavior.
words.ex_cn: 科学家对这只鸟的行为进行了观察。
words.en: The act of noticing or watching something carefully in order to gain information.

words.ex: The two teams are strong rivals in the league.
words.ex_cn: 这两支队伍是联赛中的强劲竞争者。
words.en: If you say that someone or something has no rivals or is without rival, you mean that it is the best of its type.

words.ex: He read a biography of Nelson Mandela.
words.ex_cn: 他读了一本关于纳尔逊·曼德拉的传记。
words.en: A biography is a detailed description of a person's life. It involves more than just the basic facts like education, work, relationships, and death; it portrays a person's experience of these life events.

words.ex: He is learning theoretical physics at university.
words.ex_cn: 他正在大学学习理论物理。
words.en: A theoretical study or explanation is based on or uses the ideas and abstract principles of a subject, rather than the practical aspects or uses of it.

words.ex: The birds nest on the high cliffs.
words.ex_cn: 鸟儿在高高的悬崖上筑巢。
words.en: A cliff is a high area of land with a very steep side, especially one next to the sea.

words.ex: The church has a big dome above the altar.
words.ex_cn: 教堂的祭坛上方有一个大穹顶。
words.en: A dome is a rounded vault made of either curved segments or a shell of revolution, meaning an arch rotated around its central vertical axis.

words.tr: n. 资金；款项；拨款； v. “fund”的现在分词；
words.ex: The school needs more funding for new books.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校需要更多资金来购买新书。
words.en: Funding is money which is used to pay for a particular activity or to help achieve a particular purpose.

words.tr:
adj. 专业的；职业的；
n. 专业人士；
words.ex: He is a professional teacher with many years of experience.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位有多年经验的专业教师。
words.en: A professional is a person who has a job that requires special training and education, especially one that involves a high level of skill or knowledge.

words.ex: The administration of the school is very organized.
words.ex_cn: 学校的行政管理非常有条理。
words.en: The process or activity of running a business, organization, etc., or the people who run it.

words.tr:
n. 制造；
v. （用机器大量）制造；虚构；捏造；
words.ex: The manufacture of cars needs many workers.
words.ex_cn: 汽车的制造需要很多工人。
words.en: To manufacture something means to make it in a factory, usually in large quantities.

words.tr: n. 劳动力；工人总数；职工总数；
words.ex: The factory needs a larger workforce to meet demand.
words.ex_cn: 工厂需要更多的劳动力来满足需求。
words.en: The workforce is the total number of people who are employed by a particular company or who are available to work in a particular country or area.

words.ex: The car moved to the right lane to turn.
words.ex_cn: 汽车驶入右侧车道转弯。
words.en: A lane is a narrow road, especially in the country. A lane is also one of the parts into which a wide road is divided, each of which is intended for vehicles moving in the same direction.

words.ex: The exploration of space takes many years.
words.ex_cn: 太空探索需要很多年。
words.en: The act of searching for the purpose of discovery of information or resources.

words.tr: n. 陶器；制陶手艺；陶器作坊；
words.ex: He makes pottery in his backyard studio.
