words.ex_cn: 他在后院的工作室制作陶器。
words.en: Objects such as pots, dishes, and vases that are made out of clay and then baked at high temperatures to make them hard.

words.tr:
n. 燃料；燃油；
v. 加剧；
words.ex: The rocket uses fuel 627 for propulsion.
words.ex_cn: 火箭使用627号燃料推进。
words.en: Fuel is a substance such as coal, gas, or oil that is burned to provide heat or power.

words.tr: v. 倡导废除移民；反对移民
words.ex: The government decided to axe immigration quotas.
words.ex_cn: 政府决定取消移民配额。
words.en: A term combining 'axe' and 'immigration,' suggesting a harsh or abrupt approach to migration policy.

words.ex: He looked up the country in an atlas.
words.ex_cn: 他在地图册里查找那个国家。
words.en: An atlas is a book of maps or charts.

words.ex: Asia is the largest continent.
words.ex_cn: 亚洲是最大的洲。
words.en: A continent is a very large area of land, such as Africa or Asia, that consists of several countries.

words.ex: He is an intermediate student in English.
words.ex_cn: 他是英语的中级学生。
words.en: An intermediate stage, level, or position is one that occurs between two other stages, levels, or positions.

words.ex: This portable charger works well on trips.
words.ex_cn: 这个便携式充电器在旅行时很好用。
words.en: Capable of being carried or moved about with ease.

words.tr: n. 包装；装箱；包装物； v. “package”的现在分词；
words.ex: The packaging of the gift was very beautiful.
words.ex_cn: 这份礼物的包装非常漂亮。
words.en: The materials in which goods are wrapped or packed, especially commercially.

words.tr: v. 集中；浓缩；“concentrate”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 浓缩的；密集的；全神贯注的；
words.ex: He concentrated on his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他专心做作业。
words.en: If something is concentrated, it has been made stronger or purer by removing or reducing the amount of other substances in it.

words.ex: The tree grows in a vertical line.
words.ex_cn: 这棵树垂直生长。
words.en: Something that is vertical stands or points straight up.

words.ex: He kept the dishes in the cabinet.
words.ex_cn: 他把盘子放在储藏柜里。
words.en: A cabinet is a piece of furniture with doors and shelves or drawers, used for storing or showing things. In politics, a cabinet is a group of people who are chosen by a head of state to give advice and to help set government policy.

words.ex: He is an architect who designs houses.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位设计房屋的建筑师。
words.en: An architect is a person who designs buildings and advises in their construction.

words.tr:
n. 液体；
adj. 液态的；
words.ex: Water is a common liquid.
words.ex_cn: 水是一种常见的液体。
words.en: A liquid is a substance which is not solid but which flows and can be poured, for example water.

words.ex: The company must follow the safety regulations.
words.ex_cn: 公司必须遵守安全条例。
words.en: Regulations are rules or laws designed to control the way that something happens or is done.

words.tr:
adj. 固体的；坚固的；可靠的；
n. 固体；
words.ex: Ice is a solid form of water.
words.ex_cn: 冰是水的固体形式。
words.en: A solid substance or object stays the same shape whether it is in a container or not.

words.ex: Carbon is an element in all living things.
words.ex_cn: 碳是所有生物体中的一种元素。
words.en: Carbon is a chemical element with symbol C and atomic number 6. It is nonmetallic and tetravalent—making four electrons available to form covalent chemical bonds.

words.ex: The ozone and nitrogen react in the air.
words.ex_cn: 臭氧和氮气在空气中发生反应。
words.en: A chemical compound (O₃) formed from oxygen, often used in disinfection and air purification.

words.ex: He sat on a wooden chair.
words.ex_cn: 他坐在一张木制椅子上。
words.en: Made of wood; lacking ease or grace.

words.ex: Bacteria can make you sick.
words.ex_cn: 细菌会让你生病。
words.en: Bacteria are very small organisms. Some bacteria can cause diseases.

words.ex: The soil has too much moisture.
words.ex_cn: 土壤中有太多湿气。
words.en: Moisture is tiny drops of water in the air, on a surface, or in a substance, that make it feel wet.

words.tr:
v. 抽水；打气；
n. 泵；抽水机；打气机；
words.ex: He pumps water from the well every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上从井里抽水。
words.en: A pump is a device that moves fluids (liquids or gases), or sometimes slurries, by mechanical action. Pumps can be classified into three major groups according to the method they use to move the fluid: direct lift, displacement, and gravity pumps.

words.ex: Obesity is a serious health problem in many countries.
words.ex_cn: 肥胖是许多国家的一个严重健康问题。
words.en: Obesity is a medical condition in which excess body fat has accumulated to the extent that it may have a negative effect on health.

words.ex: This car is economical because it uses little fuel.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车很经济，因为它耗油少。
words.en: Using money, resources, or time in a careful and effective way.

words.ex: His perception of the sound was very sharp.
words.ex_cn: 他对声音的感知非常敏锐。
words.en: Your perception of something is the way that you think about it or the impression you have of it.

words.tr:
adv. 仍然；还是；
adj. 静止的；
words.ex: He is still waiting for the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他仍然在等公交车。
words.en: If a situation that used to exist still exists, it has continued and exists now.

words.ex: The doctor gave me antibiotics for my infection.
words.ex_cn: 医生给我开了抗生素来治疗感染。
words.en: Antibiotics are medicines that are used to treat infections caused by bacteria.

words.tr: n. 地平线；思想等的范围；眼界；
words.ex: The sun set below the horizon.
words.ex_cn: 太阳在地平线以下落山。
words.en: The horizon is the line at which the earth's surface and the sky appear to meet.

words.ex: The mountains look distant from here.
words.ex_cn: 从这里看，山显得很远。
words.en: If you describe something as distant, you mean that it is far away in space or time.

words.ex: We will discuss the main events in chapter nine.
words.ex_cn: 我们将在第九章讨论主要事件。
words.en: The ninth section of a book or document.

words.ex: His workload is too heavy this week.
words.ex_cn: 他这周的工作量太大了。
words.en: The amount of work to be done by someone, especially in a particular period of time.

words.tr: v. 吃；喂；“feed”的现在分词； n. 饲养；给食；
words.ex: The baby is feeding on milk.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿正在喝奶。
words.en: The act of giving food to a person or an animal.

words.tr:
n. 混凝土；
adj. 具体的；
words.ex: The workers poured concrete to build the foundation.
words.ex_cn: 工人们浇筑混凝土来建造地基。
words.en: Concrete is a hard, strong construction material made by mixing a cementing material (such as Portland cement) and a mineral aggregate (such as sand and gravel) with sufficient water to cause the cement to set and bind the entire mass. In a broader sense, concrete can also refer to something that is tangible, specific, or real.

words.ex: The two shirts are identical.
words.ex_cn: 这两件衬衫是一样的。
words.en: Exactly the same, or very similar.

words.ex: He shows high intelligence in solving math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他在解决数学问题时表现出很高的智力。
words.en: The ability to acquire and apply knowledge and skills.

words.ex: The farmer stores hay in the barn.
words.ex_cn: 农夫把干草存放在谷仓里。
words.en: A barn is a large building on a farm in which crops or animals are kept.

words.ex: He was sent to prison for stealing.
words.ex_cn: 他因偷窃被送进了监狱。
words.en: A prison is a building where criminals are kept as punishment or where people accused of a crime are kept before their trial.

words.ex: The rainbow appears after the rain.
words.ex_cn: 雨后出现了彩虹。
words.en: A rainbow is an arch of different colors that appears in the sky when the sun shines through rain.

words.tr: n. 针脚；线迹；“stitch”的现在分词；
words.ex: The stitching on the jacket is very tight.
words.ex_cn: 这件夹克的针脚非常紧密。
words.en: Stitching refers to the act of sewing or the lines of thread that have been sewn in something.

words.tr: n. 女权运动；男女平等主义
words.ex: She believes in feminism and wants equal rights for women.
words.ex_cn: 她相信女权主义，希望女性享有平等权利。
words.en: Feminism is the belief and aim that women should have the same rights, power, and opportunities as men.

words.ex: This bag is durable and lasts for years.
words.ex_cn: 这个包很耐用，可以用很多年。
words.en: Something that is durable is strong and lasts a long time without breaking or becoming weaker.

words.ex: It's a myth that eating late at night causes weight gain.
words.ex_cn: 晚上吃东西会导致发胖，这是一种错误观念。
words.en: A myth is a traditional story, especially one concerning the early history of a people or explaining some natural or social phenomenon, and typically involving supernatural beings or events.

words.ex: The bird has a soft feather.
words.ex_cn: 这只鸟有一根柔软的羽毛。
words.en: One of the light, horny structures that form the principal covering of birds.

words.tr:
n. 竖琴
v. 反复诉说；唠叨
words.ex: She plays the harp beautifully at concerts.
words.ex_cn: 她在音乐会上优美地演奏竖琴。
words.en: A harp is a large musical instrument consisting of a triangular frame with vertical strings which you pluck with your fingers. If someone harps on about something, they keep talking about it in a way that other people find annoying.

words.tr: adj. 家庭的；国内的；驯养的；
words.ex: She prefers domestic chores over going out.
words.ex_cn: 她更喜欢做家务而不是外出。
words.en: Domestic means relating to the home, family, or household affairs. It can also refer to something that is made or produced within a country and not imported.

words.ex: The table has a rectangular shape.
words.ex_cn: 这张桌子是矩形的。
words.en: Something that is rectangular has the shape of a rectangle.

words.tr: n. 需优先考虑的事；优先权；
words.ex: Homework is my top priority.
words.ex_cn: 作业是我最需要优先考虑的事。
words.en: If something is a priority, it is the most important thing you have to do or deal with, or must be done or dealt with before everything else you have to do.

words.ex: The movie shows realism by depicting everyday life honestly.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影通过真实地描绘日常生活展现现实主义。
words.en: Realism is the quality or fact of representing a person, thing, or situation accurately or in a way that is true to life.

words.ex: His status in the company is very high.
words.ex_cn: 他在公司里的地位很高。
words.en: The status of someone or something is their position or situation according to the law or according to other people's opinions.

words.ex: The dog jumped over the fence.
words.ex_cn: 狗跳过了栅栏。
words.en: A fence is a barrier between two areas of land, made of wood or wire supported by posts. If you fence an area of land, you surround it with a fence.

words.ex: He works in marketing for a tech company.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家科技公司从事营销工作。
words.en: Marketing involves the process of promoting, selling, and distributing a product or service. It includes market research and advertising.

words.ex: The museum focuses on the preservation of old books.
words.ex_cn: 博物馆专注于旧书的保存。
words.en: The act of keeping something in its original state or in good condition.

words.tr: n. 保护；节约（自然资源）；
words.ex: The park is for the conservation of wild animals.
words.ex_cn: 这个公园是为了保护野生动物。
words.en: The protection and preservation of the natural environment and wildlife.

words.ex: The river is dirty because of pollution.
words.ex_cn: 这条河因为污染而变得肮脏。
words.en: Pollution is the process of making air, water, soil, etc. dirty and not safe or suitable to use.

words.tr: n. 栖息地；居留地；产地；
words.ex: The panda's habitat is in the mountains of China.
words.ex_cn: 熊猫的栖息地在中国的山区。
words.en: The natural environment in which a species or group of species lives.

words.tr:
v. 估算；估价；
n. 估价；估算；
words.ex: Can you estimate how long it will take?
words.ex_cn: 你能估算一下需要多长时间吗？
words.en: If you estimate a quantity or value, you make an approximate judgment or calculation of it.

words.ex: The frequency of the radio station is 101.5 MHz.
words.ex_cn: 这个电台的频率是101.5兆赫。
words.en: The rate at which something happens or is repeated over a particular period of time.

words.tr: n. 洪水泛滥； v. 淹没；“flood”的现在分词；
words.ex: The heavy rain caused flooding in the city.
words.ex_cn: 大雨导致了城市洪水泛滥。
words.en: Flooding refers to the overflow of water onto land that is normally dry, often caused by heavy rainfall, melting snow, or the failure of dams or levees.

words.ex: The teacher gave a satisfactory grade.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了一个令人满意的分数。
words.en: If something is satisfactory, it is good enough or acceptable.

words.tr: v. 保存；保护；保持；“preserve”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 防腐的；
words.ex: The old photos were preserved in a box.
words.ex_cn: 这些旧照片被保存在一个盒子里。
words.en: Kept in its original state or in good condition, especially over a long period of time.

words.tr: v. 埋葬；埋藏；“bury”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 埋在地下的；
words.ex: They buried the dog in the backyard.
words.ex_cn: 他们把狗埋在了后院里。
words.en: If something is buried, it is placed in a hole in the ground and covered with earth, or it is hidden or concealed in some way.

words.ex: The city hosts many art exhibitions every year.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市每年举办许多艺术展览。
words.en: A public display of works of art or other items of interest, held in an art gallery or museum or at a trade fair.

words.ex: The town is famous for its potteries.
words.ex_cn: 这个小镇以它的陶瓷制品闻名。
words.en: Potteries refer to objects made from clay and hardened by heat, or the place where such objects are made.

words.tr:
n. 影响力；冲击（力）；
v. 对…产生影响；
words.ex: The new law had a big impact on education.
words.ex_cn: 这项新法律对教育产生了重大影响。
words.en: The effect or influence of one person, thing, or action, on another.

words.ex: The barn is used for storage of grain.
words.ex_cn: 这个谷仓用于粮食的贮存。
words.en: The act of storing something or the space where things are stored.

words.ex: He looks at the bug through a microscope.
words.ex_cn: 他通过显微镜观察这只虫子。
words.en: An instrument used for viewing objects that are too small to be seen by the naked eye, especially one that uses a combination of lenses to produce a magnified image.

words.ex: He uses fertilizer to help his plants grow.
words.ex_cn: 他用肥料帮助植物生长。
words.en: A substance that is added to soil to improve the growth of plants.

words.ex: The cake has a sweet flavor.
words.ex_cn: 这个蛋糕有一种甜味。
words.en: The flavor of a food or drink is its taste, especially a pleasant or distinctive one.

words.tr: n. 变老；老化； v. “age”的现在分词；
words.ex: Aging is a natural part of life.
words.ex_cn: 变老是生命的一部分。
words.en: The process of becoming older or more mature.

words.ex: He was sent to jail for stealing.
words.ex_cn: 他因偷窃被送进了监狱。
words.en: A place where people are kept as a punishment for a crime they have committed, or while they are waiting to go to court for their trial.

words.ex: The police caught the men who committed crimes.
words.ex_cn: 警察抓到了那些犯下罪行的人。
words.en: Crimes are illegal actions or activities for which a person can be punished by law.

words.ex: The school needs more resources for students.
words.ex_cn: 学校需要为学生提供更多的资源。
words.en: Resources are materials, money, and other assets that can be used to function effectively.

words.ex: He found a weapon in the old box.
words.ex_cn: 他在旧箱子里发现了一件武器。
words.en: A weapon is an object that can be used to harm or kill someone, or to damage or destroy something.

words.ex: The word means different things in different context.
words.ex_cn: 这个词在不同的上下文中意思不同。
words.en: The context of an idea or event is the general situation that relates to it, and which helps it to be understood.

words.tr: n. 历史遗迹；纪念碑；“monument”的复数；
words.ex: Many tourists visit ancient monuments in Rome.
words.ex_cn: 许多游客参观罗马的古代历史遗迹。
words.en: A monument is a structure, statue, or building that is built to honor a special person or event.

words.ex: The legend says a dragon lives in the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 传说有一条龙住在山里。
words.en: A legend is a very old and popular story that may be true or may be imaginary.

words.ex: He has a good reputation for honesty.
words.ex_cn: 他以诚实著称。
words.en: The opinion that people have about someone or something because of what has happened in the past.

words.ex: He visits a religious temple every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周日都去一座宗教寺庙。
words.en: Relating to or believing in a religion.

words.ex: The ruler made laws for his people.
words.ex_cn: 这位统治者为他的人民制定法律。
words.en: A ruler is a person who governs or commands. It can also refer to a straight strip or cylinder of plastic, wood, metal, or other rigid material, typically marked at regular intervals and used to draw straight lines or measure distances.

words.ex: She knits a sweater from wool.
words.ex_cn: 她用羊毛织毛衣。
words.en: Wool is the hair that grows on sheep and some other animals, which is used to make clothes, blankets, etc.

words.ex: The train went through a long tunnel.
words.ex_cn: 火车通过了一条长长的隧道。
words.en: A tunnel is a long passage which has been made under or through the ground, usually through a hill or under a river, to allow people or vehicles to travel through it.

words.ex: We visited an art gallery on Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 我们周日参观了一家艺术画廊。
words.en: A gallery is a place where works of art are shown to the public.

words.tr: n. 同龄人；同辈；“peer”的复数；
words.ex: He talks more freely with his peers.
words.ex_cn: 他和同龄人在一起时更放松。
words.en: People who are the same age or have the same status as you.

words.ex: He showed patience while waiting for the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他在等公交车时表现出了耐心。
words.en: The ability to stay calm and not get angry, especially when there is a difficulty or you have to wait a long time.

words.ex: He works in a laboratory on Fridays.
words.ex_cn: 他在星期五去实验室工作。
words.en: A laboratory is a place equipped for scientific research, experiments, or teaching.

words.ex: The dictionary gives a clear definition of the word.
words.ex_cn: 词典给出了这个词的清晰定义。
words.en: A statement of the exact meaning of a word, phrase, or concept.

words.ex: He ate grilled shrimp for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚餐吃了烤虾。
words.en: A shrimp is a small shellfish with a long tail and many legs, which can be eaten as food.

words.tr:
v. 交配繁殖；饲养；
n. 品种；
words.ex: The farmers breed cows to get more milk.
words.ex_cn: 农民让奶牛交配繁殖以获得更多牛奶。
words.en: If you breed animals or plants, you keep them for the purpose of producing more animals or plants with particular qualities, in a controlled way.

words.ex: He completed the registration for the course.
words.ex_cn: 他完成了这门课程的登记。
words.en: Registration is the act of officially recording something, especially in an official list or record.

words.ex: The subcommittee met to discuss the budget.
words.ex_cn: 小组委员会开会讨论预算。
words.en: A subcommittee is a smaller committee formed from a main committee to concentrate on a specific task or area.

words.ex: He showed his qualifications for the job.
words.ex_cn: 他展示了自己胜任这份工作的资格。
words.en: The skills, qualities, or experience that you need in order to do something.

words.tr:
n. 漏洞；泄露；
v. 漏；泄露；
words.ex: The leak in the roof caused water to drip inside.
words.ex_cn: 屋顶的漏洞导致水滴进屋里。
words.en: If a container or pipe leaks, or if it leaks a substance such as liquid or gas, the substance comes out of it accidentally because there is a hole or crack in it.

words.ex: The bright lights caused stimulation in her eyes.
words.ex_cn: 明亮的灯光引起了她眼睛的刺激。
words.en: The act of arousing or accelerating physiological or psychological activity or response in an organism or any of its parts.

words.ex: The evolution of birds from dinosaurs took millions of years.
words.ex_cn: 鸟类从恐龙进化而来花了数百万年。
words.en: The gradual development of something, especially from a simple to a more complex form.

words.ex: The triangle has three sides.
words.ex_cn: 这个三角形有三条边。
words.en: A triangle is a shape consisting of three straight lines and three angles.

words.tr:
adj. 地下的；
n. 地铁；地下；
adv. 在地下；
words.ex: The underground tunnel connects two buildings.
words.ex_cn: 这条地下的隧道连接了两座建筑。
words.en: Something that is underground is below the surface of the ground. It can also refer to secret activities or organizations.

words.tr:
n. 注意；通知；
v. 注意；留心；通知；
words.ex: He gave a notice about the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他发布了关于会议的通知。
words.en: If you notice something or someone, you become aware of them.

words.tr:
n. 板；董事会；
v. 上船（或火车、飞机等）；
words.ex: He nailed the picture to the board.
words.ex_cn: 他把照片钉在板上。
words.en: A board is a flat, thin, rectangular piece of wood or other material used for a particular purpose, such as cutting food on or as a surface for writing or playing games. It can also refer to a group of people who manage or control a company or organization, or to the meals provided by an institution such as a school or hospital. As a verb, it means to get onto a ship, aircraft, or other vehicle, or to provide meals and lodging for someone.

words.tr:
n. 挑战；
v. 提出挑战；
words.ex: Climbing that mountain is a big challenge.
words.ex_cn: 爬那座山是一个巨大的挑战。
words.en: A challenge is something new and difficult which requires great effort and determination.

words.ex: The teacher will distribute the books to students.
words.ex_cn: 老师将把书分发给学生。
words.en: If you distribute things, you hand them or deliver them to a number of people.

words.ex: We are reading chapter ten in our history book.
words.ex_cn: 我们正在历史课本中阅读第十章。
words.en: The tenth section of a book, report, or other written work, typically containing a distinct topic or part of the narrative.

words.ex: His comprehension of the story was very good.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个故事的理解很好。
words.en: Comprehension is the ability to understand something.

words.tr: n. 工作场所；工作地点；
words.ex: The new safety rules apply to the workplace.
words.ex_cn: 新的安全规则适用于工作场所。
words.en: A workplace is a place where people work, such as an office or factory.

words.tr: n. 工作量过重导致的贫困；因工作负担过重而无法摆脱的贫困状态
words.ex: He struggles with heavy workload and poverty.
words.ex_cn: 他面临着繁重的工作量和贫困。
words.en: A state of extreme financial hardship where individuals or families cannot meet basic needs despite working.

words.tr: n. 相互作用；相互影响；互动交流；
words.ex: The interaction between the two chemicals causes a reaction.
words.ex_cn: 这两种化学物质之间的相互作用引起反应。
words.en: An interaction is a situation where two or more people or things communicate with or react to each other.

words.ex: He felt an obligation to help his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他感到有义务帮助他的朋友。
words.en: An obligation is something that you must do because you have promised, because of a law, etc.

words.ex: His expectation was to pass the test.
words.ex_cn: 他的期待是通过考试。
words.en: An expectation is a belief about what might happen in the future, especially about something that you think is likely or that you hope will happen.

words.ex: He solved the problem rationally.
words.ex_cn: 他理性地解决了这个问题。
words.en: In a logical and reasonable manner, based on facts or reason rather than emotions or feelings.

words.ex: Birds fly south by instinct.
words.ex_cn: 鸟类凭本能飞向南方。
words.en: An instinct is the natural tendency that a person or animal has to behave or react in a particular way.

words.ex: There is a possibility of rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 明天有可能下雨。
words.en: A possibility is a situation that might happen or something that might be true.

words.ex: The factory improved its productivity by using new machines.
words.ex_cn: 工厂通过使用新机器提高了生产率。
words.en: Productivity is the rate at which goods are produced or work is completed.

words.ex: His performance in the game was excellent.
words.ex_cn: 他在比赛中的表现非常出色。
words.en: The act of performing a play, concert, or some other form of entertainment.

words.ex: The doctor checked his red blood cell count.
words.ex_cn: 医生检查了他的红细胞计数。
words.en: A red blood cell is one of the cells in your blood that carries oxygen from your lungs to all parts of your body.

words.ex: A shark swam near the beach.
words.ex_cn: 一条鲨鱼在海滩附近游动。
words.en: A shark is a large fish that lives in the sea and has very sharp teeth.

words.tr: adj. 加强的； v. 增强；“reinforce”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The concrete wall is reinforced with steel bars.
words.ex_cn: 这堵混凝土墙用钢筋加固了。
words.en: To reinforce something means to make it stronger or more able to withstand pressure, especially by adding extra material or support.

words.tr: n. 出版商；出版公司；出版社（publisher 的复数）；
words.ex: The publishers released a new book last month.
words.ex_cn: 出版商上个月发布了一本新书。
words.en: Publishers are companies or individuals that prepare and issue books, journals, or music for sale.

words.ex: The audience clapped loudly after the show.
words.ex_cn: 演出结束后，观众热烈鼓掌。
words.en: The group of spectators at a public event; listeners or viewers collectively, especially those attending a performance or reading a particular work.

words.tr: n. 弦；线；一连串；“string”的复数；
words.ex: The violin has four strings.
words.ex_cn: 小提琴有四根弦。
words.en: Strings are thin pieces of material such as thread or cord, or the thin wires stretched across some musical instruments to produce sound.

words.ex: He stayed home because he had the flu.
words.ex_cn: 他因为得了流感待在家里。
words.en: The flu is an infectious disease characterized by fever, aches and pains, and respiratory symptoms.

words.ex: Farmers use irrigation to water their crops.
words.ex_cn: 农民使用灌溉来浇灌庄稼。
words.en: Irrigation is the process of supplying water to land or crops to help growth, typically by means of channels.

words.tr: n. 杂草；野草；“weed”的复数； v. 除草；铲除；
words.ex: The garden is full of weeds.
words.ex_cn: 花园里长满了杂草。
words.en: Weeds are plants that grow in places where they are not wanted, often in gardens or among crops, and can prevent desired plants from growing properly.

words.tr: n. 群体；殖民地；聚居地；
words.ex: A colony of ants moved quickly across the ground.
words.ex_cn: 一群蚂蚁迅速从地上爬过。
words.en: A colony is a country or area that is under the political control of another country, usually one that is far away, and where people from that country live.

words.ex: The store uses a barcode to scan the price.
words.ex_cn: 商店使用条形码扫描价格。
words.en: A barcode is an arrangement of numbers and parallel lines of different widths printed on a product, which can be read by a machine to identify the product and its price.

words.ex: The new machine improves the efficiency of production.
words.ex_cn: 这台新机器提高了生产的效率。
words.en: Efficiency is the ability to do something or produce something without wasting materials, time, or energy.

words.ex: He dismissed her advice and walked away.
words.ex_cn: 他不理会她的建议，走开了。
words.en: If you dismiss someone, you send them away or allow them to leave.

words.ex: He bought timber to build a fence.
words.ex_cn: 他买了木材来建篱笆。
words.en: Wood prepared for use in building and carpentry.

words.ex: The doctor examined the tissue under a microscope.
words.ex_cn: 医生在显微镜下检查了组织。
words.en: Tissue is a group of cells that have a similar structure and that work together to perform a specific function.

words.tr: adj. 倾斜的；有坡度的； v. “slope”的现在分词；
words.ex: The sloping roof lets rainwater run off easily.
words.ex_cn: 倾斜的屋顶让雨水容易流走。
words.en: Something that is sloping has a surface or edge that is at an angle, so that one end is higher than the other.

words.ex: Water evaporation happens when the sun heats the lake.
words.ex_cn: 当太阳加热湖泊时，水就会蒸发。
words.en: Evaporation is the process by which a liquid turns into a gas.

words.tr: n. 性格；人物角色；特点；
words.ex: His character is kind and patient.
words.ex_cn: 他的性格善良且有耐心。
words.en: The combination of qualities or features that distinguishes one person, group, or thing from another.

words.ex: He couldn't hide his frustration after losing the game.
words.ex_cn: 他输掉比赛后无法掩饰自己的沮丧。
words.en: The feeling of being upset or annoyed as a result of being unable to change or achieve something.

words.ex: The satellite sends pictures from space.
words.ex_cn: 卫星从太空发送图片。
words.en: A satellite is an object which has been sent into space in order to collect information or to be part of a communications system. Satellites move continually round the earth or around another planet.

words.tr: n. 信号；“signal”的复数； v. 预示；
words.ex: The radio receives signals from satellites.
words.ex_cn: 收音机接收来自卫星的信号。
words.en: A signal is a gesture, sound, or action which is intended to give a particular message to the person who sees or hears it.

words.ex: He is allergic to shellfish.
words.ex_cn: 他对贝类过敏。
words.en: Shellfish are sea creatures that live in shells and are eaten as food.

words.ex: He drank water to help his kidney work better.
words.ex_cn: 他喝水以帮助肾脏更好地工作。
words.en: One of the two organs in your lower back that separate waste products from your blood and make urine.

words.tr: n. 嵌套开采；指在已有矿井或开采区域内部或周围进行的二次或深层采矿活动
words.ex: The birds are nesting in the trees near the mining site.
words.ex_cn: 鸟儿在采矿场附近的树上筑巢。
words.en: The process of extracting minerals or resources from underground deposits, often involving shafts or tunnels.

words.ex: Crocodiles live in rivers and swamps.
words.ex_cn: 鳄鱼生活在河流和沼泽中。
words.en: Crocodiles are large aquatic reptiles that live throughout the tropics in Africa, Asia, the Americas and Australia.

words.ex: Rats ran across the kitchen floor.
words.ex_cn: 老鼠跑过了厨房地板。
words.en: Rats are small rodents that are often considered pests.

words.tr:
n. 茎；词干；
v. 起源于(~ from)；
words.ex: The flower grows on a long green stem.
words.ex_cn: 花长在一根长长的绿色茎上。
words.en: The main body or stalk of a plant or shrub, typically rising above ground but occasionally subterranean; to stop or restrict (the flow of something).

words.ex: The gravity of Earth pulls objects down.
words.ex_cn: 地球的重力把物体往下拉。
words.en: Gravity is the force that causes things to fall towards the Earth or towards any other physical body having mass.

words.ex: The dams hold back the river water.
words.ex_cn: 这些大坝拦住了河水。
words.en: A dam is a barrier that stops or restricts the flow of water or underground streams. Reservoirs created by dams not only suppress floods but also provide water for activities such as irrigation, human consumption, industrial use, aquaculture, and navigability.

words.tr: n. 化妆品；美容品；“cosmetic”的复数；
words.ex: She buys cosmetics at the drugstore.
words.ex_cn: 她在药店买化妆品。
words.en: Substances or treatments used to enhance or alter the appearance of the face or body.

words.ex: The bridge is made of steel.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥是用钢建造的。
words.en: Steel is a very strong metal made mainly from iron. It is used for making many things such as bridges, buildings, and vehicles.

words.ex: The team improved its defense in the second half.
words.ex_cn: 球队在下半场改进了防守。
words.en: The act of defending against attack, danger, or injury.

words.ex: The shark opened its jaws wide.
words.ex_cn: 鲨鱼张开了它的颚。
words.en: The jaws are the two bones in your head between which your teeth are fixed, or the parts at the sides of your mouth that you can move when you eat or speak.

words.ex: He speaks Chinese as his mother tongue.
words.ex_cn: 他把汉语作为母语。
words.en: The tongue is the flexible muscular organ in the mouth that is used for tasting, licking, swallowing, and (in humans) articulating speech.

words.tr:
n. 刺；刺痛；
v. 刺；刺痛；
words.ex: The bee gave him a sharp sting.
words.ex_cn: 蜜蜂给了他一下刺痛。
words.en: If a plant, animal, or insect stings you, it pricks your skin and usually pushes poison into your body with a sharp pointed part of its body.

words.ex: The lion is a carnivorous animal.
words.ex_cn: 狮子是一种食肉动物。
words.en: Carnivorous animals or plants eat meat.

words.ex: The deer is herbivorous.
words.ex_cn: 这只鹿是食草的。
words.en: Herbivorous animals are those that feed on plants.

words.ex: The earthquake shook the houses last night.
words.ex_cn: 昨晚地震震动了房屋。
words.en: An earthquake is a sudden shaking of the ground caused by the passage of seismic waves through Earth's rocks.

words.tr: n. 奖金；红利；额外津贴；
words.ex: He received a bonus for working overtime.
words.ex_cn: 他因加班获得了奖金。
words.en: A bonus is an extra amount of money that is added to someone's pay, usually because they have worked very hard.

words.ex: The volcanoes erupted last year.
words.ex_cn: 这些火山去年喷发了。
words.en: A volcano is a mountain that opens downward to a pool of molten rock below the surface of the earth. When pressure builds up, eruptions occur.

words.ex: The children learned through visual aids like pictures.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们通过图片等视觉辅助工具学习。
words.en: relating to seeing or to the eyes

words.ex: He needs surgery for his broken arm.
words.ex_cn: 他需要做手术来治疗断掉的胳膊。
words.en: Surgery is the medical specialty that uses operative manual and instrumental techniques on a patient to investigate or treat a pathological condition such as a disease or injury, to help improve bodily function or appearance, or to repair unwanted ruptured areas.

words.ex: The sandglass shows the time by falling sand.
words.ex_cn: 沙漏通过落下的沙子显示时间。
words.en: A sandglass is a device that measures time by the flow of sand from one glass bulb to another, typically taking a fixed amount of time to do so.

words.ex: He felt deep depression after losing his job.
words.ex_cn: 他失业后感到深深的抑郁。
words.en: A period during which business, employment, and stock-market values decline severely or remain at a very low level of activity.

words.ex: The drought made it hard to grow crops.
words.ex_cn: 旱灾使种植庄稼变得困难。
words.en: A drought is a long period of time during which no rain falls and hence there is a shortage of water.

words.ex: Good digestion helps your body absorb nutrients.
words.ex_cn: 良好的消化有助于身体吸收营养。
words.en: The process by which food is broken down in the stomach and intestines so that the body can absorb it and use it for energy and nutrients.

words.ex: He smokes a cigar after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭后抽一支雪茄。
words.en: A cigar is a tightly rolled bundle of dried and fermented tobacco leaves, which is ignited so that its smoke may be drawn into the mouth.

words.ex: The bear left a footprint in the snow.
words.ex_cn: 熊在雪地上留下了足迹。
words.en: A footprint is a mark made by a foot or shoe on a surface.

words.tr: n. 材料；组成部分；“ingredient”的复数；
words.ex: The recipe lists all the ingredients you need.
words.ex_cn: 这个食谱列出了你需要的所有材料。
words.en: The ingredients of something are the things that are used to make it, especially in cooking.

words.ex: The skyscraper is very tall and has many floors.
words.ex_cn: 这座摩天大楼非常高，有很多层。
words.en: A skyscraper is a very tall building that has many floors.

words.tr: n. 差额；边缘；净利润；余地；
words.ex: The profit margin is five dollars.
words.ex_cn: 利润差额是五美元。
words.en: The margin is the edge or border of something, or the difference between two amounts, especially the difference between the cost of producing something and the price it is sold for.

words.ex: He cannot breathe when he runs fast.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得快时无法呼吸。
words.en: To breathe means to take air into your lungs and then expel it, a process necessary for life.

words.ex: The children left litter on the beach.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在海滩上留下了垃圾。
words.en: If a place is littered with something, it contains many examples of it that are usually not arranged neatly or properly.

words.ex: Washing hands kills germs.
words.ex_cn: 洗手可以杀死细菌。
words.en: Germs are very small organisms that cause disease.

words.ex: He votes in a democratic election.
words.ex_cn: 他在民主选举中投票。
words.en: A democratic country, government, or political system is governed by representatives who are elected by the people.

words.ex: The teacher monitors the students' progress each week.
words.ex_cn: 老师每周监控学生的进步。
words.en: A monitor is a machine that is used to check or record things, for example in a factory or hospital. In a school, a monitor is a student who helps the teacher with various duties.

words.tr:
n. 纪律；学科；科目；训练；惩戒；
v. 约束自己；
words.ex: The teacher enforced discipline in the classroom.
words.ex_cn: 老师在教室里维持纪律。
words.en: Discipline is the practice of making people obey rules or standards of behaviour, and punishing them when they do not.

words.ex: His contribution helped the team win.
words.ex_cn: 他的贡献帮助团队赢得了比赛。
words.en: A contribution is a gift or payment to a common fund or collection, or the part played by a person or thing in bringing about a result or helping something to advance.

words.ex: His tolerance for different opinions is impressive.
words.ex_cn: 他对不同观点的宽容令人印象深刻。
words.en: The ability or willingness to tolerate the existence of opinions or behaviour that one dislikes or disagrees with.

words.tr: n. 整形外科；外科修补术；“plastic”的复数；
words.ex: He went to the hospital for plastics after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 事故发生后，他去医院做了整形外科手术。
words.en: Plastics are materials which are produced from oil by a chemical process and which are used to make many objects. They are light in weight and do not break easily.

words.ex: The building is made of limestone.
words.ex_cn: 这座建筑是由石灰岩建造的。
words.en: Limestone is a sedimentary rock composed largely of the mineral calcite (calcium carbonate: CaCO3).

words.tr: v. 繁荣兴旺；茁壮成长；
words.ex: The business flourishes in the new market.
words.ex_cn: 这家企业在新市场中繁荣兴旺。
words.en: If something flourishes, it is successful, active, or common, and developing quickly and strongly.

words.ex: He speaks three languages fluently.
words.ex_cn: 他能流利地说三种语言。
words.en: Languages refer to the system of communication used by a particular community or country, consisting of words used in a structured and conventional way and conveyed by speech, writing, or gesture.

words.ex: We read chapter eleven in math class.
words.ex_cn: 我们在数学课上读了第十一章。
words.en: A legal procedure in the United States for businesses to reorganize their finances under court supervision.

words.ex: He gets a salary of 3000 dollars each month.
words.ex_cn: 他每个月赚3000美元的工资。
words.en: A salary is the money that someone is paid each month by their employer, especially when they are in a profession such as teaching, law, or medicine.

words.ex: His behavior at the party was very polite.
words.ex_cn: 他在派对上的举止非常礼貌。
words.en: The way in which one acts or conducts oneself, especially towards others.

words.ex: Hormones control growth and mood in the body.
words.ex_cn: 荷尔蒙控制身体的生长和情绪。
words.en: A hormone is a chemical substance produced in the body that controls and regulates the activity of certain cells or organs.

words.ex: The desert has little vegetation.
words.ex_cn: 这个沙漠植被很少。
words.en: Vegetation refers to plants in general, or the plants that are found in a particular area. It can also refer to a life that is dull or inactive, often due to illness or lack of exercise.

words.ex: Many people died of starvation during the famine.
words.ex_cn: 许多人在饥荒中饿死了。
words.en: Starvation is a severe deficiency in caloric energy intake, below the level needed to maintain an organism's life.

words.ex: Drinking water helps with hydration.
words.ex_cn: 喝水有助于水合。
words.en: The process of causing something to absorb water.

words.tr:
v. 伸展；延伸；持续；
n. 一段；伸展；
words.ex: He stretches his arms every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上伸展手臂。
words.en: To stretch is to extend your body or a part of your body to its full length, or to extend something else to its full length or beyond its normal limits.

words.ex: His residence is near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他的住所靠近公园。
words.en: A residence is a house or place where someone lives.

words.ex: The merchandiser sells clothes at the market.
words.ex_cn: 这位商人在市场卖衣服。
words.en: A merchandiser is a person or company that buys and sells goods, especially in large quantities.

words.tr: n. 婴儿；幼儿；婴儿，幼儿( infant的名词复数 )；
words.ex: The nurses care for infants in the hospital.
words.ex_cn: 护士们在医院照顾婴儿。
words.en: Infants are very young children, especially those who are not yet able to walk or talk.

words.ex: The cost of maintenance is low for this car.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车的维持费用很低。
words.en: The process of preserving a condition or situation or the state of being preserved.

words.ex: The occupancy of the hotel is high during summer.
words.ex_cn: 夏天酒店的占用率很高。
words.en: The act of occupying or the state of being occupied, especially the condition of being occupied by tenants or the period during which a property is occupied.

words.ex: The teacher gave a classification of animals into mammals and birds.
words.ex_cn: 老师将动物分为哺乳动物和鸟类。
words.en: The action or process of classifying something according to shared qualities or characteristics.

words.ex: The secretary types letters for the manager.
words.ex_cn: 秘书为经理打字。
words.en: A secretary is a person whose job is to do office work, such as typing letters, answering phone calls, and arranging meetings.

words.tr: n. 出版物（publication 的复数）
words.ex: He reads many scientific publications.
words.ex_cn: 他阅读许多科学出版物。
words.en: Publications refer to the act of making something known to the public, especially by printing it in a book, magazine, or newspaper, or the thing that is published.

words.tr: phrase. 参与所需提供的住宿安排及复印件
words.ex: Her participation in the meeting helped with accommodation and photocopies.
words.ex_cn: 她参加会议有助于安排住宿和复印材料。
words.en: The act of providing copies of documents or materials to support participation in an event or process.

words.tr:
adj. 多媒体的；
n. 多媒体；
words.ex: The school uses multimedia tools to teach students.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校使用多媒体工具来教学。
words.en: Multimedia is the use of computers to present text, graphics, video, animation, and sound in an integrated way.

words.ex: The students gave presentations about their science projects.
words.ex_cn: 学生们做了关于他们科学项目的报告。
words.en: The act of presenting or the state of being presented.

words.tr: n. 参考；提及；介绍信；引用；
words.ex: Please use this book for reference.
words.ex_cn: 请使用这本书作为参考。
words.en: A reference is a mention of something or someone, or a letter or statement about someone's character or abilities.

words.ex: Good management helps a company grow.
words.ex_cn: 良好的管理有助于公司发展。
words.en: The control and organization of something, especially a business and its employees.

words.ex: He finished his homework before the deadline.
words.ex_cn: 他在截止日期前完成了作业。
words.en: A deadline is a time or date before which a particular task must be finished or a particular thing must be done.

words.ex: The game uses a simulation of weather changes.
words.ex_cn: 这个游戏使用了天气变化的模拟。
words.en: A simulation is an imitation of a situation or process.

words.ex: The statistics show a rise in sales last year.
words.ex_cn: 这些统计数字显示去年销售额有所上升。
words.en: Statistics is a branch of mathematics dealing with the collection, analysis, interpretation, presentation, and organization of data.

words.ex: The teacher gave an evaluation of the student's work.
words.ex_cn: 老师对学生的作业进行了评估。
words.en: An evaluation is a judgment about how good, useful, or successful something is.

words.ex: The wind turbine spins to make electricity.
words.ex_cn: 风力涡轮机旋转以发电。
words.en: A turbine is a machine or engine which uses a stream of air, gas, water, or steam to turn a wheel and produce power.

words.ex: He values his privacy and doesn't share personal info online.
words.ex_cn: 他重视自己的隐私，不在网上分享个人信息。
words.en: The state or condition of being free from being observed or disturbed by other people.

words.tr: phrase. 应用监控的独立性；指应用监控系统或过程在运行、管理和决策上不受其他系统或外部因素影响的能力
words.ex: He uses an app to monitor his daily habits.
words.ex_cn: 他用一个应用程序来监控自己的日常习惯。
words.en: The state of being independent from external control or influence in software or system operations.

words.tr:
n. 格式；
v. 格式化；
words.ex: The file is in PDF format.
words.ex_cn: 这个文件是PDF格式。
words.en: The way in which something is arranged or set out.

words.ex: The teacher gave us a handout about photosynthesis.
words.ex_cn: 老师发给我们一份关于光合作用的讲义。
words.en: A handout is a document which contains news or information about something and which is given, for example, to journalists or to people attending a talk or lecture.

words.ex: Wearing a helmet is compulsory for cyclists.
words.ex_cn: 骑自行车时戴头盔是必须的。
words.en: If something is compulsory, you must do it because of a rule or law.

words.tr: adj. 已退休的；已退职的； v. 退休；“retire”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: My retired grandfather walks in the park every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我已退休的爷爷每天早上都在公园散步。
words.en: Having left one's job and ceased to work.

words.ex: The rangers patrol the forest to protect animals.
words.ex_cn: 护林员巡逻森林以保护动物。
words.en: Rangers are individuals or groups responsible for patrolling and protecting a particular area, such as a forest or park, or serving in a military capacity.

words.ex: The researchers used questionnaires for measurement.
words.ex_cn: 研究人员使用问卷进行测量。
words.en: The process of using questionnaires as a tool to collect data or information from respondents for research or assessment purposes.

words.tr: n. [车辆]汽车；发动器；[车辆]汽车，发动器（automobile 复数）；
words.ex: Many automobiles are electric now.
words.ex_cn: 现在许多汽车是电动的。
words.en: Automobiles are vehicles that are designed to carry passengers and are powered by an internal combustion engine or an electric motor.

words.ex: He always follows his morality in daily life.
words.ex_cn: 他日常生活中总是遵循自己的道德。
words.en: Morality is the belief that some behaviour is right and acceptable and that other behaviour is wrong.

words.ex: He is stretching his arms before running.
words.ex_cn: 他在跑步前伸展手臂。
words.en: The act of making something longer or wider by pulling it.

words.ex: The head office is in New York.
words.ex_cn: 总部在纽约。
words.en: The main office or center of control of a business or organization, where the most important decisions are made.

words.ex: His loyalty to his friends never changed.
words.ex_cn: 他对朋友的忠诚从未改变。
words.en: The quality of being loyal to someone or something.

words.tr: adj. 负有责任的；应作解释的
words.ex: He is accountable for his mistakes.
words.ex_cn: 他要为自己的错误负责。
words.en: If you are accountable to someone for something that you do, you are responsible for it and must be prepared to justify your actions to that person.

words.ex: Ancient philosophers asked big questions about life.
words.ex_cn: 古代哲学家思考关于生命的重大问题。
words.en: A philosopher is someone who studies or writes about philosophy, which is the study of fundamental questions about existence, knowledge, values, reason, mind, and language.

words.ex: He uses simple strategies to solve math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他使用简单的策略来解决数学问题。
words.en: A strategy is a plan or method chosen to bring about a desired future, such as achieving a goal or solving a problem.

words.tr: n. 毕业文凭；学位证书；
words.ex: He received his diploma last June.
words.ex_cn: 他去年六月拿到了毕业文凭。
words.en: A diploma is a document which may be awarded by a university or college, or by a high school, showing that someone has successfully completed a course of study.

words.ex: The calculation took only five minutes.
words.ex_cn: 这个计算只花了五分钟。
words.en: The process of using mathematics to find a number or amount.

words.tr:
n. 模具；霉；
v. 铸造；
words.ex: The clay was poured into the mould to shape the pot.
words.ex_cn: 将黏土倒入模具中以塑造花盆。
words.en: A mould is a hollow container that you pour a liquid or soft substance into, which then becomes solid in the same shape as the container. Mould can also refer to a fungus that grows on old food or on damp surfaces.

words.ex: This segment of the book is very interesting.
words.ex_cn: 这本书的这一部分非常有趣。
words.en: A segment of something is one of the parts into which it is divided or from which it is formed.

words.ex: The house has good insulation to keep warm in winter.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子有良好的绝缘层以在冬天保暖。
words.en: Insulation is a material or substance that is used to stop heat, electricity, or sound from going from one place to another.

words.ex: There is friction between the two neighbors over the fence.
words.ex_cn: 两个邻居因为篱笆问题产生了不和。
words.en: The resistance that one surface or object encounters when moving over another.

words.ex: The humidity in the room made the air feel heavy.
words.ex_cn: 房间里的湿度让空气感觉很闷。
words.en: Humidity is the amount of water vapor in the air. High humidity makes the air feel wet and sticky.

words.ex: The water has dangerous contaminants.
words.ex_cn: 这种水含有危险的污染物。
words.en: Substances that make something impure, unclean, or polluted, especially by adding harmful substances.

words.ex: He ate ice cream for dessert.
words.ex_cn: 他吃冰淇淋当甜食。
words.en: Dessert is a sweet course eaten at the end of a meal.

words.tr: n. 火烈鸟；火鹤（flamingo 的复数）
words.ex: Flamingos stand on one leg in the lake.
words.ex_cn: 火烈鸟站在湖里，单腿站立。
words.en: Flamingos are large, pink or red birds with long legs and necks, and they are known for standing on one leg in shallow water.

words.ex: The skeleton of the dinosaur is displayed in the museum.
words.ex_cn: 恐龙的骨架在博物馆里展出。
words.en: The internal structure that supports and gives shape to a person, animal, or plant, composed of bones and cartilage in vertebrates.

words.ex: The accountants checked the company's money records.
words.ex_cn: 会计师检查了公司的财务记录。
words.en: Accountants are professionals who manage financial records, ensure accuracy in financial statements, and help with tax preparation.

words.ex: They did a collaborative project in class.
words.ex_cn: 他们在课堂上做了一个合作项目。
words.en: A collaborative piece of work is done by two or more people or groups working together.

words.ex: The child left footprints in the wet sand.
words.ex_cn: 孩子在湿沙地上留下了脚印。
words.en: The marks left by a person's or animal's foot on a surface.

words.tr: n. 药物；药物治疗；药物处理；
words.ex: He took his medication every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上吃药。
words.en: Medication refers to a substance used for medical treatment, especially a medicine or drug.

words.ex: He read the first chapter of the book.
words.ex_cn: 他读了这本书的第一章。
words.en: A chapter is one of the parts that a book is divided into. Each chapter has a number, and sometimes a title.

words.ex: He is good at problem-solving tasks.
words.ex_cn: 他擅长解决问题的任务。
words.en: The process of finding solutions to difficult or complex issues.

words.ex: He did a self-evaluation after the test.
words.ex_cn: 他在考试后做了自我评估。
words.en: The act of assessing one's own abilities, performance, or qualities.

words.ex: Good decision-making helps teams succeed.
words.ex_cn: 良好的决策有助于团队成功。
words.en: The process of making choices, especially important ones, in an organization or group.

words.tr: adj. 以自我为中心的；自私的
words.ex: He is self-centered and never listens to others.
words.ex_cn: 他以自我为中心，从不听别人的话。
words.en: Someone who is self-centered is only concerned with their own needs and interests and does not consider the needs or wishes of other people.

words.ex: He learned self-defense to stay safe.
words.ex_cn: 他学习了自卫以确保安全。
words.en: Self-defense is the act of defending oneself, one's property, or a close relative from physical harm.

words.ex: He uses an energy-saving light bulb.
words.ex_cn: 他使用一个节能灯泡。
words.en: Designed to use less energy, especially electricity, in order to reduce costs or environmental impact.

words.ex: He is a well-organized student.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个有条理的学生。
words.en: Arranged or structured in an efficient and effective way.

words.ex: He shows self-motivation by studying every day.
words.ex_cn: 他通过每天学习展现自我激励。
words.en: Self-motivation refers to the ability to motivate oneself to take initiative and action to pursue goals and complete tasks.

words.ex: He took sick-pay last week because he had a fever.
words.ex_cn: 他上周因为发烧请了病假工资。
words.en: Sick-pay is the money that an employer pays to an employee who is unable to work because of illness.

words.ex: He made a pre-booking for the hotel room.
words.ex_cn: 他提前预订了酒店房间。
words.en: The act of booking or reserving something in advance.

words.tr: adj. 勤勉的；努力工作的
words.ex: He is hard-working and always finishes his homework on time.
words.ex_cn: 他很勤奋，总是按时完成作业。
words.en: Someone who is hard-working always puts a lot of effort and care into their work.
